text: Seeds (during facility phase) or plays on your ship (limit one per ship) or outpost, or on any {headquarters}. Adds Holodeck, and your compatible [Holo] cards may report aboard. OR Plays once each turn to download a {Holoprogram} or any [Holo] or [Bar] card; place doorway out-of-play. OR Plays at any time to prevent the deactivation of any one [Holo] personnel; discard doorway.

name: Holoprogram: 221B Baker Street
text: Seeds or plays on your ship or facility with a Holodeck. In place of your normal card play, you may download {Sherlock Holmes} (or any personnel with his name in lore) aboard. OR Seeds or plays on table. Once each turn, you may place a personnel here from hand. Personnel placed here add [Holo] icon to your copies of same personnel in play. You may discard any cards placed here at any time.

name: Holoprogram: Deadwood
text: Seeds or plays on your ship with a Holodeck. {Sheriff Worf} and {Deputy Rozhenko} may report aboard. If both aboard: location here is span+X for opponent (where X=number of your SECURITY personnel aboard, maximum 4), opponent must have more SECURITY here than you to initiate battle here, and, once each turn, Sheriff Worf may nullify any dilemma requiring SECURITY he just encountered here.

name: Holoprogram: Noah's Mountain Retreat
text: Seeds or plays on any ship or facility with a Holodeck. You may report {Secret Agent Julian Bashir} (or any personnel with his name in lore) aboard. In place of your normal card play, you may download such a personnel aboard. Also, if your Transporter Skill aboard, at start of turn you may replace (discard) your {Dr. Noah} (or personnel with his name in lore) present by downloading a version of same persona.

name: Holoprogram: Fortress of Doom
text: Seeds or plays on your ship with a Holodeck. In place of your normal card play, you may download {Chaotica} (or any card with his name in lore) aboard. While Chaotica is aboard (and {Captain Proton} is not at same location), opponent must discard two cards to attempt mission at this location unless they have a [Holo] personnel participating in the attempt.

name: Holoprogram: The Office of Dixon Hill
text: Seeds or plays on your ship with a Holodeck. In place of a card draw, you may download {Felix Leech} aboard. Also, your {Cyrus Redblock} may report aboard and, if he is aboard, once each turn you may request "the item." Place a card from hand face down on table. Opponent must choose: you may play it for free and draw a card OR you must place it out-of-play and score 5 points.

name: Holo-Projectors (Premiere Remastered) (Holodeck Adventures)
text: Plays on a [P]. [Holo] cards may exist on this planet (activated or deactivated). If nullified, [Holo] cards that depended on these Holo-Projectors for existence are erased.
lore: Technology which the escaped Hirogen holograms hoped to use to establish a permanent home planet. B'Elanna Torres helped Kejal bring the device online.

name: Home Away From Home
text: Seeds or plays on your ship with one or more staffing icons. If a [DQ] ship with "Alpha Quadrant" in lore: while not in Alpha Quadrant, your equipment and matching [DQ] personnel may report aboard; once each turn, one who has [Stf] icon may do so for free. If any other non-Borg ship: while not in its native quadrant, your personnel who match ship's affiliation and native quadrant (and your equipment) may report aboard.

name: Homefront
text: Seeds or plays on any homeworld. In place of a normal card play, a SECURITY personnel matching homeworld's affiliation may download here (owner draws no cards that turn). No player may attempt mission or use {headquarters} game text here unless they have 4 SECURITY on planet. OR Plays on table. Your personnel who have infiltration icons may report (for free) on homeworlds those icons match.

name: Homeward
text: Anthropology + Computer Skill
lore: Aid study of primitive culture on planet threatened by intense radiation storms.

name: Hon'Tihl
text: OFFICER SCIENCE Geology Treachery
lore: First officer and sole survivor of the I.K.C. Toh'Kaht. Briefly succeeded captain Kee'Bhor. Suffering from the influence of Saltah'na energy spheres.

name: Horta
text: Place on planet. Now and end of every player's turn, kills one of that player's personnel present (random selection). Cure with 2 Leadership, 2 Mindmeld, and 2 Exobiology.
lore: Silicon-based life-form native to Janus VI. Every 50,000 years, all Horta die off except one, which must repopulate the species through egg laying. Will kill to protect its young.

name: Hoshi Sato
text: OFFICER Music Anthropology DL/ {Hail} May nullify Female-related dilemmas where present.
lore: Communications officer on board Enterprise, NX-01. Didn't want to come along, but after listening to some Klingon, she felt motivated.

name: Hostage Situation
text: SECURITY x2 + MEDICAL + INTEGRITY>32
lore: Coordinate with local authorities to free captives held hostage.

name: Hostage Trade
text: Seeds or plays on table (for free if you hold any captives). (Unique.) {Prisoner Exchange} and {Fajo's Gallery} may each be used only once per turn. Where your personnel are escorting captive(s), you may release any or all of them (relocate to owner's crew or Away Team there) and capture an equal number of other personnel there, then discard incident.

name: Howard Heirloom Candle
text: Plays to double effects of {Anaphasic Organism} or {Empathic Echo} OR nullifies {Coalescent Organism} OR prevents {Anya} or {Salia} from morphing this turn.
lore: The anaphasic organism appearing as Ronin lived in and drew power from this special candle.

name: HQ: Defensive Measures
text: Seeds or plays on table. Your personnel with any Intelligence gain 1 Leadership and may initiate battle against their own affiliation. Also, opponent may not attempt any of your missions with more than one affiliation icon on each end unless opponent attempted to seed a copy of that mission OR opponent is using an appropriate {Espionage} card.

name: HQ: Ferengi Credit Exchange
text: Seeds or plays on {Ferenginar}, {Ferengi Trading Post} or {Quark's Bar}. Any player who has Acquisition present may, once each turn, discard up to three {Gold-Pressed Latinum} cards present. For each one discarded, score 2 points (place that Latinum card in point area), draw one card or place any one card from discard pile beneath draw deck. May be nullified by {Subspace Interference}.

name: HQ: Orbital Weapons Platform
text: Plays on any homeworld. Each time opponent initiates battle here against your ship or facility matching this homeworld's affiliation, just after it is targeted each of your Orbital Weapons Platforms here may "fire upon" an opposing ship present. Each ship fired upon is damaged = [Flip][Flip] for each Platform that targets it, and you may exclude that ship from that battle.

name: HQ: Return Orb to Bajor
text: Plays on your [Orb] personnel. Where present, that personnel may earn Orb artifacts just encountered and may "reclaim" (steal) any Orb artifacts in play. If that personnel is on {Bajor} with Orb artifacts present, draw up to three cards for each one, discard objective and score points. (Each artifact may be "returned" only once per game.)

name: HQ: Secure Homeworld
text: Seeds or plays on a homeworld. Your Away Teams which include a personnel who matches homeworld's affiliation may attempt the mission using these requirements: Leadership x2 + SECURITY + (Honor OR Treachery) + any one attribute total > point value of mission When you solve mission, capture all opposing personnel on planet who do not match affiliation of homeworld.

name: HQ: War Room
text: Plays on a homeworld. Your OFFICER, SECURITY, Leadership and Resistance personnel of same affiliation as that homeworld are CUNNING +2 and STRENGTH +2.
lore: During the Bajoran civil war of 2370, General Krim charted troop movements for the Bajoran Militia from his fortified map room.

name: Hull Breach
text: Unless {Environmental Suit} present, kills one non-android (random selection) and another non-android of same classification (random selection). Mission continues.
lore: In 2372, a spatial scission caused explosive decompression aboard U.S.S. Voyager. Harry Kim was lost in the incident, and later replaced by a duplicate Harry from a duplicate Voyager.

name: Humuhumunukunukuapua'a
text: Plays on any location. Your Youth personnel here are CUNNING and STRENGTH +4; opponent's [Non] personnel here are CUNNING and STRENGTH 4.
lore: A reef triggerfish, Rhinecanthus rectangulus, found near Earth's tropical islands. An animated version is a symbolic "guide" on the U.S.S. Enterprise schoolroom computers.

name: Hunt Alien
text: Anthropology + Exobiology + Leadership + (STRENGTH>40 OR {Borg Nanoprobes})
lore: Stalk and kill wounded member of Species 8472.

name: Hunter Gangs
text: Two Away Team members (random selection) are chased. Examine cards separately. Personnel escapes if CUNNING even, killed if odd. Discard dilemma.
lore: On some planets, civilization has devolved into a bitter struggle for survival. Violent gangs search for prey, such as those which chased Natasha Yar on Turkana IV.

name: Hunting Group
text: Seeds or plays on your non-[HIR] space mission with a point box. You may attempt it using these requirements: Alpha-Hirogen + [Hir] ship + (CUNNING + STRENGTH) > mission points x3 When you solve mission, you may commandeer an opposing ship present (capturing opposing personnel aboard) if your total WEAPONS there > twice its SHIELDS. Discard objective.

name: Husnock Outpost
text: Seed at any [NON] location. You may seed one [Univ] {Husnock Ship} face up here. Extends only 25% of its SHIELDS to ships.
lore: The sudden eradication of the entire Husnock race left its many outposts vacant. Various affiliations take advantage of these available facilities.

name: Hypospray
text: Once each battle, your MEDICAL present may stun their adversary OR change one personnel from mortally wounded to disabled. (Does not affect inorganics.) (Cumulative.)
lore: Uses an aerosuspension delivery system to administer subcutaneous or intramuscular medication. Can also be used to sedate an adversary.

name: I Am Not a Merry Man!
text: Plays on any one Klingon. While in play, once per turn that Klingon may nullify one [Q] icon interrupt, event or dilemma where present. (Not duplicatable.)
lore: I will not play the fool for Q's amusement!

name: I Do Not Take Orders From You!
text: Plays at start of a personnel battle you initiated (once per battle). Each of your personnel who has Treachery x2 may kill an opposing personnel who has lower CUNNING.
lore: Admiral Dougherty knew the Son'a were devious and dangerous, but never imagined how far Ru'afo would go until it was too late. "The Federation will never know what happened here."

name: I Hate You
text: To get past requires Anthropology, Youth, and no Music present. Nullified by {Vulcan Nerve Pinch}.
lore: The sins of all our fathers, being dumped on us - the sons. The only choice we're given is HOW MANY MEGATONS? And, I eschew you! And I say SCREW YOU! And I hope you're blue too.

name: I Just Love Scanning for Life-forms
text: Plays to reveal up to three cards from the top of any draw deck (six if your own). Discard all non-personnel cards; replace remaining cards in any order. Discard event.
lore: Life-forms... you tiny little life-forms... you precious little life-forms... where are you?

name: I Tried to Warn You
text: If you began this mission with only one non-Borg personnel, or if all your missions have the same icon ([S] or [P]), opponent places dilemma on any one mission in play. Q makes that mission unattemptable and unscoutable; destroys any points already gained from solving that mission or completing an objective targeting that mission. (May not be nullified.)
lore: You're making a terrible mistake.

name: I.K.S. Amar
keywords: Cloaking Device; Klingon ship; Tractor Beam;
text: Cloaking Device, Tractor Beam
lore: One of the first K't'inga-class ships. Leader of the battle group dispatched to escort an unidentified intruder out of Klingon space in 2271.

name: I.K.S. Chang
keywords: Cloaking Device; Holodeck; Klingon ship; Tractor Beam;
text: Cloaking Device, Holodeck, Tractor Beam If your {I.K.S. Fek'lhr} in play, it has a <L) icon and both ships reduce staffing by one [AU] icon.
lore: Patrolled the Devron system with sister ship I.K.S. Fek'lhr. Formerly commanded by Governor Worf.

name: I.K.S. Chontay
keywords: Bird-of-Prey; Cloaking Device; Klingon ship; Tractor Beam;
text: Cloaking Device, Tractor Beam (cannot carry ships aboard).
lore: Bird-of-prey captained by Klaa. The highlight of its mission was shooting space garbage until its pursuit of the U.S.S. Enterprise-A through the Great Barrier.

name: I.K.C. Fek'lhr
keywords: Cloaking Device; future-related ship; Holodeck; Klingon ship; Tractor Beam;
text: Cloaking Device, Holodeck, Tractor Beam
lore: Destroyed U.S.S. Pasteur in an alternate future, only to be thwarted by the future Enterprise. Named for the ferocious guardian of Gre'thor.

name: I.K.C. Gr'oth
text: Tractor Beam DL/ {Any Klingon [OS] personnel}
lore: Battle cruiser commanded by Koloth. Dispatched to Federation station K-7, under pretense of shore leave, to further the Empire's plans for Sherman's Planet.

name: I.K.S. K'elric
keywords: Cloaking Device; Klingon ship; Tractor Beam;
text: Cloaking Device, Tractor Beam
lore: One of three ships that ended The Albino's raids on Klingon colonies. Intercepted the Starship Excelsior in the Azure Nebula. Commanded by Captain Kang.

name: I.K.C. Ki'tang
keywords: Bird-of-Prey; Cloaking Device; Klingon ship; Tractor Beam;
text: Cloaking Device, Tractor Beam DL/ {Intermix Ratio}
lore: Klingon Bird-of-Prey that fought in the Dominion War. Immune to the Breen energy-dampening weapon due to a fortuitous tritium intermix adjustment.

name: I.K.S. Kla'Diyus
keywords: B'rel Class; Cloaking Device; Klingon ship;
text: Cloaking Device (while cloaked, may initiate battle but may not be fired upon).
lore: Unique vessel able to fire while cloaked. Commissioned and commanded by General Chang, who ordered the designers killed to preserve the secret of its existence.

name: I.K.C. Koraga
keywords: Bird-of-Prey; Cloaking Device; Klingon ship; Tractor Beam;
text: If your {I.K.C. Rotarran} in play, both are RANGE +1. Cloaking Device, Tractor Beam
lore: Klingon Bird-of-Prey briefly commanded by Worf Son of Mogh in 2375. Along with the I.K.C. Rotarran, engaged a Dominion patrol near the Badlands.

name: I.K.C. K'Ratak
keywords: Bird-of-Prey; Cloaking Device; Klingon ship; Tractor Beam;
text: Cloaking Device, Tractor Beam
lore: Bird-of-Prey named in honor of the author of the classic work of Klingon literature, The Dream of the Fire.

name: I.K.C. Lukara
keywords: Bird-of-Prey; Cloaking Device; Klingon ship; Tractor Beam;
text: Cloaking Device, Tractor Beam
lore: Bird-of-Prey commanded by Kang. Transported its commander and his comrades to Secarus IV in 2370, to confront the Albino in his stronghold.

name: I.K.C. Maht-H'a
keywords: Cloaking Device; Klingon ship; Tractor Beam;
text: Cloaking Device, Tractor Beam
lore: Commanded by Nu'Daq during the chase for clues to a four-billion-year-old genetic message in 2369.

name: I.K.S. Negh'Var
keywords: Cloaking Device; Holodeck; Klingon ship; Tractor Beam;
text: Cloaking Device, Holodeck, Tractor Beam
lore: Flagship of the Klingon Defense Force. Commanded by Gowron when first commissioned, and then by Martok during the 2372 invasion of Cardassia.

name: I.K.C. Ning'tao
keywords: Bird-of-Prey; Cloaking Device; Klingon ship; Tractor Beam;
text: SHIELDS +2 for each opposing [Dom] ship here. Cloaking Device, Tractor Beam
lore: Bird-of-Prey commanded by Kor in 2375. Held off a fleet of ten pursuing Jem'Hadar warships. Presumed lost in glorious battle. Now the subject of legend.

name: I.K.C. Rotarran
keywords: Bird-of-Prey; Cloaking Device; Klingon ship; Tractor Beam;
text: Cloaking Device, Tractor Beam
lore: Bird-of-prey stationed at Deep Space 9 during the war against the Dominion. Commanded by Martok. Led many raids into Cardassian and Dominion space.

name: I.K.C. Toh'Kaht
keywords: Cloaking Device; Klingon ship; Tractor Beam;
text: Attributes all +1 in Gamma Quadrant. Cloaking Device, Tractor Beam
lore: Klingon cruiser dispatched to the Gamma Quadrant on a biosurvey mission. Commanded by first officer Hon'Tihl after its captain was killed in battle.

name: I.K.S. T'Ong
text: Cloaking Device. Must report with up to 3 personnel at end of spaceline.
lore: A Klingon sleeper ship from the 23rd century, an era when Klingons despised humans and attacked them on sight. Commanded by K'Temoc.

name: I.K.C. Voq'leng
keywords: Alpha Quadrant-related [DQ] ship; Cloaking Device; Klingon ship; Tractor Beam;
text: Cloaking Device, Tractor Beam DL/ {Home Away From Home}
lore: 23rd-century battle cruiser. Believing the Empire had lost its way, the original crew set out over a century ago from the Alpha Quadrant on a quest to find the Kuvah'Magh.

name: I.P. Scanner
text: Where present, nullifies {Interphasic Plasma Creatures}, {Brain Drain} and {Phased Matter}.
lore: The Interphasic Scanner has been used to detect signatures of phased matter, invisible interphasic creatures and beings from other subspace domains.

name: I.S.S. Enterprise
text: Tractor Beam DL/ {Any [TE][OS] personnel}
lore: Imperial starship. Credited with many successful and profitable missions. I.S.S. Enterprise officers are frequently promoted - usually through assassination.

name: Ian Andrew Troi
text: OFFICER Diplomacy Leadership Music Computer Skill
lore: Human husband of Lwaxana. Father of Deanna. Seen in Lwaxana's surreal vision of home at Lake El'nar, Betazed. Friend of Steven Miller and Reittan Grax.

name: Icheb
text: CIVILIAN ENGINEER Astrophysics Physics Youth Stellar Cartography Biology
lore: Borg rescued from the collective and his own people, the Brunali. Takes Starfleet Academy courses, taught by U.S.S. Voyager's crew. Prot g of Seven of Nine.

name: Icheb*
text: CIVILIAN ENGINEER Astrophysics Physics Youth Stellar Cartography Biology
lore: Borg rescued from the collective and his own people, the Brunali. Takes Starfleet Academy courses, taught by U.S.S. Voyager's crew. Prot g of Seven of Nine.

name: Iconian Gateway
text: Place in hand. Play as [Event] on a [P] mission: personnel present may walk to other [P] missions.
lore: The now extinct Iconians were "Demons of Air and Darkness" due to their advanced technology such as this instant transport portal to farflung planets.

name: Iden
text: V.I.P. Leadership Anthropology Diplomacy Treachery Astrophysics DL/ {Children of Light}
lore: Charismatic but megalomaniacal hologram. Escaped the Hirogen. Seeks to create a new religion based on his deliverance of holograms from oppression and slavery.

name: Iden*
text: V.I.P. Leadership Anthropology Diplomacy Treachery Astrophysics DL/ {Children of Light}
lore: Charismatic but megalomaniacal hologram. Escaped the Hirogen. Seeks to create a new religion based on his deliverance of holograms from oppression and slavery.

name: Idrin
text: OFFICER Exobiology Archaeology Greed ENGINEER Treachery DL/ {Hirogen Talon}
lore: Massive Alpha-Hirogen in command of a solitary Hunting Vessel. Less interested in the hunt than the spoils of his conquests, envy of his peers, and fear of his captives.

name: Ikat'ika
keywords: Jem'Hadar; Internment Camp 371-related personnel; Jem'Hadar First; Male;
text: OFFICER Honor Leadership Anthropology Your Jem'Hadar present are STRENGTH +1 in battle.
lore: Jem'Hadar First under Deyos. Leader of detachment assigned to Internment Camp 371. Fought Worf as part of training exercise. Skilled combatant.

name: Ilia
text: OFFICER Navigation Biology Anthropology Astrophysics
lore: Deltan navigator assigned to the Starship Enterprise. Her Oath of Celibacy is on record. Was romantically involved with Willard Decker while posted to Delta IV.

name: Ilon Tandro
keywords: Klaestron; Capturing-related card; Deep Space 9-related personnel; Male;
text: V.I.P. Diplomacy ENGINEER Treachery Once per game, may capture one personnel present.
lore: Klaestron dignitary. Son of Enina and General Ardelon Tandro. In 2369, used Cardassian technology to gain access to Deep Space 9 in order to kidnap Jadzia Dax.

name: I'm a Doctor, Not a Bartender
text: Adds Anthropology to one MEDICAL personnel until end of turn. OR Downloads a bartender to replace (discard) your MEDICAL personnel in play (or vice versa).
lore: Though happy to celebrate Kes' second birthday, The Doctor's mood soured when he became trapped in the Chez Sandrine holoprogram during an encounter with a spatial distortion ring.

name: I'm a Doctor, Not a Bricklayer
text: Nullifies {Horta}. OR One MEDICAL personnel gains Geology until end of turn. OR Once per game, downloads a Geology personnel to your MEDICAL and OFFICER.
lore: Despite his protestations to Captain Kirk, Dr. McCoy treated a grievously wounded Horta. Thermal concrete from the supplies of the Starship Enterprise made an excellent wound covering.

name: I'm a Doctor, Not a Doorstop
text: Plays to "stop" any one [Holo] personnel. OR Plays to cancel a personnel battle by sacrificing (discarding) one of your [Holo] personnel present.
lore: Interactive holograms sometimes balk at instructions not compatible with their programming. Dr. Crusher activated an unwilling E.M.H. program to delay a group of Borg.

name: Immortal Again
text: Nullifies {Mortal Q} (plus any {Calamarain}). Q-Continuum is active again. Discard event. (Immune to {Kevin Uxbridge}.) OR Exchange for one {Amanda Rogers} or {Q2} card from your discard pile.
lore: Following Q's "selfless act," Q2 reluctantly restored his powers. He warned Q to try to stay out of trouble - just in time to save the Calamarain from further torment.

name: Impersonate Captive
keywords: Capturing-related card; Infiltration-related card; Infiltrator; Morph card;
text: Seeds or plays on table. Place on your Founder present with a non-Borg personnel you've captured. Founder morphs to impersonate captive. Founder's classification, skills, staffing icon, infiltration icon, STRENGTH and CUNNING change to those of captive. Founder has 1 Treachery, loses all Honor and gains infiltration icon(s) for captive's affiliation(s). May morph back at any time (discard objective).

name: Implication
text: To get past requires 3 Diplomacy and INTEGRITY>30 OR Law and CUNNING>30.
lore: The manager of a Nekrit Supply Depot arrested Chakotay and Tom Paris on charges of conspiracy and murder, based solely on security footage that showed them conversing with the victim.

name: Impressive Trophies
text: Unless CUNNING>50, crew or Away Team member with the most [*] icons OR highest CUNNING + STRENGTH (opponent's choice) is captured. Discard dilemma.
lore: Hirogen hunters always search for prey that provide the greatest challenge - and the most unique relics to adorn their ships.

name: In for a Trim
text: Seeds or plays on table. {Barber Pole} and {Mot's Advice} play for free. Once each turn, if you have Barber Pole in play, you may "take a little off the top": peek at the top X cards of opponent's draw deck, where X is the number of your non-[Bor] Barbering personnel in play. You may discard any events, incidents, or interrupts (except [BO] and [Ref] cards), then replace the rest in any order.

name: In the Bag
text: Allows your Equipment card in play and your shape-shifter in hand to morph (exchange). May be played at the start of battle (may also download {Strike Three} there).
lore: While investigating a Tallonian crystal smuggler, Odo took the form of a latinum-filled satchel. He was forced to abort the sting operation when Worf interfered.

name: In the Pale Moonlight
text: To get past requires a personnel who has INTEGRITY<4 OR a [Fed] Treachery personnel OR any Garak OR a Founder.
lore: In a desperate attempt to spark Romulan participation in the defense of the Alpha Quadrant, Benjamin Sisko enlisted Elim Garak's effective, but questionable, methods.

name: In the Zone
text: Seeds or plays on table. If a non-Borg player scores more than 50 points during a single turn (including this turn), those points in excess of 50 do not count toward winning. While your score is exactly 50 points, each of your ships has double RANGE and SHIELDS. Also, nullifies {End Transmission} and {Preparation}, and each player may call "{Devidian Door}" during their turn (and only once per turn).

name: Incoming Message - The Continuum
text: Opponent may end current Q-Flash now (no more [Q] icon cards are drawn) and immediately seed the card that started it under any other mission (it has no further effects now; mission continues).
lore: Your progress, Q? "As anticipated, there are some problems. I need time."

name: Incoming Message: Attack Authorization
text: Plays on any Federation ship. If Treachery aboard, "This ship must immediately attack one ship (your choice) at this location." May ignore if V.I.P. aboard.
lore: On several occasions, for purposes of Federation security, Starfleet Command has reluctantly or mistakenly ordered captains to attack certain enemy or rogue ships.

name: Incoming Message: Bajoran
text: Plays on a [Baj] ship; its controller targets one of their [Baj] facilities on this spaceline (nullified if none). Ship must do nothing but move toward it. Nullified on arrival at its location.
lore: Messages and directives are sent, faster than light, on subspace radio signals amplified by networks of relay stations.

name: Incoming Message: Cardassian
text: Plays on a [Car] ship; its controller targets one of their [Car] facilities on this spaceline (nullified if none). Ship must do nothing but move toward it. Nullified on arrival at its location.
lore: Messages and directives are sent, faster than light, on subspace radio signals amplified by networks of relay stations.

name: Incoming Message: Ferengi
text: Plays on a [Fer] ship; its controller targets one of their [Fer] facilities on this spaceline (nullified if none). Ship must do nothing but move toward it. Nullified on arrival at its location.
lore: Messages and directives are sent, faster than light, on subspace radio signals amplified by networks of relay stations.

name: Infirmary
text: Compatible MEDICAL-classification personnel, MEDICAL-related Equipment cards and {I.P. Scanner} may report here. Once each turn, any MEDICAL personnel unopposed here may "revive" a personnel present who was disabled by a {Hypospray} (revived personnel is no longer disabled). Matching MEDICAL personnel may {file mission reports} here. Any Nor: Promenade

name: Injector Assembly One
text: May report to location of your Son'a ship. DL/ {Collect Metaphasic Particles}
lore: Specialized ship designed to collect metaphasic radiation particles from the ring system of the Ba'ku planet - a procedure tested extensively by Ru'afo in simulations.

name: Inside Operation
text: Plays at start of ship battle. Each opposing ship and facility in the battle is WEAPONS and SHIELDS -3 if your personnel is infiltrating one of them. Infiltrator exposed.
lore: The changeling impersonating Lovok compromised the mission to destroy the Founders' homeworld. His participation in the battle plans led the attacking fleet into a Jem'Hadar ambush.

name: Install Autonomic Systems Parasite
text: Plays on opponent's ship if your Founder is aboard. That ship may not engage or disengage its special equipment, transporters and WEAPONS until your next turn; then you may use ship to move and/or battle opponent's other cards (ignore staffing and affiliation restrictions); then discard objective. May be nullified by {Miles O'Brien} OR {Odo} OR 3 ENGINEER and 3 SECURITY aboard. (Unique.)

name: Insurrection
text: Leadership x2 + Diplomacy + STRENGTH>50 Ba'ku may report on planet (for free).
lore: Prevent the Son'a attempt to forcibly relocate the Ba'ku race.

name: Intelligence Operation
text: Navigation x2 + (Tal Shiar OR Obsidian Order) + Anthropology + (SECURITY x3 OR {any Odo})
lore: Covertly compile data on current Dominion homeworld in the Omarion Nebula.

name: Intercept Maquis
text: OFFICER + SECURITY + CUNNING>24 May attempt only if your total WEAPONS>14 here.
lore: Prevent attack on secret Cardassian weapons depot.

name: Intercept Renegade
text: Obsidian Order + Tal Shiar + Treachery x3 OR OFFICER x2 + CUNNING>40
lore: Intercept hijacked Starfleet vessel reportedly attacking facilities in Cardassian space.

name: Intermix Ratio
text: Plays on table. If any player's ratio of bonus points to non-bonus points exceeds 1:1, the excess bonus points do not count toward winning. (Immune to {Kevin Uxbridge}.)
lore: Zefram Cochrane struggled to maintain the optimum balance of matter and anti-matter injection for the Phoenix warp systems. The proper ratio, of course, is 1 to 1.

name: Interphasic Plasma Creatures
text: Unless 2 SCIENCE or Mindmeld present, play on table as an Event card. While in play, lowers STRENGTH of each of your personnel by 2. (Not cumulative.)
lore: Organisms from just beyond the range of visual acuity sucked cellular peptides from the U.S.S. Enterprise crew, similar to the way Terran leaches consume hemoglobin.

name: Interrogation
text: Plays on your captive (limit one; discard if released). Once each turn per copy, ask, "How many lights?" If opponent replies "Five," score 10 points; relocate captive anywhere (opponent's choice; released). Otherwise, score 1 point.
lore: In violation of the Seldonis IV convention, Gul Madred interrogated Jean-Luc Picard, seeking Starfleet strategic secrets. He kept asking, "How many lights do you see?"

name: Into the Breach
text: Plays on table until any Q-Flash. While in play, nullifies all {Warp Core Breach} cards and immediately repairs all damaged ships in play, except {Borg Ship}. (Not duplicatable.)
lore: Ooh!

name: Intruder Alert!
text: Seeds or plays on table; nullifies all seeded {Memory Wipe} cards. At any time, you may capture a one- or two-person Away Team in your {Ops} or assimilate one personnel intruder on your Borg ship or facility if your {Talon Drone} is present (discard incident) OR download {Intruder Force Field} (place incident atop event to protect it from nullification and extend its effects to all intruders on your ships).

name: Intruder Force Field
text: Plays on table. While in play, reverses {Telepathic Alien Kidnappers} affecting you AND {Rogue Borg} invading your ships must be 3 or more to be effective.
lore: With one look from Jean-Luc Picard, the U.S.S. Enterprise crew captured two alien intruders in a force field on the bridge - turnabout for their own kidnapping activities.

name: Invasive Beam-In
text: Seeds or plays on table. Each of your ships with Invasive Transporters and Transporter Skill aboard may beam your personnel matching that ship through opponent's SHIELDS.
lore: Dominion transporter technology is optimized for combat operations. The ability to breach enemy shields allows rapid deployment of Jem'Hadar warriors in most battle scenarios.

name: Invasive Procedures
text: Unless a [Def] Borg OR MEDICAL, CUNNING>35, and a {phaser} or {disruptor} present, place on ship; quarantined. Each crew member loses first-listed skill and is attributes all -2.
lore: Srivani researchers covertly boarded U.S.S. Voyager in 2374. Using a phase variance to avoid detection, they performed invasive, and sometimes fatal, medical tests on the crew.

name: Inversion Mystery
text: ENGINEER + Astrophysics + Diplomacy
lore: Determine how plasma strands - typically unstable - have survived here for centuries.

name: Investigate Anomaly II
text: Exobiology + STRENGTH>35 If destroyed, flip mission over.
lore: Trace radiation anomalies.

name: Investigate Anomaly II (back)
text: Exobiology + STRENGTH>35 If your Federation ENGINEER is here, in place of your normal card play you may flip mission over; draw no cards that turn.
lore: Trace radiation anomalies.

name: Investigate Coup
text: OFFICER + Leadership x2 + SECURITY + Navigation OR {Benjamin Sisko} OR {Tomalak} OR {General Krim}
lore: Investigate alleged coup that threatens to change the balance of power in this sector.

name: Investigate Legend
text: Youth x3 + (Diplomacy x2 OR Discard 2 Youth) Cloaks or decloaks each time any points scored.
lore: Verify existence of fabled utopian planet hidden by powerful cloaking device.

name: Investigate Quantum Singularity
text: Navigation x2 + CUNNING>40 + (ENGINEER x3 OR {B'Elanna Torres})
lore: Investigate unidentified transmission emanating from this type-four quantum singularity.

name: Investigate Rumors
text: Navigation + SCIENCE x2 + SECURITY OR Navigation + {Odo}
lore: Search nebula for clues to origin of changelings.

name: Investigate Sighting II
text: Empathy x3 OR Treachery + Exobiology + CUNNING>40 If destroyed, flip mission over.
lore: Investigate sighting of Gomtuu.

name: Investigate Sighting II (back)
text: Empathy x3 OR Treachery + Exobiology + CUNNING>40 If your Romulan ENGINEER is here, in place of your normal card play you may flip mission over; draw no cards that turn.
lore: Investigate sighting of Gomtuu.

name: Ira Graves
text: CIVILIAN Cybernetics Computer Skill SCIENCE Treachery and Biology if {Kareen Brianon} in play.
lore: A mentor of Dr. Soong and thus Lt. Commander Data's "grandfather." Arguably one of the greatest minds of the age. Has Darnay's Disease.

name: Isabella
text: Plays on any non-Borg ship at a nebula; it is destroyed unless Youth aboard by end of your next turn. OR Kill any one Greed personnel who just exploited a {Worshiper}.
lore: At the FGC-47 nebula, the U.S.S. Enterprise encountered an energy being who took the form of a child's imaginary friend. It judged the crew from that perspective.

name: Ishka
text: CIVILIAN Acquisition Computer Skill Honor Music Your {Gold-Pressed Latinum} may report here, for free. While {Grand Nagus Zek} is here, doubles his skills.
lore: Moogie to Quark and Rom. Financial genius. Wears clothes. Earns profit. Secretly helps Zek run his empire.

name: Isolinear Puzzle
text: Place on ship. Reduces RANGE by 4 and WEAPONS by 4. Nullify with 2 ENGINEER.
lore: Jake Sisko and Nog felt compelled to override the autopilot system of the U.S.S. Rio Grande. Unfortunately, they found it easier to take apart than to put back together.

name: Isolytic Burst
text: Attack: 3. Defense: 0. Requires a {Son'a Battleship} or {Li'seria} firing. If you hit, randomly kills one additional personnel (on a Nor, one personnel at site of opponent's choice). Hit = [Down][Flip]. Direct hit = [Down][Flip][Flip][Flip]. Hull: -30% Casualties: randomly kills one personnel (on a Nor, one personnel at site of opponent's choice).

name: Isomagnetic Disintegrator
text: Plays on table. Shuffle your hand into your discard pile, then exchange your discard pile for your draw deck. Draw four cards (may not be converted to downloads). Discard event.
lore: Don't give an isomagnetic disintegrator to a Klingon showing signs of jak'tahla unless you want him to use it.

name: Issue Secret Orders
text: Seeds or plays on table. Place on your V.I.P. or OFFICER who has been infiltrating opponent's ship since start of opponent's last turn. Target any opponent's mission in same quadrant. Ship and crew must do nothing but go to that mission (with infiltrator aboard) and attempt it if possible (any infiltrators may decline); then infiltrator is exposed. Discard objective whenever infiltrator exposed.

name: It's Only a Game
text: Seeds or plays on table. Limits each non-Borg report with crew action to four total personnel/equipment. Limits {Red Alert} to one Personnel, one Ship and one Equipment card per turn. Limits probing and doubling for {Visit Cochrane Memorial} to once per game per persona. Also, whenever opponent draws three or more cards in one turn, you may download (even from discard pile) {Scorched Hand}, ignoring {Computer Crash}.

name: I've Been Waiting for You
text: Once every turn, plays to exchange your unique [Holo] personnel in play with a [Holo] personnel from your hand.
lore: Upon learning of Quark's plan to feature her in a lascivious holoscenario, Kira Nerys enlisted Odo's help in making a small change to the program. The client got far more than he paid for.

name: Ixtana'Rax
text: OFFICER Leadership Navigation Stellar Cartography Other [GQ] Jem'Hadar present are attributes all +1.
lore: Jem'Hadar Honored Elder. Became Second under Kudak'Etan when the alpha was promoted above him. Unsure about the new order of things.

name: J. T. Esteban
text: OFFICER Geology Exobiology Astrophysics
lore: Captain of the U.S.S. Grissom. Has served as such for over four years without serious incident, due largely to his cautious, "by the book" command style.

name: Jabin
text: OFFICER Leadership Astrophysics Geology Treachery Greed
lore: First maje of the Kazon-Ogla in 2371. Has laid claim to the Ocampa planet. His efforts to tap its subterranean resources have been thwarted by the Caretaker.

name: Jack Crusher
text: OFFICER Honor Archaeology Music Leadership Computer Skill
lore: Lt. Commander aboard U.S.S. Stargazer under best friend Jean-Luc Picard. Husband of Beverly Crusher. Advised their son Wesley to seek his own way.

name: Jadzia Dax
text: SCIENCE Archaeology Astrophysics Exobiology Navigation x 2 Anthropology
lore: Lt. Commander Jadzia Dax is the eighth Trill host of the Dax symbiont. Underwent zhian'tara closure rite in 2371. Level 3 pilot. Married to Worf. Likes tongo.

name: Jadzia Dax (Blaze of Glory)
text: SCIENCE ENGINEER Diplomacy Anthropology Honor Other (R> personnel present are attributes all +2.
lore: Trill. Disregarded her commitments to both Starfleet and Trill custom in order to honor a Klingon blood oath sworn by her symbiont's previous host, Curzon Dax.

name: Jake and Nog
text: CIVILIAN+CIVILIAN Jake: Youth Biology ENGINEER Nog: Youth Acquisition ENGINEER
lore: Jake Sisko and Nog are best friends. Loiterers. Frequently chased away from "their spot" by Odo. Briefly owned 100 gross of self-sealing stem bolts.

name: Jake Sisko
text: CIVILIAN Once each turn, if {any PADD} present, may peek at top card of any deck OR file a mission report at any site. Youth Biology DL/ {File Mission Report}
lore: Federation News Service correspondent - and spy - during the Dominion War. Has his sources.

name: Jamaharon
text: Nullifies {Horga'hn} OR nullifies {Parallel Romance} OR if planet {Risa} is on spaceline, immediately move any one male personnel alone on a planet to Risa.
lore: A mysterious sexual ritual from Risa. One signifies desire for Jamaharon by displaying a Horga'hn, as Jean-Luc Picard did accidentally in 2366, thereby attracting Joval.

name: James T. Kirk
text: OFFICER Leadership x 2 Diplomacy Computer Skill Honor DL/ Any Captain's Order card Scores 5 points each time he helps solve a mission.
lore: Famous captain thought lost in 2293. Returned from the Nexus 78 years later to make a difference once more.

name: James Tiberius Kirk
text: OFFICER Leadership x 2 Treachery x 2 Archaeology DL/ {Tantalus Field} DL/ {Classic Communicator}
lore: The ruthless Captain Kirk took command of the I.S.S. Enterprise by assassinating Captain Pike. Uses the deadly Tantalus Field to maintain his control.

name: Jaresh-Inyo
text: V.I.P. Diplomacy Biology Law DL/ {HQ: Secure Homeworld}
lore: Male Grazerite. President of the United Federation of Planets. Reluctantly imposed martial law on Earth in 2372 at the urging of Admiral Leyton.

name: Jaro Essa
keywords: Bajoran; Male; Minister; The Circle-related personnel;
text: V.I.P. Diplomacy Leadership Greed Treachery x 2 CUNNING +3 if with {Vedek Winn}.
lore: Ambitious member of Chamber of Ministers. Leader of Alliance for Global Unity, a.k.a. the Circle. Minister Jaro was allied with Vedek Winn until exposed as a traitor.

name: Ja'rod
text: V.I.P. Treachery x 2 Leadership ENGINEER Computer Skill Attributes all +5 if with {Toral}.
lore: Father of Duras, Lursa and B'Etor. Disappeared shortly after transmitting security codes to the Romulans, precipitating the Khitomer massacre.

name: Jealous Amanda
text: Plays on table. The next time any Away Team encounters a {Love Interest}, {Parallel Romance} or {Alien Groupie}, your opponent may override that card's normal result by relocating the affected personnel to any planet location. Discard event. (Not duplicatable.)
lore: Do you love me?

name: Jean-Luc and Beverly
text: OFFICER+MEDICAL Jean-Luc: Diplomacy Archaeology Honor Beverly: MEDICAL Exobiology DL/ {Hypospray}
lore: Escaping from their captors on Kesprytt III, Jean-Luc Picard and Beverly Crusher discovered they had been telepathically linked by psi-wave implants.

name: Jean-Luc Picard (First Contact)
text: OFFICER Leadership Navigation Diplomacy Archaeology DL/ {Sense the Borg} DL/ {Make It So}
lore: Captain of the U.S.S. Enterprise-E. Once assimilated by the Borg. Became obsessed with their destruction. Still hears echoes of the collective.

name: Jem'Hadar Birthing Chamber
text: Where present, each of your Jem'Hadar Birthing Chambers allows you to report one [Univ] {Young Jem'Hadar} (for free) each turn, regardless of quadrant.
lore: Incubation module used to breed Jem'Hadar warriors. Each infant grows at a greatly accelerated rate, and is able to fight within days of emergence.

name: Jem'Hadar Disruptor
text: Dominion and Non-Aligned use only. Each of your personnel present is STRENGTH +2. (Cumulative.)
lore: Standard-issue Jem'Hadar sidearm. Energy from a tritium microfusion reaction is accumulated in a phased polaron source, then pulse-discharged through a parabolic arkenium emitter.

name: Jem'Hadar Disruptor Rifle
text: Dominion and Non-Aligned use only. Each of your personnel present is STRENGTH +3, but loses 1 Diplomacy unless aboard your ship. (Cumulative.)
lore: Jem'Hadar weapons have nonvariable energy settings, but their polaron beams can be enhanced with chemicals such as anticoagulants, nerve agents and osteosolvents.

name: Jem'Hadar Sacrifice
text: Plays on your [KW] personnel. He sacrifices (dies) to keep all your {Ketracel-White} present from counting down this turn OR to substitute for a Founder present who is about to die.
lore: Injured by phaser fire, Meso'Clan could no longer contribute to his unit. He requested that he be put to death rather than continue to consume ketracel-white.

name: Jem'Hadar Shrouding
text: Seeds or plays on table. During your turn, you may place here one or two Jem'Hadar from hand or in play, then draw a card. (These Jem'Hadar are not in play.) OR Plays once every turn (for free) on an opponent's Away Team (unless it is on a homeworld). Initiate battle against that Away Team by playing up to an equal number of personnel to it from your Jem'Hadar Shrouding on table. Discard incident.

name: Jenice Manheim
text: CIVILIAN {Ressikan Flute} is limited to 4 Music personnel. One male present is attributes +2 (+4 if {Paul Manheim}).
lore: Dedicated wife of Paul Manheim. Once romantically involved with Jean-Luc Picard.

name: Jeremy Lucas
text: MEDICAL MEDICAL Exobiology Honor DL/ Any MEDICAL-related Equipment card
lore: Chairman of research at Cold Station 12. Close friend of Phlox. His optimism sometimes leads him to jump to dangerous conclusions.

name: Joachim
keywords: Human; Augment; Khan-related card; Khan-related personnel; Male;
text: CIVILIAN SECURITY Astrophysics Navigation Physics Treachery If on {U.S.S. Reliant}, it is WEAPONS +3.
lore: Khan's lieutenant and most trusted friend. Augment who acted as first officer on the U.S.S. Reliant when, after nearly two decades, they escaped Ceti Alpha V.

name: Jodmos
text: OFFICER ENGINEER Navigation Honor May stun adversary without Honor he just engaged.
lore: The human Benjamin Sisko assumed the identity of Jodmos, son of Kobor, to help rid the Klingon Empire of a suspected changeling at Ty'Gokor.

name: John Doe
text: CIVILIAN Once per turn, may prevent one other personnel from being killed on a ship where present.
lore: A Zalkonian male with amnesia and the ability to heal by touch alone. Romantically involved with Dr. Crusher. Later evolved into a pure energy being.

name: John Harriman
text: OFFICER SECURITY Diplomacy Geology Honor
lore: Son of a respected Federation official. Captain of U.S.S. Enterprise-B. Usually confident in dealing with reporters, but on the ship's maiden voyage was having an off day.

name: John Watson
text: MEDICAL If with {Sherlock Holmes}, you may discard your hand at start of turn. ENGINEER Physics
lore: London physician and companion of Sherlock Holmes. Recounted a full five dozen of the sleuth's cases. On the holodeck, Geordi La Forge was Data's Watson.

name: Jonathan Archer
text: OFFICER Honor Diplomacy Navigation Leadership x 2 Anthropology DL/ {Porthos} DL/ {Captain's Log}
lore: Captain of Enterprise, NX-01. Leaped into deep space to make the future quantifiably better for all mankind.

name: J'Onn
text: CIVILIAN SECURITY While with your {Sybok}, you may play {Release This Pain} (for free) one additional time each turn.
lore: Humanoid settler of Nimbus III. Released the pain of his impoverishment when Sybok enlisted his help in the search for the knowledge sought by all since time began.

name: Jorik
text: MEDICAL Exobiology Biology Computer Skill x 2 Treachery
lore: Medic who built neural interfaces to subdue the Voyager crew. Patched them up after hunters stabbed, shot, beat, phasered, and bat'lethed them in Karr's holoscenarios.

name: Jovis
text: Once per game, you may capture an android on an undocked ship here. DL/ {Kivas Fajo}
lore: Zibalian transport and merchant vessel commanded by Kivas Fajo. Houses his collection of rare and one-of-a-kind objects. Used to imprison Data in 2366.

name: Julian Bashir
keywords: Human; Deep Space 9-related personnel; genetically enhanced; Male;
text: MEDICAL MEDICAL x 2 Exobiology Biology DL/ {Kukalaka}
lore: Lt. Julian Bashir. Genetically enhanced. Salutatorian at Starfleet Medical. Requested assignment to DS9 so he could practice "frontier medicine." Likes tennis.

name: Juliana Tainer
text: SCIENCE Geology, Computer Skill, Cybernetics, Music After first use as an android, X=4 but "stopped."
lore: Dr. Juliana O'Donnell Soong Tainer. Data's co-creator and "mother." Unaware that Dr. Soong stored her mind in a Soong-type android to prolong her life.

name: Kahlest
text: CIVILIAN MEDICAL Honor Music Klingons with Honor are STRENGTH +2 where present.
lore: Female ghojmok to young Worf in the employ of the House of Mogh prior to the Khitomer Massacre. Spurned K'mpec because "he was too fat."

name: Kai Opaka
text: V.I.P. Leadership x 3 Diplomacy Honor Anthropology Orb artifacts may not be nullified.
lore: Revered Kai of Bajor. Lost her son in the Kendra Valley Massacre. First recognized Benjamin Sisko as the Emissary of the Prophets.

name: Kai Winn
text: V.I.P. Leadership x 2 Diplomacy Treachery Honor (if {The Emissary} in play). DL/ Any Bajoran treaty
lore: Vedek Winn became Kai of Bajor in 2370. Concluded Cardassian treaty negotiations by Bareil Antos. Finally accepted Benjamin Sisko's role as the Emissary.

name: Kalenna
text: SECURITY Anthropology Biology Honor
lore: Female Romulan. Member of task force sent to destroy the Founders. Helped Julian Bashir, Worf, and Elim Garak escape from Internment Camp 371.

name: Kal-Toh
text: Plays on table. Once each turn, unless {Alien Probe} in play, you may discard one card from hand; opponent must discard one of same type (if they cannot, discard Kal-Toh).
lore: Vulcan game of intricate strategy. Players must find the seeds of order, even in the midst of profound chaos. Tuvok observed that novices often try merely to introduce a spatial balance.

name: Kamarag
text: V.I.P. Diplomacy Law Archaeology
lore: Ambassador to the Federation. Believed Admiral Kirk wanted Project Genesis as a weapon against Qo'noS. Predicted there would be no peace while Kirk lived.

name: Kang
text: OFFICER Leadership Honor SECURITY Physics DL/ {Blood Oath}
lore: Faced Kirk at Beta XII-A. Swore blood oath against the Albino with Kor, Koloth, and Curzon Dax to avenge the death of his firstborn son.

name: Karden
text: OFFICER Youth Navigation x 2 Physics Anthropology Biology Honor
lore: Young Kazon-Ogla now come of age. Bravely earned his name like his brother, Kinell, before him. The only Kazon to ever form a real bond with a "Federation."

name: Kareen Brianon
text: CIVILIAN Computer Skill ENGINEER Youth May nullify {Male's Love Interest} where present.
lore: Technical assistant to Dr. Ira Graves. Admitted to having been attracted to him, despite decades of age difference.

name: Karina
text: V.I.P. Treachery Transporter Skill SCIENCE
lore: Female Romulan "delegate" and saboteur. Assistant to Ruwon. Planned to help him sabotage the Bajoran wormhole and Deep Space 9.

name: Karon
text: OFFICER Leadership Treachery Anthropology x 2 Navigation Exobiology DL/ {Hirogen Disruptor Rifle}
lore: Diligent Alpha-Hirogen. Commanded a Hunting Vessel that stalked a member of Species 8472. Has an unrivaled understanding of the behavior of prey.

name: Karr
text: OFFICER Leadership x 2 Diplomacy Honor Law Computer Skill Anthropology Astrophysics
lore: Alpha-Hirogen who captured Voyager in 2374. Used its holodecks to study his prey's history. Hoped for lessons to save his own culture from stagnation and extinction.

name: Kar'takin
text: Each of your Jem'Hadar, Breen and Dosi present is STRENGTH +2, and in each battle one of them may mortally wound one adversary they just stunned. (Cumulative.)
lore: Blade weapon used by the Jem'Hadar and Dominion allies. Similar to the Klingon bat'leth in function and effectiveness.

name: Kasidy Yates
text: CIVILIAN Navigation x 2 Smuggling Transporter Skill May add 2 card draws to "{cargo runs}" she completes.
lore: Freighter captain for Bajoran Ministry of Commerce. Smuggled weapons for the Maquis in 2372. Loves baseball. Romantically involved with Benjamin Sisko.

name: Katherine Pulaski
text: MEDICAL MEDICAL SCIENCE Suspends effects of {Doppelganger} where present.
lore: Chief Medical Officer of the U.S.S. Enterprise in 2365. Dislikes transporters and turbolifts.

name: Kathleen Tonell
text: CIVILIAN Anthropology
lore: Inspired in 2063 with a new view of humanity's place in the cosmos, her work helped end post-atomic horror and led to world government in 2113.

name: Kathryn Janeway
text: OFFICER SCIENCE Diplomacy Leadership Computer Skill Physics Astrophysics
lore: Former science officer of U.S.S. Al-Batani. Dog lover. Inspired by Amelia Earhart, Leonardo da Vinci, and her father. Has promised herself to get her crew home.

name: Kavok
keywords: Klingon; Captain; Male; U.S.S. Enterprise-related personnel;
text: OFFICER Computer Skill Treachery DL/ {Commandeer Ship} Physics May report directly to any empty [Fed] ship.
lore: Commanded U.S.S. Enterprise after hijacking it from Starbase 74. Intended to start a war with the Federation and die in glorious battle. Once captained I.K.C. Buruk.

name: Kazago
text: OFFICER Leadership ENGINEER Honor
lore: First officer. Shocked by DaiMon Bok's free gift of the derelict U.S.S. Stargazer to the human Picard. Placed Bok under arrest for using an illegal thought maker.

name: Kazon Bomb
text: Unless 3 SECURITY and CUNNING>35 OR 2 SECURITY and {any tricorder} OR 3 [Def] Borg present, kills all personnel present who have printed STRENGTH<7. Discard dilemma.
lore: Tierna's "rescue" by the Voyager crew was part of an elaborate ruse. The Kazon was on a suicide mission, carrying a chemical injection that would convert is blood into a powerful explosive.

name: Kazon Conference
text: OFFICER x3 + SECURITY + Diplomacy * +5 for each different Maje present.
lore: Attend meeting of rival Kazon sects.

name: Kazon Disruptor
text: Kazon use only. Reports for free (once each turn). Each of your personnel present is STRENGTH +2. (Cumulative.)
lore: Typical sidearm employed by the various Kazon sects. Simple design is slightly less powerful than comparable Starfleet arms, but it easily mass-produced even without replicator technology.

name: Kazon Disruptor Rifle
text: Kazon use only. Reports for free (once each turn). Each of your personnel present is STRENGTH +3, but loses 1 Diplomacy unless aboard your ship. (Cumulative.)
lore: Relatively unsophisticated beam weapon used by the Kazon. No-frills design abandons aesthetic features in favor of inexpensive production. As deadly as it is ugly.

name: Keevan
text: V.I.P. Treachery x 2 Anthropology Diplomacy Geology DL/ {Hostage Trade}
lore: Devious, aloof Vorta. Extorted a Federation Away Team into destroying his marooned, white-starved Jem'Hadar unit before it could turn on him. Hates Ferengi.

name: Keiko O'Brien
text: SCIENCE Exobiology Biology Attributes all +2 if with {Miles O'Brien}.
lore: Botanist. Vegetarian. Keiko Ishikawa married Miles O'Brien aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise in 2367. Lt. Commander Data served as father of the bride.

name: Kejal
text: ENGINEER Computer Skill Transporter Skill Honor DL/ {Holo-projectors}
lore: Cardassian hologram created by the Hirogen. Self-taught engineer of advanced skill. Her name, the Bajoran word for "freedom," was given to her by Iden.

name: Kejal*
text: ENGINEER Computer Skill Transporter Skill Honor DL/ {Holo-projectors}
lore: Cardassian hologram created by the Hirogen. Self-taught engineer of advanced skill. Her name, the Bajoran word for "freedom," was given to her by Iden.

name: Kelvan Show of Force
text: To get past, two non-android, non-holographic personnel present are selected (opponent's choice). One of those two is "crushed" (killed, random selection).
lore: Aliens from the Andromeda Galaxy demonstrated their power to Captain Kirk by distilling two crew members to their chemical components. Crushing a container instantly killed the victim.

name: Keogh
text: OFFICER Leadership Honor Physics Geology DL/ {Attack Pattern Delta}
lore: Captain of the U.S.S. Odyssey. In 2370, ordered to investigate the Jem'Hadar threat and rescue Benjamin Sisko. Knew Jadzia Dax, but not on friendly terms.

name: Keras
text: OFFICER Leadership x 2 Astrophysics Geology Honor DL/ {Engage Cloak} DL/ {Auto-Destruct Sequence}
lore: Expert strategist. Followed orders despite misgivings about provoking another war with the Federation. In a different reality, he could have called Kirk friend.

name: Kes
text: CIVILIAN MEDICAL Exobiology Biology Empathy DL/ {The Gift} OR {Beyond the Subatomic}
lore: Four-year-old Ocampa. Mentored by The Doctor and Tuvok. Has begun to tap latent abilities few others of her species have. Was romantically involved with Neelix.

name: Kes (The Borg)
text: CIVILIAN Empathy x 2 Physics Navigation Treachery MEDICAL May not be stunned.
lore: In 2376, a vengeful Kes returned to Voyager, an outcast with powers far beyond any other Ocampa. Angry with Janeway, who encouraged her to unlock these abilities.

name: Kes*
text: CIVILIAN MEDICAL Exobiology Biology Empathy DL/ {The Gift} OR {Beyond the Subatomic}
lore: Four-year-old Ocampa. Mentored by The Doctor and Tuvok. Has begun to tap latent abilities few others of her species have. Was romantically involved with Neelix.

name: Ketracel-White
text: Where present, prevents "white deprivation." Counts down only if you have [KW] personnel present. (Your Vorta may "ration" just one Ketracel-White present to count down.)
lore: Isogenic enzyme controlled by the Vorta. Genetically addicted Jem'Hadar need a constant supply of "the white" to stay alive. Withdrawal prevents shrouding and leads to killing rampages.

name: Kevin Uxbridge: Convergence
text: Nullifies all [Event] (except [Shield]) in play at any one spaceline location.
lore: A Douwd, a race of sentient energy beings of "disguises and false surroundings." He is capable of using his enormous powers to stop threats with a single thought.

name: Khan
text: V.I.P. [Fed] opponents need {any Kirk} present to solve mission here. Leadership Treachery x 2 Computer Skill
lore: Genetically engineered augment exiled to Ceti Alpha V by Admiral Kirk. Seeks to avenge his wife's death.

name: Kidnappers
text: Place on a female present (random selection). Until end of opponent's turn, she is "stopped" and may be captured by opponent's SECURITY present; then discard dilemma.
lore: While visiting Bajor, Kira Nerys was captured by the Alliance for Global Unity, also known as the Circle. The Alliance sought to overthrow the Bajoran provisional government.

name: Kilana
text: V.I.P. Diplomacy Leadership Treachery SCIENCE Archaeology
lore: Female Vorta field operative. Dispatched to rescue an injured Founder shipwrecked on Torga IV. Distrusted Benjamin Sisko long enough to fail her mission.

name: Kira
text: OFFICER Leadership Resistance SECURITY Navigation Honor x 2 X=3 vs. [Dom].
lore: Ironically, Kira Nerys trained Legate Damar's freedom fighters in Resistance tactics. The Bajoran accepted a Starfleet commission to help ease the racial tensions.

name: Kira Founder
text: OFFICER Leadership Resistance SECURITY Navigation Computer Skill Treachery
lore: Changeling who, under the guise of Kira Nerys, attempted to understand Odo's loyalty to the solids. Discovered he had feelings for Kira.

name: Kira Nerys
keywords: Bajoran; Deep Space 9-related personnel; Female; Shakaar Resistance Cell;
text: OFFICER Leadership Resistance SECURITY Navigation x 2 Computer Skill X=3 vs. [Car].
lore: Outspoken Major in Bajoran Militia. Assigned as first officer of Deep Space 9. Former member of Shakaar resistance cell. Romantically involved with Odo.

name: Kitrik
text: MEDICAL Exobiology SCIENCE Cybernetics Music
lore: A Klingon physician. Has a research laboratory and clinic at the Klingon outpost on Maranga IV. Plays the part of "Molor" in the annual Kot'baval Festival.

name: Kivas Fajo
text: CIVILIAN Greed x 2 Acquisition Treachery Each unduplicated artifact present is worth 5 points. Makes parallel use of opponent's {Palor Toff} cards.
lore: Unscrupulous, murderous, conceited Zibalian trader. Collector. Notorious member of Stacius Trade Guild.

name: Klaa
text: OFFICER Leadership Anthropology Biology Greed Treachery
lore: Aggressive captain. He hunted the U.S.S. Enterprise-A without authorization in 2287. Later demoted and assigned menial translation duties on Qo'noS.

name: Klaestron Outpost
text: Seed one OR build where you have a Klaestron ENGINEER.
lore: Klaestron IV is a member of the United Federation of Planets. Its inhabitants also maintain a strong alliance with the Cardassian Union.

name: Klim Dokachin
text: Plays on table. Opponent loses their normal card draw if they played a unique personnel this turn.
lore: Zakdorn quartermaster controlling the Starfleet surplus depot at Qualor II. A typical bureaucrat of the type that delights in delays that make life difficult for officers.

name: Klingon Civil War
text: Plays on table. While in play, when a Klingon ship destroys any opponent's Klingon ship, winner scores points = loser's WEAPONS + SHIELDS. (Immune to {Kevin Uxbridge}.)
lore: Powerful political "houses" in Klingon society can form factions that vie for control. Gowron and his supporters defeated the forces of Duras in the civil war of 2367-68.

name: Klingon Disruptor Rifle
text: Klingon and Non-Aligned use only. Each of your personnel present is STRENGTH +3, but loses 1 Diplomacy unless aboard your ship. (Cumulative.)
lore: Standard phase disruptor fitted with attachable shoulder stock. Rifle components include extended-charge capacitance cell, high-energy augmented accelerator and requisite induction coil.

name: Klingon Painstik
text: Return your {Arbiter of Succession} to your hand at any time, nullifying its points. OR One unique personnel just killed may not be reported for duty again by any player.
lore: Device employed to verify death in the Sonchi ritual. Also used in the nentay (Rite of Ascension) to test courage. Can make a two-ton Rectyne monopod jump 5 meters.

name: K'mtar
text: V.I.P. Diplomacy Leadership Honor Attributes all +5 if with {Alexander Rozhenko}.
lore: Worf's son Alexander returned from 40 years in the future to influence his younger self to embrace the way of the warrior and avoid life as a peacemaker.

name: K'nera
text: OFFICER SECURITY Transporter Skill Honor Scores 5 points when {Korris} or {Konmel} killed in battle.
lore: Pursued the criminals Korris and Konmel in 2364 until their deaths on the U.S.S. Enterprise. Offered Worf a position in the Klingon Defense Force.

name: Kobayashi Maru Scenario
text: Seeds or plays on a mission; adds Computer Skill to mission requirements. At the start of each mission attempt here, one attempting personnel (random selection) is placed beneath this incident ("in play" for uniqueness only). When a player solves this mission, all of their compatible personnel beneath this incident join the solving crew or Away Team (any other personnel are discarded). (Unique.)

name: Kohlar
text: OFFICER Diplomacy Honor Anthropology Leadership Stellar Cartography DL/ {Auto-Destruct Sequence}
lore: Captain of I.K.C. Voq'leng. Seized a chance to end his crew's long journey of hardship and isolation, casting the unborn child of B'Elanna Torres as the Kuvah'Magh.

name: Kol
text: SCIENCE Navigation Treachery Greed Computer Skill Stellar Cartography
lore: Piloted a shuttle sent into the Barzan wormhole by Goss in 2366. After posing as the Takarians' "Lesser Sage," returned to the Alpha Quadrant via the same wormhole.

name: Koloth
text: V.I.P. Diplomacy x 2 Exobiology Honor Klingon Intelligence DL/ {Bat'leth}
lore: Called d'akturak, "ice man", by Curzon Dax due to his negotiating prowess. Commanded the I.K.C. Gr'oth during the Sherman's Planet sabotage mission in 2267.

name: Komar Possession
text: Place on one personnel present (random selection). Now and start of each turn, "stops" that personnel and one other personnel present (random selection). Cure with 3 SECURITY.
lore: Tuvok was possessed by trianic energy beings known as the Komar. The entities sought to collect neural energy from the U.S.S. Voyager crew members.

name: Kor
text: V.I.P. Leadership x 2 Anthropology Honor Music Other Klingons present are each STRENGTH +2.
lore: Dahar master. Legendary warrior. Former ambassador to Vulcan. Victorious at Klach D'Kel Brakt. Swore blood oath against the Albino. Sought the Sword of Kahless.

name: Korax
text: OFFICER ENGINEER Physics Exobiology
lore: First officer of the I.K.C. Gr'oth under Captain Koloth. Klingon expert on Regulan blood worms and Denebian slime devils. Outspoken critic of Captain Kirk.

name: Korinas
text: OFFICER SECURITY Leadership Treachery Obsidian Order
lore: High-ranking female intelligence operative. Often assigned by the Obsidian Order to keep a close watch on the Central Command.

name: Koth
text: SECURITY Exobiology Geology Treachery DL/ {Forced-Labor Camp} (your [Kli] may attempt.)
lore: Warden of the penal asteroid Rura Penthe. His greatest pleasures are watching fights among his inmates and delivering his welcoming speech to new prisoners.

name: Kotran Pa'Dar
text: V.I.P. Diplomacy Leadership Geology
lore: Powerful civilian leader. Former exarch of Cardassian settlement on Bajor. Believed his son Rugal was killed in 2362 terrorist attack.

name: Kova Tholl
text: CIVILIAN Scores bonus points if killed by an attack in which you do not retaliate. Diplomacy
lore: A male from Mizar II. Mizarians value peace above all else and employ passive resistance. They have been conquered six times in 300 years.

name: Koval
text: V.I.P. SECURITY Treachery Tal Shiar x2 (when [Rom]). Exobiology Your Tal Shiar may report here.
lore: Chairman of the Tal Shiar. Seeks appointment to the Continuing Committee. Suffers from Tuvan Syndrome. Conspired with Sloan to bring down Senator Cretak.

name: Kovat
text: CIVILIAN Honor Diplomacy Law Anthropology
lore: One of the finest public conservators on Cardassia. Assigned to defend Miles O'Brien. Deeply disturbed when he "won" the case and O'Brien was freed.

name: Krajensky Founder
keywords: Changeling; Ambassador; Founder; Infiltrator; Male; Shape-shifter;
text: V.I.P. Diplomacy Law Leadership ENGINEER Treachery DL/ {Issue Secret Orders}
lore: The changeling appearing as Ambassador Krajensky seized the U.S.S. Defiant in an effort to start a war between the Federation and the Tzenkethi.

name: Kras
text: OFFICER Acquisition Geology Treachery Navigation
lore: Klingon who tried to acquire topaline mining rights on Capella IV. Interfered in Capellan politics by supporting Maab's attempt to overthrow Teer Akaar.

name: Krase
text: OFFICER Stellar Cartography Astrophysics MEDICAL Your [Kli] [Films] ships here are each SHIELDS +2.
lore: Captain of the I.K.S. Amar. His tendency to rash behavior has earned him a ruthless reputation even by Klingon standards.

name: Krax
text: V.I.P. Youth Greed MEDICAL May serve as Nagus (if you have no Nagus in play).
lore: Son of Grand Nagus Zek. Missed his chance to show his father he could be a good nagus when he tried to seize power quickly, rather than accumulate it quietly.

name: Kraxon
text: WEAPONS +3 and SHIELDS +2 vs. Defiant-class ships. Tractor Beam
lore: Cardassian warship sent to intercept the U.S.S. Defiant and the renegade Thomas Riker in 2371.

name: Krayton
keywords: D'Kora-Class; Ferengi ship; Holodeck; Tractor Beam;
text: Holodeck, Tractor Beam
lore: Marauder commanded by Tog. Briefly imprisoned Lwaxana Troi, whom Tog had abducted from Betazed following the 2366 Trade Agreements Conference.

name: Kreechta
keywords: D'Kora-Class; Ferengi ship; Holodeck; Tractor Beam;
text: Holodeck, Tractor Beam
lore: Ferengi marauder. Under the command of Bractor in 2365, interrupted a mysterious battle between the Federation starships Enterprise and Hathaway.

name: Kressari Rendezvous
text: OFFICER + (Treachery x2 OR Smuggling) * Discard up to four hand weapons for +5 each.
lore: Complete covert weapons transfer to agents supplying the Circle.

name: Kronos One
keywords: Cloaking Device; Klingon ship; Tractor Beam;
text: Cloaking Device, Tractor Beam DL/ {Any [Kli] [Films] personnel}
lore: Battle cruiser of the Klingon Chancellor in the late 23rd century. Under command of Chancellor Gorkon, had a fateful rendezvous with the U.S.S. Enterprise-A.

name: Kruge
text: OFFICER Leadership Treachery Biology Physics Worth 15 points while {The Genesis Device} on his ship.
lore: Klingon commander with a festering hatred of the Federation. Attempted to seize the secret of the Genesis weapon - the secret of ultimate power.

name: K'Temoc
text: OFFICER Astrophysics Transporter Skill Geology DL/ {Engage Cloak}
lore: Captain of the sleeper ship I.K.S. T'Ong, on a crucial mission ordered by the High Command in the late 23rd century. Awoke 75 years later in a much-changed galaxy.

name: Kudak'Etan
text: OFFICER Leadership Navigation Anthropology ENGINEER DL/ {Commandeer Ship} OR {Victory Is Life}
lore: Arrogant First under Gelnon. Commanded the captured U.S.S. Defiant in 2374. One of the first Jem'Hadar bred in the Alpha Quadrant. Ignored his Second's advice.

name: Kukalaka
text: Your non-Borg personnel present are each INTEGRITY +2, or +3 if {Leeta} present. Also, each player is limited to one {Brain Drain} OR one {Going To The Top} every turn. (Unique.)
lore: Beloved childhood companion (and first surgical patient) of Julian Bashir. Loaned to, and especially treasured by, Leeta. A timeless symbol of innocence and security.

name: Kurros
text: SCIENCE SCIENCE Treachery x 2 Diplomacy Acquisition Leadership
lore: Humanoid leader of the Think Tank, an elite group that solves problems - for a price. Brilliant tactician. Often does the exact opposite of what an adversary expects.

name: La Forge Impersonator
text: ENGINEER Navigation Computer Skill Treachery May report wherever {Taibak} is present, for free.
lore: Surgically altered Romulan. In 2367, posed as Geordi La Forge so Taibak could brainwash the real La Forge without raising suspicions.

name: La Forge Maneuver
text: Plays to expose any one cloaked ship at a planet location. It is vulnerable (as if it were decloaked) if the next action is an attack against that ship.
lore: When attacked by a powerful cloaked drone at Minos, acting-captain Geordi La Forge used atmospheric turbulence to locate and target the hidden enemy.

name: Lack of Preparation
text: Non-Borg: Cannot get past (lose 10 points) unless you could have met mission requirements at start of attempt. Borg: Must have [Com], [Nav] and [Def] personnel to proceed.
lore: An Away Team that is unprepared to complete its mission will undoubtedly experience delays. Mission progress may be impossible until additional personnel arrive.

name: Lack of Preparation (Voyager)
text: Non-Borg: Cannot get past (lose 10 points) unless you could have met mission requirements at start of attempt. Borg: Must have [Com], [Nav], and [Def] personnel to proceed.
lore: Malon legend warns of poisonous monsters, the Vihaar. When aiding a damaged Malon ship in 2375, a U.S.S. Voyager away team discovered the threat they'd dismissed was all too real.

name: Lagren
text: ENGINEER Physics Geology Exobiology
lore: Kazan-Ogla who maintains the settlement on the Ocampa planet. Has searched unsuccessfully for a way to penetrate the Caretaker's subterranean shield.

name: Lakanta
text: CIVILIAN Ship he is on can leave one end of spaceline and enter other end. {Wesley Crusher} attributes +4, if present.
lore: Male of American Indian descent. Actually The Traveler in disguise. Wesley Crusher left Starfleet Academy to study transcendence of thought with him.

name: Lal
text: CIVILIAN Computer Skill Youth When reported, gains two different skills present.
lore: Soong-type android and daughter of Data. Created through replication of Data's positronic pathways. Named for the Hindi word for imzadi or beloved.

name: Lamat'Ukan
text: SECURITY Leadership Computer Skill x 2 Transporter Skill While on your ship, it is WEAPONS +2.
lore: Jem'Hadar Third. Alpha. Realigned targeting sensors on U.S.S. Defiant captured by Dominion forces in 2374. His initiative pleased First Kudak'Etan.

name: Lansor
text: SCIENCE When reported, may download {Marika} and {P'Chan} (if not in play). Physics SECURITY
lore: Humanoid mathematician once assimilated as the Borg, Two of Nine. Still linked with Marika and P'Chan.

name: Latinum Payoff
text: Plays if Greed aboard your ship when it destroys another ship in battle (once per destroyed ship). X=3 for each OFFICER aboard destroyed ship.
lore: Gold-pressed latinum, which cannot be replicated, is a valuable metal used as currency in many less-developed sectors, primarily outside Federation space.

name: Launch Portal
text: Suspends play to do any or all of the following: download {Engage Shuttle Operations} or {Escape Pod}; download (once per game) a scout ship, shuttle or Borg Sphere to your ship with Tractor Beam; and (except during a mission attempt) launch any or all of your carried ships with crew. Discard, or place on Engage Shuttle Operations to protect it from nullification and extend its effects to scout ships.

name: Leck
text: CIVILIAN SECURITY Exobiology Treachery Once per game, may kill any one personnel present.
lore: Professional assassin called an "eliminator." Doesn't crave latinum, but doesn't like being cheated. Brunt called him a psychopath during the 2374 Ishka rescue.

name: Leeta
text: CIVILIAN Anthropology Youth Computer Skill Leadership Music DL/ {Dabo} OR {Kukalaka}
lore: Bajoran dabo girl. Formed the Guild of Restaurant and Casino Employees with Rom. Amateur sociologist. Was formally separated from Julian Bashir on Risa in 2373.

name: Legate Damar
text: V.I.P. Leadership x 2 Computer Skill Honor SECURITY Physics DL/ {For Cardassia!}
lore: Damar became legate in 2374. Weary of Dominion rule, he led the resistance effort to free Cardassia in 2375. Rumored to have secret mountain stronghold.

name: Lemec
text: OFFICER Geology MEDICAL Music Transporter Skill
lore: Gul in command of the Reklar. Clashed with Captain Edward Jellico over troop and ship movements along the Federation-Cardassian border.

name: Lemon-Aid
text: If you are at least 20 points ahead of your opponent, graciously give this card to opponent, who scores bonus points. (May not be nullified.)
lore: Wasn't it your own Hardy that said 'Nothing reveals humanity so well as the games it plays?' ... Actually, you reveal yourself best in how you play.

name: Lenaris Holem
text: OFFICER Honor Leadership Physics Resistance
lore: Colonel. Former member of Ornathia resistance cell. Part of historic Pullock V raid. Grateful to Shakaar for liberating his brother from Gallitep prison camp.

name: Leonardo da Vinci
text: CIVILIAN SCIENCE Astrophysics Biology Geology Physics DL/ {Mona Lisa}
lore: Renaissance man whose accomplishments as a scientist, artist, mathematician, philosopher, astronomer, inventor, anatomist, and geologist dwarfed all his contemporaries.

name: Lethean Telepathic Attack
text: Unless 2 Empathy present, place on one personnel ({Julian Bashir} if present, otherwise random selection). Personnel is disabled (killed if CUNNING+STRENGTH<16).
lore: Altovar tried to steal biomimetic gel from the Deep Space 9 infirmary. When interrupted by Julian Bashir, he assaulted the doctor telepathically. Such attacks are usually fatal.

name: Lewis Zimmerman
text: ENGINEER Your compatible [Holo] cards may report here (for free, once each turn). ENGINEER Computer Skill x 2
lore: Father of modern holography. Designed the E.M.H. series. Was briefly romantically involved with Leeta in 2373. Suffering from acute subcellular degradation.

name: Leyton Founder
keywords: Changeling; Admiral; Founder; Infiltrator; Male; Shape-shifter;
text: V.I.P. Leadership SECURITY Treachery May report on {Earth}. DL/ {Flight of the Intruder}
lore: Dominion changeling appearing as Admiral Leyton. Exposed by Odo outside Starfleet headquarters; escaped using his shape-shifting abilities.

name: Li Nalas
text: V.I.P. OFFICER Resistance Honor Geology May seed under {Cardassia IV}.
lore: Hero of the Bajoran resistance. Cardassian prisoner at Hutet labor camp. Temporary first officer of Deep Space 9. Titled Navarch by provisional government.

name: Liam Bilby
text: CIVILIAN Honor Treachery Geology Leadership Orion Syndicate
lore: Low-ranking Orion Syndicate member. Obeys Raimus, his superior, in order to protect his wife and children. Holds that family is "the most important thing."

name: Liberation
text: SECURITY + (Transporter Skill OR {Neelix}) Ocampa may report on planet (for free).
lore: Liberate prisoner being held by Kazon sect on the surface of this desert planet.

name: Liberty
text: Your [Maq] personnel may report aboard. May be your seed at {Caretaker's Array}.
lore: Maquis ship commanded by Captain Chakotay in 2371. 30-year old vessel - with a 39-year old engine that has been rebuilt and modified many times over.

name: Lightner
text: SECURITY Youth Astrophysics DL/ {Starfleet Type III Phaser Rifle}
lore: Lieutenant (j.g.) Lightner is an expert marksman. Member of the winning team in the 2369 Starfleet Academy Parrises Squares Championship.

name: Lily
text: CIVILIAN If with {Dixon Hill}, once per game may cancel a personnel battle here. ENGINEER Physics
lore: In her time aboard U.S.S. Enterprise-E, Lily Sloane adjusted admirably to rayguns, force fields, bionic zombies, and the holographic world of Dixon Hill.

name: Lily Sloane
text: CIVILIAN ENGINEER Physics DL/ {Auto-Destruct Sequence} If on {Phoenix}, meets two [Stf] staffing requirements.
lore: Structural design engineer of Phoenix. Took first steps into the new frontier. Helped overcome Borg in 2063. Said, "Jean-Luc, blow up the damned ship!"

name: Lineup
text: To get past requires four personnel present (random selection) to "form a lineup." All four are "stopped" unless one has INTEGRITY<5 OR INTEGRITY>8.
lore: After a bar fight with Klingons on Station K-7, Captain Kirk ordered a lineup. No crewman claimed responsibility for starting the brawl, but none pointed the finger at Mr. Scott, either.

name: Linguistic Legerdemain
text: Unless Anthropology and Exobiology present, X=1+number of affiliation icons on this mission with no matching personnel present; place on mission; it cannot be attempted.
lore: We must respond personally. The universal translator would be recognized.

name: Lisa Azar
text: OFFICER Diplomacy Greed
lore: Ex-wife of a coalition arms merchant on Turkana IV. Misses her old lifestyle, but likes the opportunities offered by the Federation.

name: Li'seria
text: Son'a shuttlecraft may report, be carried, and launch aboard. Tractor Beam
lore: Flagship of the small Son'a fleet and base of operations for the entire race. Commanded by Ru'afo.

name: Live Long and Prosper
text: Saves any Vulcan who was just randomly selected to die. OR Once per turn, returns an opponent's personnel who just died to opponent's hand; draw one card for each of its [*] icons.
lore: Traditional Vulcan greeting and farewell gesture. Originated by Surak, the father of Vulcan philosophy, who led Vulcan into its era of peace some 2,000 years ago.

name: Lockbox
text: Unless Greed present, Away Team "stopped" (discard dilemma). Otherwise, score points if you solve mission this turn.
lore: Quark's greed led him to critical evidence in a lockbox which ultimately solved a five-year-old murder case.

name: Locutus' Borg Cube
text: WEAPONS and SHIELDS +3 at {Wolf 359}. Your equipment and Borg personnel may report aboard. Tractor Beam
lore: Identification: BORG CUBE Task: Eliminate resistance at location designation Wolf 359. Locutus of Borg commands.

name: Locutus of Borg
text: OFFICER Diplomacy x 2 Leadership Honor Navigation Archaeology Music While on your ship, WEAPONS and SHIELDS +4 against [Fed].
lore: Assimilated counterpart who spoke to the Federation. "The knowledge and experience of the human - Jean-Luc Picard - is part of us now."

name: Lon Suder
text: ENGINEER Physics Biology Treachery Honor May initiate personnel battle, against any affiliation.
lore: Dangerous, violent Betazoid. Unable to sense even his own emotions. Murdered Crewman Darwin. Sought to atone after a mindmeld with Tuvok. Skilled floriculturist.

name: Lon Suder*
text: ENGINEER Physics Biology Treachery Honor May initiate personnel battle, against any affiliation.
lore: Dangerous, violent Betazoid. Unable to sense even his own emotions. Murdered Crewman Darwin. Sought to atone after a mindmeld with Tuvok. Skilled floriculturist.

name: Long Live the Queen
text: Seeds or plays on table. Reveal (then discard) incident to do one of the following: If your {Borg Queen} was just killed, download another Borg Queen. OR Prevent your Borg Queen present with your [Def] drone from being captured (drone is captured instead). OR Suspend any {Regenerate} while you place out-of-play from targeted discard pile up to six cards without a [BO] or [Bor] icon.

name: Lonzak
keywords: Hologram; Bodyguard; Capturing-related card; Chaotica-related card; Inorganic; Male;
text: SECURITY Worth 5 points for each female captive present (double if {Chaotica} also present). Law
lore: Inferior serving as bodyguard to Chaotica. Enforces his liege's rule, imprisoning infidels in the Dungeon of Pain or Mines of Mercury. Often seizes Constance Goodheart.

name: Loran
text: OFFICER Leadership MEDICAL Physics Archaeology
lore: First maje of the Kazon-Hobii. Has twice attended meetings with rivals in the hopes of ending skirmishes his small sect lacks the reserves to defend against.

name: Lore
text: CIVILIAN ENGINEER Computer Skill Treachery x 2 SECURITY Transporter Skill Leadership Doubles {Crystalline Entity}. DL/ {Crosis}
lore: Evil Soong-type android. Data's "elder brother."

name: Lovok
