text: Plays on table; download {Treaty: Cardassian/Dominion}. Nullifies your {Dominion War Efforts}. Once each turn, one [DS9][Dom] OR [DS9][Car] personnel with four or fewer [*] (and no DL/ ) may report for free, then you may draw a card. Discard if you have played a personnel not native to the Alpha Quadrant OR a [Car] Honor personnel.

name: Distorted Reflection
text: When your [Car] personnel with "resistance" in lore helps solve a Cardassian Region mission, you may score points OR opponent must discard 3 cards.
lore: After years as a puppet of the Dominion, Damar could no longer recognize the man he had become, and decided to rise up and reassert Cardassian autonomy.

name: I Want the Cardassians Exterminated!
text: Kill three of your non-[Holo][Car] personnel (X = their total [*]) present with your Founder to peek at the bottom seed card there (once per unattempted mission) and score points.
lore: Tired of the uprisings, disloyalty, and betrayal, the Founder Leader ordered the execution of the Cardassians. All of them.

name: Secret Sabotage
text: Plays once each turn, at the end of your turn, on an opponent's undamaged ship. If you have 3 [Car] personnel with "resistance" in lore here, you may [Flip][Flip].
lore: To defeat the occupying Dominion forces, Damar and his compatriots adopted guerrilla warfare techniques, taught to them by Kira Nerys from her days in the Bajoran resistance.

name: Battle of Cardassia
text: Leadership x2 + SECURITY x2 + Honor x2 *+20 points if your [Fed] ship, [Rom] ship, and [Kli] ship here. Opponent's side: [car][dom] Leadership x2 + SECURITY x2 + Treachery x2 May only attempt if your total WEAPONS>36 here. Points: [40]
lore: Defeat overwhelming Dominion forces.

name: Increase White Production
text: SCIENCE + Biology + (Son'a OR Vorta OR MEDICAL x3) *+5 points for each Son'a present (limit 3).
lore: Mass-produce ketracel-white to maintain Jem'Hadar soldiers' biochemical balance.

name: Recruit Ally
text: Leadership + Diplomacy x2 + (Breen OR V.I.P.) Once solved, your Breen ships may report with staffing here.
lore: Rendezvous with Breen flagship in Dominion-occupied Cardassian space.

name: Resist Occupying Forces
text: OFFICER x3 + Honor x3 OR {Kira} + {Legate Damar} *+10 if {Cardassian Liberation Front} in play.
lore: Establish covert base and train in guerrilla warfare.

name: Steal Breen Armament
text: Anthropology + Honor + Leadership + (3 SECURITY OR 3 [Car] personnel with "resistance" in lore)
lore: Covertly penetrate facility and retrieve newly installed weapons technology.

name: Decimate Homeworld
text: Plays on a homeworld if you have solved two missions (one [P] and one [S]). Your Breen and Xindi ships may ignore {Strategema} here when initiating battle. If you destroy a headquarters here (or at a corresponding time location) that your opponent seeded or played, you score points, where X = printed SHIELDS of that headquarters.

name: One Big Happy Family
text: Plays on your non-[GQ] mission (limit one per mission). At the start of your first mission attempt here, if you have [Car] and/or [Dom] personnel here from at least four different species, you may draw three cards. Once solved, your [Car] and non-[GQ][Dom] ships with personnel of three different species aboard are attributes all +2, or +4 if in a region with this mission (cumulative).

name: Anjohl and Winn
keywords: Cardassian/Bajoran; Dual Personnel; Female; Kai; Male; Pah-wraith-related card; Vedek;
text: CIVILIAN+V.I.P. Anjohl: Treachery x 2 Anthropology Archaeology Winn: Leadership Treachery Diplomacy
lore: The Cardassian Dukat, anointed by the Pah-wraiths, became romantically involved with former Vedek Winn, now Kai of Bajor. He acted as her guide.

name: Bronok
text: ENGINEER Geology Physics Smuggling
lore: Typical member of Damar's resistance. Dissident who performed many acts of terrorism against the Dominion. One of Rusot's most experienced soldiers.

name: Chaban
keywords: Cardassian; Cardassian resistance; Dissident; Male; Nurse;
text: MEDICAL Exobiology Navigation Archaeology
lore: One of many battlefield nurses on Cardassia Prime. Dissident who was angered by the loss of Cardassian lives. He vowed to join Damar's resistance efforts.

name: Disik
text: OFFICER Honor MEDICAL Anthropology
lore: Typical loyal Cardassian glinn. Friends with Ekoor. Joined Damar's resistance movement against the Dominion. Wanted to avenge Lakarian City.

name: Elim Garak (Dogs of War)
text: CIVILIAN SECURITY ENGINEER Computer Skill Diplomacy Honor Obsidian Order
lore: Cardassian tailor and former spy. He assisted Legate Damar's resistance efforts to free Cardassia.

name: Mason
text: CIVILIAN SCIENCE Astrophysics Honor Youth
lore: Representative of Cardassian citizens, living under the Dominion occupation. Upon seeing Damar, he was inspired to rise up and join the resistance efforts.

name: Odo (Dogs of War)
keywords: Changeling; Cardassian resistance; Founder; Infiltrator; Male; Shape-shifter;
text: SECURITY Honor Law Computer Skill Diplomacy DL/ {You Dirty Rat} (to hand). DL/ {Strike Three} (when attacked).
lore: Changeling who aided Damar's resistance. Frequent shape-shifting advanced the onset of the morphogenic virus. He posed as the Founder, Founder Leader.

name: Baas
text: SECURITY Diplomacy Geology Law DL/ {Decimate Homeworld} (if with any Thot).
lore: Breen security specialist. Patrolled the holding cells where Worf and Ezri Dax were held. He helped Thot Gor to plan the attack on Earth.

name: Damar (Dogs of War)
text: OFFICER Diplomacy ENGINEER Treachery Physics Stellar Cartography DL/ {Kanar}
lore: Cardassian legate and head of state. Holds no true power in the Dominion. Hates the Vorta. Drowns his woes with alcohol. He arranged a surgeon for Dukat.

name: Draz
text: MEDICAL Biology Stellar Cartography Youth X = number of your other Breen present.
lore: Representative of Breen medics. He was charged with ensuring that prisoners such as Worf and Ezri Dax were not killed during interrogation.

name: Fel
text: SCIENCE Astrophysics Honor Music
lore: Typical Breen scientist. He supervised the interrogation of Worf and Ezri Dax. Accompanied Thot Gor for the initial meeting with the Dominion.

name: Flet'ika
text: OFFICER Archaeology Transporter Skill Leadership Exobiology
lore: Typical Jem'Hadar First bred in the Alpha Quadrant. Served during the battle to retake the Chin'toka system, which saw the U.S.S. Defiant destroyed.

name: Founder Leader (Dogs of War)
text: V.I.P. Leadership Exobiology Treachery x 2 Diplomacy DL/ Any Thot DL/ {I Want the Cardassians Exterminated!}
lore: Diseased changeling trapped in the Alpha Quadrant. Her negotiations brought the Breen into the war.

name: Luaran 9
text: SCIENCE Computer Skill Biology Diplomacy Leadership Your non-[GQ][Dom] ships here are each WEAPONS +1.
lore: Vorta clone activated in the Alpha Quadrant near the end of the war after the death of her predecessor. Luaran helped negotiate the peace accords.

name: Rayva
text: MEDICAL Astrophysics Anthropology Treachery X = number of affiliations of non-[Dom] personnel present.
lore: One of many Vorta bred in the Alpha Quadrant. Was instructed to continue the viral research of his predecessor. Witnessed the Treaty of Bajor signing.

name: Weyoun 8
text: V.I.P. Diplomacy x 2 Leadership Treachery x 2 Law Biology Once per game, if killed, draw 3 cards.
lore: Overconfident Vorta. The last Weyoun clone. Activated in the Alpha Quadrant after his predecessor was killed by Worf. Lives to serve the Founders.

name: Lieutenant Nog
text: OFFICER Honor ENGINEER Navigation Diplomacy DL/ {Phaser Array Power Cell}
lore: Ferengi serving on Deep Space 9. One of Benjamin Sisko's final acts was to promote Nog. Future Starfleet vessels would bear his illustrious name.

name: Grand Nagus Rom
text: V.I.P. Diplomacy Honor x 2 ENGINEER Physics Your other Ferengi present are each INTEGRITY +2.
lore: Former waiter Rom married Leeta in 2373. He was selected by Grand Nagus Zek as a kinder, gentler, more benevolent Nagus to succeed him.

name: Chancellor Martok
keywords: Klingon; Chancellor; General; High Council; High Council Leader; Male;
text: V.I.P. OFFICER Leadership Diplomacy Honor x 2 Law Once per game, may download {Mantle of the Empire}.
lore: Honored General. Martok became High Council leader after the death of Gowron. Soldier who detests politics. Commands the I.K.S. Rotarran.

name: Chu'vok
text: V.I.P. Leadership ENGINEER Honor Archaeology
lore: Klingon general and military aide to Chancellor Gowron. He commanded a Modified Vor'Cha during the Dominion War. Collects rare, vintage bloodwine.

name: Worf Son of Mogh (Dogs of War)
text: CIVILIAN SECURITY Honor x 2 Leadership Law Your other [Kli] personnel present are INTEGRITY +1.
lore: Putting aside his oath to Starfleet, the Klingon Worf killed Chancellor Gowron in ritual combat. Was briefly romantically involved with Ezri Dax.

name: Vic Fontaine (Dogs of War)
text: CIVILIAN Music x 2 Worth points while present with {any Sisko}, {any Kira}, {any Quark}, {any O'Brien}, {any Odo}, {any Dax}, {any Bashir}, {any Nog}, and {any Worf}.
lore: Self-aware holographic singer. After he helped Nog to recover, his program was left running permanently.

name: General Lar
text: OFFICER Diplomacy Honor Archaeology If with {Velal} OR any [DS9][Rom] V.I.P.: MEDICAL, Geology.
lore: Typical military negotiator. She attended the signing of the Treaty of Bajor as the highest-ranking Romulan officer after Velal's death at the Battle of Cardassia.

name: Hideki Cruiser
text: DL/ {Strafing Run} OR {Activate Tractor Beam}
lore: Heavy duty military vessel outfitted with the latest Dominion security protocols. Damar's resistance used one to infiltrate the Kelvas V shipyards.

name: Enhanced Warship
keywords: Dominion ship; Energy Dampener; Invasive Transporters; Tractor Beam; Warship;
text: Energy Dampener, Invasive Transporters, Tractor Beam
lore: Upgraded warship constructed in the Alpha Quadrant. Had Breen energy-dampening technology built into its arsenal. Luaran 9 commanded one.

name: Tykk
keywords: Breen ship; Dominion ship; Energy Dampener; Tractor Beam; Warship;
text: Energy Dampener, Tractor Beam
lore: Breen flagship commanded by Thot Pran. One of the few vessels to survive the attack on Earth.

name: U.S.S. Magellan
text: Holodeck, Tractor Beam If [DS9]: DL/ {Line of Defense}
lore: NCC-71820. Fought in Operation Return. Briefly commanded by Admiral Ross. Served as his flagship during the Battle of Cardassia.

name: Modified Vor'Cha
keywords: Cloaking Device; Klingon ship; Tractor Beam;
text: Cloaking Device, Tractor Beam Energy Dampeners here are off line.
lore: Klingon heavy cruiser used during the Dominion War. Upgraded in 2375 to counteract recently encountered Breen energy-dampening technology.

name: B-Type Warbird
keywords: Cloaking Device; Romulan ship; Tractor Beam;
text: Cloaking Device, Tractor Beam
lore: The Romulan fleet rearmed to replace the Tal Shiar ships destroyed in 2371. Ruwon commanded one.

name: Rovaran
keywords: Cloaking Device; Romulan ship; Tractor Beam;
text: Cloaking Device, Tractor Beam WEAPONS and SHIELDS +2 vs. [Dom].
lore: Flagship of the Romulan forces stationed at Deep Space 9 during the final stages of the Dominion War. Commanded by Velal.

name: Elim Garak (Dogs of War)*
text: CIVILIAN SECURITY ENGINEER Computer Skill Diplomacy Honor Obsidian Order
lore: Cardassian tailor and former spy. He assisted Legate Damar's resistance efforts to free Cardassia.

name: Odo (Dogs of War)*
keywords: Changeling; Cardassian resistance; Founder; Infiltrator; Male; Shape-shifter;
text: SECURITY Honor Law Computer Skill Diplomacy DL/ {You Dirty Rat} (to hand). DL/ {Strike Three} (when attacked).
lore: Changeling who aided Damar's resistance. Frequent shape-shifting advanced the onset of the morphogenic virus. He posed as the Founder, Founder Leader.

name: Odo (Dogs of War)+
keywords: Changeling; Cardassian resistance; Founder; Infiltrator; Male; Shape-shifter;
text: SECURITY Honor Law Computer Skill Diplomacy DL/ {You Dirty Rat} (to hand). DL/ {Strike Three} (when attacked).
lore: Changeling who aided Damar's resistance. Frequent shape-shifting advanced the onset of the morphogenic virus. He posed as the Founder, Founder Leader.

name: Worf Son of Mogh (Dogs of War)*
text: CIVILIAN SECURITY Honor x 2 Leadership Law Your other [Kli] personnel present are INTEGRITY +1.
lore: Putting aside his oath to Starfleet, the Klingon Worf killed Chancellor Gowron in ritual combat. Was briefly romantically involved with Ezri Dax.

name: Odo (Dogs of War) *VP
keywords: Changeling; Cardassian resistance; Founder; Infiltrator; Male; Shape-shifter;
text: SECURITY Honor Law Computer Skill Diplomacy DL/ {You Dirty Rat} (to hand). DL/ {Strike Three} (when attacked).
lore: Changeling who aided Damar's resistance. Frequent shape-shifting advanced the onset of the morphogenic virus. He posed as the Founder, Founder Leader.

name: Odo (Dogs of War)* *VP
keywords: Changeling; Cardassian resistance; Founder; Infiltrator; Male; Shape-shifter;
text: SECURITY Honor Law Computer Skill Diplomacy DL/ {You Dirty Rat} (to hand). DL/ {Strike Three} (when attacked).
lore: Changeling who aided Damar's resistance. Frequent shape-shifting advanced the onset of the morphogenic virus. He posed as the Founder, Founder Leader.

name: Odo (Dogs of War)+ *VP
keywords: Changeling; Cardassian resistance; Founder; Infiltrator; Male; Shape-shifter;
text: SECURITY Honor Law Computer Skill Diplomacy DL/ {You Dirty Rat} (to hand). DL/ {Strike Three} (when attacked).
lore: Changeling who aided Damar's resistance. Frequent shape-shifting advanced the onset of the morphogenic virus. He posed as the Founder, Founder Leader.

name: Armus: Sticky Situation
text: Away Team member with highest STRENGTH is stopped if another personnel present has Diplomacy and CUNNING>7, killed otherwise. To get past requires any personnel remaining.
lore: Armus, a remnant of the Vagrans, engulfed William T. Riker in his skin of evil. Only the finesse and skillful negotiation of Jean-Luc Picard resulted in his release.

name: Spacedoor
text: Seeds on your outpost during facility phase. Outpost is SHIELDS -8 (cumulative). In place of your normal card play, you may return your empty ship docked here (and all cards played on it) to owners' hands, nullifying any {Static Warp Bubble} targeting you OR download {Spacedock} or one compatible [Univ] ship to outpost. Flip Spacedoor over after either use.

name: Spacedoor (back)
text: You may use opponent's {Red Alert}! (only at this outpost) as if you had a copy in play. At the end of your turn, you may discard a card from hand to flip Spacedoor over. (Immune to cards that close doorways.)

name: Spacedoor (back)*
text: You may use opponent's {Red Alert}! (only at this outpost) as if you had a copy in play. At the end of your turn, you may discard a card from hand to flip Spacedoor over. (Immune to cards that close doorways.)

name: Spacedoor (back)* (back)
text: You may use opponent's {Red Alert}! (only at this outpost) as if you had a copy in play. At the end of your turn, you may discard a card from hand to flip Spacedoor over. (Immune to cards that close doorways.)

name: Establish Relations
text: Diplomacy + INTEGRITY>32 + (Leadership OR V.I.P.) When you solve, you may download a [Non] personnel here.
lore: Conduct negotiations to establish peaceful rapport and cultural exchange.

name: Suna
text: SECURITY MEDICAL Treachery Once per game, may download {Reflection Therapy}.
lore: Military official of Tilonus IV. He twisted William T. Riker's mind using neurosomatic techniques. Typical of treacherous Tilonian government interrogators.

name: Abandon Ship!
text: If ship damaged or RANGE reduced, personnel not needed for staffing are placed with dilemma atop mission. Rescue (opponent may capture) personnel with different ship here.
lore: Krenim attacks repeatedly damaged the U.S.S. Voyager. Failing life support systems led Kathryn Janeway to order the evacuation of all personnel except senior staff.

name: Hippocratic Oath
text: To get past, most CUNNING MEDICAL must relocate with dilemma to nearest planet at another location (must still have MEDICAL upon arrival); stopped until countdown expires.
lore: On stardate 49066.5, rogue Jem'Hadar detained Julian Bashir on Bopak III. He was compelled to seek a cure to their genetically engineered addiction to the drug ketracel-white.

name: Make Us Go
text: To get past, place most CUNNING ENGINEER present atop mission with dilemma. At end of your next turn, place both out of play if you do not have CUNNING>24 here.
lore: We are Pakleds. We look for things...things to make us go. You are smart. Can you make our ship go? Do not try to trick us. We can tell.

name: Unscientific Method
text: Most CUNNING SCIENCE personnel present without Greed or Treachery is killed. To get past requires CUNNING>24 remaining.
lore: As part of his plan to steal the newly developed metaphasic shield technology, Jo'Bril sabotaged the initial testing, faked his own death and killed the inventor.

name: Space-Time Portal
text: Seeds or plays on table. Your [AU] cards may seed and (once per turn) play. At any time, discard doorway to download {Alternate Universe Door} (except to table) OR play {Wormhole} on a location to relocate your ship there (stopped) OR nullify {Temporal Rift} OR return one of your ships to owner's hand OR (once per game) report with up to four [AU] personnel an [AU] ship to any location.

name: Treaty: Federation/Romulan/Klingon
keywords: Federation treaty; Klingon treaty; Romulan treaty;
text: Plays on table. While you have no open side decks, your [Fed], [Rom], and [Kli] affiliations are compatible and ignore affiliation attack restrictions. They may not attempt opponent's missions.
lore: Three major Alpha Quadrant powers, in an uncharacteristic show of solidarity in 2373, focused their resources against the Dominion threat in a united stand at station Deep Space 9.

name: Husnock Outpost
text: Seed at any [NON] location. You may seed one [Univ] {Husnock Ship} face up here. Extends only 25% of its SHIELDS to ships.
lore: The sudden eradication of the entire Husnock race left its many outposts vacant. Various affiliations take advantage of these available facilities.

name: Explore Interstellar Matter
text: SCIENCE + (Astrophysics OR Stellar Cartography) Your {Subspace Warp Rift} and {Tetryon Field} play for free here. Opponent's side: Opponent's {Calamarain} plays at this mission (or a copy).
lore: Gather data on newly encountered phenomenon.

name: Impose Order
text: Diplomacy + Treachery + STRENGTH>40 *Unopposed OFFICER on planet may steal points.
lore: Unify diverse nation-states via coercion and occupation.

name: Investigate Incursion
affiliation: Any crew may attempt mission. Your {Salvage Starship} objective may target this location.
text: SECURITY + ({Shelby} OR Leadership + OFFICER x2) X=30 (45 if [Bor] or [BO] card or {Borg Ship} dilemma here). Opponent's side: Your Borg ships may report with staffing here. Points: [30]
lore: Investigate reports of Borg presence in this sector.

name: Mineral Survey
affiliation: Any Away Team may attempt mission.
text: Geology + SCIENCE + CUNNING>28 When you solve, draw up to two cards.
lore: Survey planetoid with minimal atmosphere to determine value of mineral deposits.

name: Test Propulsion Systems
text: Navigation + Physics + ENGINEER + % ship Solving player's ships are RANGE +2. (Cumulative.)
lore: Test upgrades to faster-than-light drive components.

name: Open Diplomatic Relations
text: Seeds on table during doorway phase; you may seed one {Treaty} during this phase (cumulative). At any time, you may exchange two cards in hand for a Treaty in your discard pile. OR Plays on opponent's ship. Your Away Teams which have a V.I.P. may beam to and from that ship, and it may not voluntarily move while your V.I.P. aboard. Discard objective if your personnel battle aboard that ship.

name: Reflection Therapy
text: Plays on a personnel (except {Suna}) if your Treachery > Honor present. Replace one regular skill with one level of another regular skill (discard if skill lost). Any player may nullify with 3 Empathy present. OR Plays on an opponent's personnel affected by {Frame of Mind}; personnel is captured. Discard objective if rescued or (on a later turn) to download {Brainwash} or {Interrogation} to this captive.

name: Hide and Seek
text: Shuffle Hide and Seek together with crew or Away Team. Randomly select cards until a [Univ] personnel or Hide and Seek selected. All selected personnel are stopped; discard dilemma. (May be seeded as a [S/P] dilemma.)
lore: Why don't we play a little game? I'll hide... you find me.

name: Darmok
keywords: Holodeck; Particle Scattering Device; Tractor Beam;
text: When reporting, choose Tractor Beam OR Holodeck OR Particle Scattering Device.
lore: Typical Tamarian vessel. "Picard and Dathon, trading knives at El-Adrel. Children at Tama's knee. Sokath, forging knives for his brothers."

name: Assimilate Counterpart *VP
text: Plays on table. Target an opponent's unique male personnel. Your Borg may beam to and battle target's crew or Away Team. One of your Borg who engages target in combat may abduct target. If target is occupying an {Assimilation Table}, you may probe: [Com], [Nav], [Def]: Assimilated as a counterpart. Place on target. Worth 5 points per [*] while objective on target.

name: Where No Man Has Gone Before *VP
text: Plays on table. At start of turn, your undocked ships at any spaceline end are RANGE +3 until end of turn. Once per turn, when your ship moves from one spaceline to another, you may draw a card OR report an [AU] card aboard.
lore: Going boldly into the unknown frontiers of the galaxy, brave captains and crews cheat death in search of new life.

name: Q: A Dazzling Flash
text: Crew or Away Team has a Q-Flash with X cards from opponent's Q-Continuum, where X = number of personnel present. Discard dilemma. (Immune to {Q2}.)
lore: One of many Q conflicts encountered during their voyage home, a furious chase between Q and Quinn threw the U.S.S. Voyager from the birth of the universe to a Christmas tree.

name: Q: Enter the Supernova
text: Crew has a Q-Flash with X cards from opponent's Q-Continuum, where X = the lowest attribute of attempting ship. Discard dilemma. (Immune to {Q2}.)
lore: A civil war between the Q resulted in the implosion of multiple stars. Each one created a negative density false vacuum, sucking the surrounding matter into the Continuum.

name: Miss Q
text: Once per Q-Flash, just before a card is drawn from your Q-Continuum, download a [Q] card (once per game per card title) and place it atop that deck. OR Nullifies a [Q] card.
lore: Female Q. Has an eternal association with Q. Relied on a rickety barge and its half witted crew to stop Q from mating with a human. Mother of Q Junior. Admires Klingon females.

name: Mortal Quinn
text: V.I.P. Anthropology x 10 Scores 5 points if he dies. Loses 5 points if he helps solve a mission. While in play, your personnel enter play stopped.
lore: Controversial Q philosopher. Granted mortality, he was able to live the rest of his life as a human.

name: An Absence of Manners
text: Plays on table until any Q-Flash. Play with your hand revealed. If, at the start of opponent's turn, you have drawn exactly one card since end of opponent's last turn (including card draws converted to downloads), discard event. May be nullified only by {Plexing} or {Wolf}.
lore: At some point along the way, I guess we just stopped thinking about the little niceties.

name: It's a Party!
text: If crew or Away Team began attempt with more than 9 or fewer than 4 personnel, plays on table until any Q-Flash. Opponent may play one additional card each turn.
lore: One dance, B'Elanna, that's all I ask.

name: Don't Provoke the Borg!
text: If any [Bor] ship or {Borg Ship} dilemma is on this spaceline, opponent (even if playing Borg) scores points (once per game), and you may relocate one such card up to 20 span away from its current location on same spaceline.
lore: If the Continuum has told you once, they've told you a thousand times...

name: Futile Attempt
text: Reveal the top card of your draw deck. If it is a personnel, it is placed beneath draw deck; opponent scores 1 point for each [*] and you lose 2 points for each DL/ . May be nullified by {any Seven of Nine}.
lore: If you're attempting to embarrass me, you won't succeed.

name: I Will Not Promise...
text: If played during a Q-Flash: Opponent may end current Q-Flash now (no more [Q] cards are drawn) and immediately seed this interrupt beneath any other mission like a [S/P] dilemma. If encountered seeded beneath a mission: Crew or Away team has a Q-Flash with three [Q] cards.
lore: ...never to appear again.

name: Q: A Dazzling Flash *VP
text: Crew or Away Team has a Q-Flash with X cards from opponent's Q-Continuum, where X = number of personnel present. Discard dilemma. (Immune to {Q2}.)
lore: The sudden appearance of Q on the U.S.S. Enterprise often signals the start of unusual experiences like post-apocalyptic courtrooms, Borg encounters, or a trip to Sherwood Forest.

name: Hello Computer?
text: Unless Archaeology, Physics, and Computer Skill present, place on table. All your personnel are attributes all -2.
lore: Any technology, if sufficiently advanced, seems indistinguishable from magic. Obsolete machinery, however, also poses certain challenges. "Just use the keyboard."

name: Nuclear Wessels
text: Place on planet. Now and start of each attempt here, cannot get past unless one SECURITY OR Anthropology is stopped (random selection). (Unique.)
lore: Searching in an unfamiliar environment can be challenging. Commander Uhura and Commander Chekov struggled to locate a naval base in ancient San Francisco.

name: Slingshot Effect
text: Seeds on table. Your [AU][Films] personnel, ships and facilities (and [AU] cards of other card types) may seed and play. Once each turn, your [Films] ship may time travel between a time location and its corresponding spaceline location. {Temporal Investigations} is nullified.

name: Earth Spacedock
text: Seeds at a [FED] Sector 001 mission; you may not play cards to {Camp Khitomer}. Once each turn, if all your personnel are [Films], one [Fed][Films] personnel may play for free here.
lore: Large starship service facility commanded by Fleet Admiral Morrow. On a clear night, visible from Earth.

name: Guess Who's Coming to Dinner
text: Seeds on {The Great Hall}. Once each turn, your [Kli][Films] personnel reporting here may do so for free. You may play personnel for free only at {Qo'noS}. In place of your normal card draw, you may download to hand one [Films] personnel with "High Council" in lore OR on {HQ} card.

name: Take Us Out!
text: Seeds on table. If all your ships in play are [Films], they are RANGE and SHIELDS +2 while uncloaked. Nullified if you have in play both {Camp Khitomer} and {a headquarters}.
lore: The late 23rd century saw many scientific and technological advancements. New ships were launched and older ships refurbished, each one worthy of celebration.

name: The Undiscovered Country
text: Seeds on table. While all your personnel in play are [Films], you may draw an extra card at the end of your turn. Once per game, in place of your normal card play, you may nullify {Homefront}. Nullified if you have in play both {Camp Khitomer} and {a headquarters}.

name: We Surrender!
text: Plays at start of a battle opponent initiated against your card. Cancels and prevents battles there. Up to two of your personnel involved (opponent's choice) are captured.
lore: To avoid instigating full scale war on the eve of universal peace, Captain Kirk ordered his crew to yield to the Klingon flagship.

name: Overhaul Starship Systems
text: ENGINEER x2 + 6 {[Films] personnel}
lore: Enhance, repair, and upgrade vessel to latest specifications.

name: GIVE ME GENESIS!
text: Seeds on any [FED][P] mission that requires SCIENCE OR Geology. No player may use {The Genesis Device} on a mission they seeded. In place of your normal card play, you may download {Kruge} here; lose 5 points. When you solve mission, you may download The Genesis Device here. (Unique.)

name: Reserve Activation Clause
text: Seeds or plays on table. Once each turn, just after the end of a mission attempt, you may "retire" one [Fed][Films] personnel who was involved in that attempt when it ended (place atop objective; in play for uniqueness only) and play a different [Films] personnel there (from hand) instead. Once per game, you may play one personnel from here to your crew or Away Team.

name: Admiral S'rrel
text: V.I.P. Diplomacy Stellar Cartography Geology MEDICAL (if all your personnel present are [Films]).
lore: Typical Caitian diplomat and ambassador serving in Starfleet. Mentor to Lt. M'Ress. Attended the inquiry following the controversial events at Genesis.

name: Bill Toddman
text: V.I.P. Leadership Diplomacy SECURITY Biology If all your personnel are [Films], your [Fed] leaders may play as if Admirals.
lore: Fleet admiral and Chief in Command in 2293. Agreed to open negotiations with the Klingon Empire.

name: Bob Bennett
text: V.I.P. Leadership Archaeology ENGINEER Transporter Skill (if all your personnel present are [Films]).
lore: Starfleet Chief of Staff. Admiral who sent the U.S.S. Enterprise-A to Nimbus III. Helped write and produce leadership textbooks used at Starfleet Academy.

name: Captain Alexander
text: OFFICER Diplomacy SECURITY Stellar Cartography Anthropology (if all your personnel present are [Films]).
lore: Decorated Starfleet captain. She commanded the Starship Saratoga in 2286 when it encountered the whale probe. Previously served under Admiral Kirk.

name: Captain Kirk (Second Star to the Right)
text: OFFICER Leadership Anthropology Honor Diplomacy Protects all treaties from nullification. DL/ {We Surrender!}
lore: Demoted admiral who became captain of the U.S.S. Enterprise-A. Father of David Marcus. His efforts at Khitomer helped build an alliance with the Klingons.

name: Commander Sonak
text: SCIENCE Computer Skill Anthropology Mindmeld ENGINEER (if all your personnel present are [Films]).
lore: Typical Vulcan science officer. Newly appointed to the refitted Starship Enterprise. He expressed gratitude to Admiral Kirk for the assignment.

name: Fleet Admiral Morrow
text: V.I.P. ENGINEER Diplomacy Physics Once per game, may return your ship here to hand.
lore: High-ranking admiral who succeeded Admiral Nogura. He commissioned the failed transwarp drive project and tried to decommission the Starship Enterprise.

name: Igrilan Kor
text: OFFICER Astrophysics Exobiology Music Law SCIENCE (if all your personnel present are [Films]).
lore: Reprentative of Andorian admirals in the 2280s. Friend of Ambassador Shras. Part of the inquiry group looking into the fallout from Project Genesis.

name: Lt. Slater
text: ENGINEER Transporter Skill Archaeology Anthropology SECURITY (if all your personnel present are [Films]). DL/ {Hail}
lore: Night shift communications officer aboard Starship Excelsior. Expert in ordnance disposal. Likes archery, vampire stories, and orange sherbet. A true romantic.

name: Pavel Chekov
text: OFFICER Navigation Anthropology Biology Your {[Univ][Fed][Stf][Films] personnel} present gain MEDICAL.
lore: After a long career, Ensign Chekov was a guest at the U.S.S. Enterprise-B launch. Commander who assisted as a nurse due to a lack of medical staff.

name: Peter Preston
text: ENGINEER Transporter Skill Youth Honor Physics (if all your personnel present are [Films]).
lore: Diligent cadet. Nephew of Mr. Scott. Called a tiger by Admiral Kirk. Stayed at his post during the attack by the U.S.S. Reliant, when most other trainees ran.

name: President Ra-ghoratreii
text: V.I.P. Diplomacy Law Leadership Archaeology MEDICAL (if all your personnel present are [Films]).
lore: Efrosian who succeeded Hiram Roth. Redefined relations with the Klingons and the Cardassians during his time in office. Not above the law.

name: Saavik (Second Star to the Right)
text: SCIENCE Geology Computer Skill Mindmeld DL/ {Tricorder} If all your personnel present are [Films]: MEDICAL, Physics.
lore: Vulcan science officer aboard U.S.S. Grissom. Friend to David Marcus. She studied the rapid development of both Genesis and a similarly aging Captain Spock.

name: Brask
text: SECURITY Transporter Skill Treachery Greed DL/ {Target Engines}
lore: Typical reserve gunner serving in the Klingon Defense Force. Expert marksman. Understood Kruge's order to only target the engines of the Starship Enterprise.

name: Frexor
text: SCIENCE Navigation Biology ENGINEER (if all your personnel present are [Films]).
lore: One of many Klingon technicians serving in the Klingon Defense Force. Beamed down to Genesis with Kruge and Regnor to investigate the planet.

name: Garvock
text: SECURITY Archaeology Transporter Skill Youth
lore: Typical Klingon soldier aboard the I.K.S. Chontay. He escorted Captain Kirk to the bridge after beaming up from Sha Ka Ree. Collects antique d'k tahgs.

name: General Grokh
text: OFFICER SECURITY Klingon Intelligence Treachery Navigation (if all your personnel present are [Films]).
lore: Intelligence officer recently promoted to serve on the High Council. Assisted General Chang with developing the I.K.S. Kla'Diyus. Opposed to the peace initiative.

name: General K'Ron
text: V.I.P. ENGINEER Computer Skill Treachery Leadership (if all your personnel present are [Films]).
lore: Characteristic of High Council logistics experts. Encouraged Azetbur to attack the Federation now, rather than becomes slaves under their rule.

name: General Lompoc
text: SCIENCE Stellar Cartography Geology Astrophysics (if all your personnel present are [Films]).
lore: Representative of Klingon scientific advisors to the High Council. Enjoyed the gagh served aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise-A. Not fond of Shakespeare.

name: K'mbol
text: MEDICAL Biology Exobiology Geology DL/ {Medical Kit} (if with your [Films] Leadership).
lore: Typical military surgeon. Expert in Klingon anatomy. Assigned by the High Council to single-handedly oversee the medical needs to Chancellor Gorkon.

name: Magistrate K'Rea
text: V.I.P. Law Diplomacy Archaeology DL/ {Awaiting Trial} SCIENCE (if all your personnel present are [Films]).
lore: Senior judge for the High Council. Gave Captain Kirk and Dr. McCoy a lenient sentence in the interest of fostering amity for the forthcoming peace talks.

name: Prisoner Martia
keywords: Chameloid; Female; Male; Prisoner-related personnel; Rura Penthe-related personnel; Shape-shifter;
text: SECURITY Exobiology Geology (if no other Geology present). Greed Treachery DL/ {You Dirty Rat} (to hand).
lore: Female Chameloid and shape-shifter who posed as a male to access the mines on Rura Penthe. Martia conspired with Koth to stage an execution.

name: Prisoner McCoy
keywords: Human; Male; Prisoner-related personnel; Rura Penthe-related personnel;
text: CIVILIAN MEDICAL Exobiology Biology Honor Cantankerousness
lore: The human Dr. McCoy was sentenced to mining duties on Rura Penthe for the remainder of his life. He unsuccessfully tried to save Chancellor Gorkon.

name: Spock Son of Sarek
text: OFFICER SCIENCE Diplomacy Mindmeld Honor Compatible with {[SKR] cards}. DL/ {Tactical Console}
lore: Half brother to Sybok. Under orders from General Korrd, Klaa allowed the 1/2 Vulcan, 1/2 human Mr. Spock to act as gunner for the I.K.S. Chontay.

name: Starship Saratoga
text: Tractor Beam
lore: NCC-1887. Commanded by Captain Alexander. Patrolled the Neutral Zone in 2286. Unsuccessfully attempted to communicate with the whale probe.

name: H.M.S. Bounty*
keywords: Bird-of-Prey; Cloaking Device; Federation ship; Klingon ship; Tractor Beam;
text: Cloaking Device, Tractor Beam (cannot carry ships aboard).
lore: Bird-of-prey captained by Kruge on a covert mission to the Genesis Planet. Stolen and commanded by Admiral Kirk; re-christened with historical irony by Dr. McCoy.

name: Analyze Radiation
text: Astrophysics + Biology + Navigation Span -2 for all Son'a ships.
lore: Conduct analysis of the metaphasic particles in this nebula.

name: Ch'dak
text: OFFICER Navigation Physics If on a [Kli] [Films] ship, it is RANGE +1.
lore: Characteristic member of the I.K.S. Kla'Diyus crew. A pilot rated on many designs, he enjoyed the new tactics enabled by the ability to attack while cloaked.

name: Henreid
text: OFFICER Leadership Astrophysics Navigation
lore: Typical first officer. Assigned to Starship Excelsior in 2285. Stood in for the helmsman, who was on leave when Admiral Kirk stole the Starship Enterprise.

name: I.K.S. K't'inga
keywords: Cloaking Device; Klingon ship; Tractor Beam;
text: Cloaking Device, Tractor Beam DL/ {Any [Univ] Klingon [Films] personnel}
lore: Though the basic form of the Klingon cruiser had been the same since the 22nd century, this design introduced in the 2270s boasted upgrades to all major systems.

name: Jacobson
text: MEDICAL Biology Honor
lore: Typical member of the medical staff aboard the Starship Enterprise, serving under Dr. McCoy and Dr. Chapel. Specialist in microcellular biology.

name: Karnog
text: SCIENCE Geology
lore: Science officer aboard the I.K.S. Amar. Tried to analyze the sensor data from the intruder V'Ger. Unfortunately, his expertise was in the planetary sciences.

name: Komal
text: MEDICAL Biology Archaeology Honor
lore: Typical chief surgeon of a K't'inga-class ship. Friend of Krase. Strongly opinionated, he often provided his captain with advice, whether asked to or not.

name: Kor'choth
text: SECURITY Leadership Honor Transporter Skill
lore: Typical bodyguard of the High Council leader. Lost an arm defending Chancellor Gorkon. Refused prosthetic replacement. Gave evidence at the subsequent trial.

name: Lojur
text: OFFICER Navigation Transporter Skill
lore: Conservative helmsman of the Starship Excelsior. Serves adequately in the position, but is less knowledgeable about the ship and its limitations than Captain Sulu.

name: Mark Tobiaston
text: ENGINEER Anthropology Exobiology
lore: Communications officer, fully rated on Excelsior-class ships. Linguistics expert who has authored an analysis on similarities of the Vulcan and Romulan languages.

name: Mas'ud
keywords: Human; Augment; Khan-related card; Khan-related personnel; Male;
text: CIVILIAN May download {Ceti Eel} to adversary he just stunned (if with {Khan}). Biology SCIENCE Geology
lore: Specimen of late 20th-century genetic engineering. Augment who swore loyalty to Khan. Studied the effects of the Ceti eel while trapped on Ceti Alpha V.

name: Pa'rena
text: SCIENCE Physics Exobiology Your {Ketracel-White} may report here, for free.
lore: Son'a female. Chief science officer of the Li'seria. Part of the team that perfected mass production of ketracel-white for trade with the Dominion.

name: Rae'alin
text: ENGINEER Geology Anthropology Archaeology
lore: One of the Son'a assigned to the Ba'ku duck blind operation. Has been secretly looking for opportunities to steal technology from the Federation installation.

name: Regnor
text: MEDICAL Exobiology Anthropology
lore: Trained medic serving under Kruge. Like most serving aboard smaller Klingon vessels, is more often called upon as a soldier.

name: Sam'po
text: SECURITY Navigation Treachery Stellar Cartography
lore: Tactical officer aboard the Li'seria. Among the most far gone of the Son'a - will likely die within a few months unless he receives metaphasic treatment.

name: Sarod
keywords: Human; Augment; Khan-related card; Khan-related personnel; Male;
text: CIVILIAN Draw a card when you place a {Ceti Eel} on a personnel here. Exobiology Anthropology MEDICAL
lore: Loyal augment follower of Khan. He served as the group's physician. With healthy "supermen" rarely taxing him, he knew of nothing to save Lt. McGivers.

name: Sharic
text: MEDICAL Biology Computer Skill If on your Son'a ship, cancels its restriction box.
lore: Typical Tarlac, born into indentured servitude of the Son'a. Ru'afo's personal body sculpture attendant. Very good at what she does.

name: Son'a Battleship
text: Son'a shuttlecraft may report, be carried, and launch aboard. Tractor Beam
lore: Fast and deadly, the largest of Son'a ships carry isolytic subspace weapons banned by the Khitomer Accord.

name: Son'a Shuttle
keywords: No staffing requirement; Shuttlecraft; Son'a ship;
text: {Transporter Drones} may report aboard (for free, once each turn).
lore: Small craft capable of atmospheric flight. Used to strafe the Ba'ku village and launch Son'a transporter drones.

name: Starship Constitution (The Motion Pictures)
text: Tractor Beam DL/ {Any [Univ][Fed][Films] personnel}
lore: With new modifications, ships of this class were built long after the original's launch. Starfleet continued this practice of refitting older designs into the 24th century.

name: Tahglio
text: SECURITY Computer Skill
lore: Typical guard for Federation Security. Given a low-priority post on Earth after a poor performance review at his last assignment. His next review showed no improvement.

name: Voight
text: SCIENCE Physics Geology
lore: Science officer aboard U.S.S. Enterprise-B. Joined Starfleet to pursue her interest in alien environments. Has Irish lineage dating back nearly four centuries.

name: Wajahut
keywords: Human; Augment; Female; Khan-related card; Khan-related personnel;
text: CIVILIAN Once per game, if aboard {U.S.S. Reliant}, may relocate it to {any Kirk}'s location. Navigation ENGINEER
lore: Eugenics Wars augment. Escaped on the Botany Bay with Khan. With superior intellect and knowledge of that ship, she quickly adapted to the U.S.S. Reliant.

name: Dmitri Valtane
text: SCIENCE Stellar Cartography Geology Computer Skill
lore: Starship Excelsior science officer. Monitored the 2293 disaster on the Klingon moon Praxis. Host of a parasitic memory virus. Thinks Vulcans need to relax.

name: Woteln
text: ENGINEER Computer Skill Stellar Cartography While on your outpost, opponent's span here is +2.
lore: Technician at the Morska listening post. Representative of those performing less glorious duties in service of the Klingon Empire. "Dujvetlh'e' nuq? ...rln."

name: Admiral Cartwright
text: V.I.P. Leadership SECURITY Treachery Section 31 Once per game, may nullify a [Fed] Treaty.
lore: Militant admiral opposed to Chancellor Gorkon's peace initiative. Used his covert contacts in mounting a conspiracy to assassinate the Klingon leader.

name: Admiral Kirk
text: V.I.P. Leadership x 3 Diplomacy DL/ {Commandeer Ship} Once each turn, you may discard a card to draw a card.
lore: While Captain Kirk regretted accepting promotion, he commanded the Starship Enterprise in later crises. Time away from the center seat did not diminish his ingenuity.

name: Amanda Grayson
text: CIVILIAN {Any Spock} or {any Sarek} may report where present (for free). Anthropology Diplomacy Honor
lore: Human wife of Ambassador Sarek. Admires the Vulcan way, but taught her son Captain Spock that the capacity of human emotion is just as great.

name: Ambassador Sarek
text: V.I.P. Diplomacy x 2 Mindmeld Law DL/ Any [Fed] Treaty
lore: Vulcan ambassador. Sent Admiral Kirk to recover the body of his son Captain Spock. Reciprocated Kirk's effort by defending him to the Federation Council.

name: Target Warp Field Coils
text: Attack: 2. Defense: 2. May not be used to fire upon a facility. Hit = [Down][Flip]. Direct hit = [Down][Flip][Flip][Flip]. Hull: -30% Warp drive off line: opponent may immediately download {Engine Imbalance} to this ship as an interrupt (immune to {Amanda Rogers}).

name: Azetbur
text: V.I.P. Leadership Diplomacy Exobiology DL/ {Treaty: Federation/Klingon}
lore: Daughter of Chancellor Gorkon; became chancellor herself in 2293. Pursued his dream of peace with the Federation, signing the historic Khitomer Accords.

name: Brigadier Kerla
text: SECURITY Stellar Cartography Navigation Transporter Skill DL/ Any [Films] Klingon Chancellor
lore: Military advisor to the High Council leader. Loyally served both Chancellor Gorkon and Azetbur, though bitterly opposed to peace with the Federation.

name: Caithlin Dar
text: V.I.P. Youth Honor Diplomacy Exobiology Compatible with {[SKR] cards}.
lore: Ambassador to Nimbus III. Hides disdain for the position with overeagerness. Released the pain of her deception when Sybok enlisted her help in the search for Vorta Vor.

name: Camp Khitomer
text: Seeds or plays on table. Native to this timeline: all cards with both [Films] and [AU] icon. Once per turn, one such card reporting at this location may report for free.
lore: Site of the ground-breaking peace talks between the Federation and the Klingon Empire.

name: Captain Kang
text: OFFICER Leadership Diplomacy Honor Physics If on a ship at a [KLI] mission, it is WEAPONS +2.
lore: Respected warrior. Named his firstborn son in honor of Curzon Dax. Watched the careers of the Starship Enterprise crew since encountering them in 2268.

name: Captain Spock
text: OFFICER SCIENCE Leadership Computer Skill Physics Mindmeld Diplomacy Honor Music Once per game, may be taken from discard pile to hand.
lore: 1/2 Vulcan, 1/2 human. Mr. Spock was restored from death by the Genesis wave - and his friends' resolve.

name: Captain Styles
text: OFFICER ENGINEER Leadership Physics
lore: Overconfident captain of the Starship Excelsior for a failed transwarp test. Planned to break old Starship Enterprise speed records. Was really in for a shock.

name: Captain Sulu
text: OFFICER Leadership Navigation Honor Physics SCIENCE
lore: After moving through the ranks aboard the Starship Enterprise, Lt. Sulu earned a captaincy in 2290. Holds loyalty in high regard, his crew as dear as family.

name: Carol Marcus
text: SCIENCE SCIENCE Leadership Biology x 2 Physics
lore: Molecular biologist. Head of Project Genesis. Once romantically involved with Admiral Kirk. Asked that he leave her to raise David Marcus in her world, not his.

name: Cetacean Institute
text: Seeds or plays on table; download {George and Gracie} here. Native to this timeline: {Dr. Gillian Taylor} and George and Gracie.
lore: Marine biology research laboratory and public aquarium located in Sausalito, California.

name: Ceti Eel
text: Plays on table (once each turn, for free). On your turn, you may place on a personnel present with {Khan}. Personnel becomes [Non], is under your control, is attributes all 3, and is not discarded at end of turn by {Revenge Is A Dish Best Served Cold}. Nullified if personnel is an android or [Holo]. You may not place more than two Ceti Eels on personnel during any turn (even with {Mas'ud}).

name: Chancellor Gorkon
text: V.I.P. Leadership Diplomacy x 2 Honor Anthropology Protects your [Kli] Treaties from nullification.
lore: Klingon leader who first embraced the notion of peace with the Federation. His vision mapped the way to the undiscovered country - the future.

name: Clark Terrell
text: OFFICER Honor x 2 Leadership Biology May replace any V.I.P. present selected to die.
lore: Captain of U.S.S. Reliant. Has a strong sense of duty. Has never met Admiral Kirk, but knows something of him from a few stories told by Commander Chekov.

name: Collect Metaphasic Particles
text: Seeds or plays on {Ba'ku Planet}. Your personnel may attempt it using these requirements: Any Son'a personnel + {Injector Assembly One} in orbit + Treachery x2 + no opposing ships or personnel here When you solve, you may skip opponent's next turn and, for rest of game, all your personnel are STRENGTH +2, add Youth, and you may unstop them each once each turn.

name: Colonel Worf
text: OFFICER Diplomacy Law Honor Archaeology Astrophysics
lore: Warrior and father of Mogh. He represented Captain Kirk and Dr. McCoy at their trial. His low political standing improved once they were proved innocent.

name: Commander Chekov
text: OFFICER Navigation SECURITY Astrophysics Biology If on {Starship Enterprise}, it is WEAPONS +2.
lore: Over the years, Ensign Chekov's distinguished career would include many promotions, and positions as acting science officer, security chief, navigator, and first officer.

name: Commander Rand
text: OFFICER ENGINEER Transporter Skill Biology Leadership
lore: After serving on the Starship Enterprise, Yeoman Rand desired greater duties. She rose to transporter chief and Starship Excelsior's communications officer.

name: Commander Uhura
text: OFFICER Once per game, may capture an all-male Away Team present. Computer Skill ENGINEER Music
lore: While Lt. Uhura had promotions and transfers, she seized each chance to return to Starship Enterprise. Got to play for a captive audience on Nimbus III.

name: David Marcus
text: SCIENCE Biology Computer Skill Physics Geology Ignore {The Genesis Device}'s [Fed] restriction on your [P] here.
lore: Gifted scientist. Like his father, often bends the rules. His impatience was Project Genesis' breakthrough and downfall. Proud - very proud - to be Admiral Kirk's son.

name: Demora Sulu
text: OFFICER Navigation Exobiology Stellar Cartography If on {any Enterprise}, it is RANGE +1.
lore: Daughter of Captain Sulu. Helmsman of the U.S.S. Enterprise-B. James T. Kirk declared: "It wouldn't be the Enterprise without a Sulu at the helm."

name: Dr. Chapel
text: MEDICAL MEDICAL Biology Archaeology Computer Skill
lore: After her first tour aboard the Starship Enterprise, Nurse Chapel earned a medical doctorate. She later accepted a post at Starfleet Command.

name: Dr. Gillian Taylor
text: CIVILIAN May exclude {George and Gracie} from any personnel battle or random selection here. Biology SCIENCE
lore: 20th-century marine biologist. Helped Admiral Kirk safely bring George and Gracie to the 23rd century, where she then signed on aboard a Starfleet science vessel.

name: Dr. Gillian Taylor*
text: CIVILIAN May exclude {George and Gracie} from any personnel battle or random selection here. Biology SCIENCE
lore: 20th-century marine biologist. Helped Admiral Kirk safely bring George and Gracie to the 23rd century, where she then signed on aboard a Starfleet science vessel.

name: Dr. McCoy (The Motion Pictures)
text: MEDICAL Twice per game, may take topmost personnel of discard pile into hand. MEDICAL Exobiology Biology
lore: Leonard H. "Bones" McCoy. Retired from Starfleet in 2270, but returned a year later on Admiral Kirk's request. Retired again in 2293. Would again return.

name: Gallatin
text: OFFICER Anthropology SCIENCE Computer Skill Honor Transporter Skill
lore: Ru'afo's first officer. Once the most vengeance-minded of the Son'a, recent time with the Ba'ku - and a persuasive Federation captain - has softened his hatred.

name: General Chang
text: OFFICER Leadership Treachery Anthropology Law SECURITY DL/ {To Be Or Not To Be}
lore: Chief of staff of the High Council leader. Conspired to assassinate Chancellor Gorkon and ensure no peace. Likes Shakespeare, especially in the original Klingon.

name: General Korrd
text: V.I.P. Leadership x 2 Diplomacy Physics Navigation Compatible with {[SKR] cards}.
lore: Once-renowned military strategist exiled to Nimbus III by the High Council. Released the pain of his dishonor when Sybok enlisted his help in the search for Qui'tu.

name: Observe Ritual
text: Vulcan + Diplomacy + Anthropology Vulcans and {Amanda Grayson} may report on planet.
lore: Transport crew member to Vulcan homeworld to participate in a cultural ceremony.

name: Ru'afo
text: OFFICER ENGINEER Biology Leadership Treachery x 2 Astrophysics DL/ {Injector Assembly One}
lore: Leader of the Son'a, a people banished from their home planet by the Ba'ku. Will let nothing stand in the way of his revenge upon them, least of all his Federation allies.

name: The Whale Probe
text: Place on mission. End of every turn, moves one location toward and off far end of spaceline. All ships, personnel, and facilities are in stasis while here. (Unique.)
lore: Alien space probe of unknown origin. Traveled to Earth to contact the extinct humpback whale. Its powerful transmission caused total power loss aboard nearby ships and starbases.

name: Dr. Tolian Soran
text: SCIENCE Astrophysics Stellar Cartography Treachery Worth points while placed under {The Nexus}.
lore: El-Aurian refugee "rescued" from the nexus in 2293 by the Enterprise-B. Spent the next 78 years obsessed with finding a way to return, no matter the cost.

name: Duj Saq
text: Plays on table. Your B'rel-class ships may report on planets that have a matching affiliation icon. Each may use 1 RANGE to land or take off once each turn. (Captain's Order.)
lore: Klingon for "land the ship." Though K'Vort-class ships were larger and more heavily armed than the B'rel design they were based upon, only the 23rd-century original had this ability.

name: Engine Imbalance
text: Place on ship. It may not fly by a location without stopping, and its RANGE is exhausted each time it moves. Cure with 2 ENGINEER, Computer Skill, and Physics.
lore: An improperly balanced warp drive system poses a serious hazard. Even a minor misalignment can propel a ship into an artificial wormhole.

name: Ensign Tuvok
text: SCIENCE Astrophysics Mindmeld Youth Once per game, may cancel ship battle at same nebula.
lore: 29-year-old Vulcan on first deep space assignment aboard Captain Sulu's Starship Excelsior in 2293. Joined Starfleet under pressure from his parents.

name: Fal-tor-pan
text: Plays on table. At any time, if top card of your discard pile is a Vulcan personnel, you may place it here. Personnel here may report to the {planet Vulcan} as if from your hand.
lore: Vulcan refusion of the body and katra. The ritual was performed successfully for the first time since ancient legend between Leonard H. McCoy, son of David, and Spock, son of Sarek.

name: George and Gracie
keywords: Humpback Whales; Dual Personnel; Female; Male;
text: ANIMAL+ANIMAL George: Nullifies {The Whale Probe} at this location. Gracie: Worth points on Earth (except time locations).
lore: Two humpback whales, male and female, raised in captivity on 20th-century Earth. Gracie is pregnant.

name: God
text: Unless two Away Team members each have INTEGRITY>7, place on mission; destroys one ship here (opponent's choice). You must have a ship here to attempt mission.
lore: This starship. Could it carry my wisdom beyond the Barrier? ...Then I shall make use of this starship... bring it closer, so that I might... join with it.

name: H.M.S. Bounty
keywords: Bird-of-Prey; Cloaking Device; Federation ship; Klingon ship; Tractor Beam;
text: Cloaking Device, Tractor Beam (cannot carry ships aboard).
lore: Bird-of-prey captained by Kruge on a covert mission to the Genesis Planet. Stolen and commanded by Admiral Kirk; re-christened with historical irony by Dr. McCoy.

name: Hero Worship
text: Stops non-Borg crew or Away Team members with the most and fewest [*] icons. (In case of ties, stops all tied personnel.)
lore: Doctor Cochrane, I know this sounds silly, but can I shake your hand?

name: I Do Not Take Orders From You!
text: Plays at start of a personnel battle you initiated (once per battle). Each of your personnel who has Treachery x2 may kill an opposing personnel who has lower CUNNING.
lore: Admiral Dougherty knew the Son'a were devious and dangerous, but never imagined how far Ru'afo would go until it was too late. "The Federation will never know what happened here."

name: I Hate You
text: To get past requires Anthropology, Youth, and no Music present. Nullified by {Vulcan Nerve Pinch}.
lore: The sins of all our fathers, being dumped on us - the sons. The only choice we're given is HOW MANY MEGATONS? And, I eschew you! And I say SCREW YOU! And I hope you're blue too.

name: I Just Love Scanning for Life-forms
text: Plays to reveal up to three cards from the top of any draw deck (six if your own). Discard all non-personnel cards; replace remaining cards in any order. Discard event.
lore: Life-forms... you tiny little life-forms... you precious little life-forms... where are you?

name: I.K.S. Amar
keywords: Cloaking Device; Klingon ship; Tractor Beam;
text: Cloaking Device, Tractor Beam
lore: One of the first K't'inga-class ships. Leader of the battle group dispatched to escort an unidentified intruder out of Klingon space in 2271.

name: I.K.S. Chontay
keywords: Bird-of-Prey; Cloaking Device; Klingon ship; Tractor Beam;
text: Cloaking Device, Tractor Beam (cannot carry ships aboard).
lore: Bird-of-prey captained by Klaa. The highlight of its mission was shooting space garbage until its pursuit of the U.S.S. Enterprise-A through the Great Barrier.

name: I.K.S. K'elric
keywords: Cloaking Device; Klingon ship; Tractor Beam;
text: Cloaking Device, Tractor Beam
lore: One of three ships that brought an end to The Albino's raids on Klingon colonies. Intercepted the Excelsior in the Azure Nebula in 2293. Commanded by Captain Kang.

name: I.K.S. Kla'Diyus
keywords: B'rel Class; Cloaking Device; Klingon ship;
text: Cloaking Device (while cloaked, may initiate battle but may not be fired upon).
lore: Unique vessel able to fire while cloaked. Commissioned and commanded by General Chang, who ordered the designers killed to preserve the secret of its existence.

name: Ilia
text: OFFICER Navigation Biology Anthropology Astrophysics
lore: Deltan navigator assigned to the Starship Enterprise. Her Oath of Celibacy is on record. Was romantically involved with Willard Decker while posted to Delta IV.

name: Injector Assembly One
text: May report to location of your Son'a ship. DL/ {Collect Metaphasic Particles}
lore: Specialized ship designed to collect metaphasic radiation particles from the ring system of the Ba'ku planet - a procedure tested extensively by Ru'afo in simulations.

name: Insurrection
text: Leadership x2 + Diplomacy + STRENGTH>50 Ba'ku may report on planet (for free).
lore: Prevent the Son'a attempt to forcibly relocate the Ba'ku race.

name: Isolytic Burst
text: Attack: 3. Defense: 0. Requires a {Son'a Battleship} or {Li'seria} firing. If you hit, randomly kills one additional personnel (on a Nor, one personnel at site of opponent's choice). Hit = [Down][Flip]. Direct hit = [Down][Flip][Flip][Flip]. Hull: -30% Casualties: randomly kills one personnel (on a Nor, one personnel at site of opponent's choice).

name: Isomagnetic Disintegrator
text: Plays on table. Shuffle your hand into your discard pile, then exchange your discard pile for your draw deck. Draw four cards (may not be converted to downloads). Discard event.
lore: Don't give an isomagnetic disintegrator to a Klingon showing signs of jak'tahla unless you want him to use it.

name: J. T. Esteban
text: OFFICER Geology Exobiology Astrophysics
lore: Captain of the U.S.S. Grissom. Has served as such for over four years without serious incident, due largely to his cautious, "by the book" command style.

name: James T. Kirk
text: OFFICER Leadership x 2 Diplomacy Computer Skill Honor DL/ Any Captain's Order card Scores 5 points each time he helps solve a mission.
lore: Famous captain thought lost in 2293. Returned from the Nexus 78 years later to make a difference once more.

name: Joachim
keywords: Human; Augment; Khan-related card; Khan-related personnel; Male;
text: CIVILIAN SECURITY Astrophysics Navigation Physics Treachery If on {U.S.S. Reliant}, it is WEAPONS +3.
lore: Khan's lieutenant and most trusted friend. Augment who acted as first officer on the U.S.S. Reliant when, after nearly two decades, they escaped Ceti Alpha V.

name: John Harriman
text: OFFICER SECURITY Diplomacy Geology Honor
lore: Son of a respected Federation official. Captain of U.S.S. Enterprise-B. Usually confident in dealing with reporters, but on the ship's maiden voyage was having an off day.

name: J'Onn
text: CIVILIAN SECURITY While with your {Sybok}, you may play {Release This Pain} (for free) one additional time each turn.
lore: Humanoid settler of Nimbus III. Released the pain of his impoverishment when Sybok enlisted his help in the search for the knowledge sought by all since time began.

name: Kamarag
text: V.I.P. Diplomacy Law Archaeology
lore: Ambassador to the Federation. Believed Admiral Kirk wanted Project Genesis as a weapon against Qo'noS. Predicted there would be no peace while Kirk lived.

name: Khan
text: V.I.P. [Fed] opponents need {any Kirk} present to solve mission here. Leadership Treachery x 2 Computer Skill
lore: Genetically engineered augment exiled to Ceti Alpha V by Admiral Kirk. Seeks to avenge his wife's death.

name: Klaa
text: OFFICER Leadership Anthropology Biology Greed Treachery
lore: Aggressive captain. He hunted the U.S.S. Enterprise-A without authorization in 2287. Later demoted and assigned menial translation duties on Qo'noS.

name: Koth
keywords: Klingon; Capturing-related card; Male; Rura Penthe-related personnel;
text: SECURITY Exobiology Geology Treachery DL/ {Forced-Labor Camp} (your [Kli] may attempt.)
lore: Warden of the penal asteroid Rura Penthe. His greatest pleasures are watching fights among his inmates and delivering his welcoming speech to new prisoners.

name: Krase
text: OFFICER Stellar Cartography Astrophysics MEDICAL Your [Kli] [Films] ships here are each SHIELDS +2.
lore: Captain of the I.K.S. Amar. His tendency to rash behavior has earned him a ruthless reputation even by Klingon standards.

name: Kronos One
keywords: Cloaking Device; Klingon ship; Tractor Beam;
text: Cloaking Device, Tractor Beam DL/ {Any [Kli] [Films] personnel}
lore: Battle cruiser of the Klingon Chancellor in the late 23rd century. Under command of Chancellor Gorkon, had a fateful rendezvous with the U.S.S. Enterprise-A.

name: Kruge
text: OFFICER Leadership Treachery Biology Physics Worth 15 points while {The Genesis Device} on his ship.
lore: Klingon commander with a festering hatred of the Federation. Attempted to seize the secret of the Genesis weapon - the secret of ultimate power.

name: Linguistic Legerdemain
text: Unless Anthropology and Exobiology present, X=1+number of affiliation icons on this mission with no matching personnel present; place on mission; it cannot be attempted.
lore: We must respond personally. The universal translator would be recognized.

name: Li'seria
text: Son'a shuttlecraft may report, be carried, and launch aboard. Tractor Beam
lore: Flagship of the small Son'a fleet and base of operations for the entire race. Commanded by Ru'afo.

name: Lure of the Nexus
text: Prevent a personnel from leaving {The Nexus}. OR Relocate all personnel under The Nexus aboard a ship about to be destroyed by it; relocate ship to adjacent location. Discard interrupt.
lore: Though exiting the nexus is as simple as wishing it so, its temptations are so great that few desire to leave. Those pulled away against their will are forever changed by their experience.

name: Maltz
text: ENGINEER Transporter Skill Astrophysics Geology
lore: Klingon serving under Kruge. Prefers the night shift. Captured when his ship was commandeered. Willing to die for this dishonor. Admiral Kirk saw otherwise.

name: Martia
keywords: Chameloid; Female; Rura Penthe-related personnel; Shape-shifter;
text: CIVILIAN SECURITY Treachery Exobiology Anthropology Greed
lore: Chameloid prisoner on Rura Penthe. She helped set up Captain Kirk and Dr. McCoy to get a full pardon. Great shape-shifter, though it takes "a lot of effort."

name: Matthew Dougherty
text: V.I.P. Scores 10 points if helps complete {Collect Metaphasic Particles}. Leadership Treachery SCIENCE
lore: Conflicted admiral under orders from the Federation Council to oversee the Ba'ku relocation. Dislikes working with Ru'afo, but will do it for the Federation.

name: Mr. Scott (The Motion Pictures)
text: ENGINEER Miracle Worker ENGINEER Astrophysics Computer Skill x 2 Transporter Skill DL/ {Divert Power} Removes one staffing requirement from ship while aboard.
lore: Scotty knows his ship like the back of his hand. With his help, a chimpanzee and two trainees could run her.

name: Nanclus
text: V.I.P. Diplomacy Treachery Tal Shiar Geology May work with [Fed] and [Kli] cards if no Honor present.
lore: Romulan Ambassador to the Federation in 2293. Conspired with Admiral Cartwright and General Chang in the assassination of Chancellor Gorkon.

name: No, Kirk ... The Game's Not Over
text: Plays if you just changed a mission's point value using {The Genesis Device}. Discard all planet facilities, landed ships, and ships in orbit there, and all personnel on planet.
lore: From hell's heart, I stab at thee! For hate's sake... I spit my last breath at thee!

name: Now Would Be a Good Time
text: Your Transporter Skill here with transporters may beam up Away Team. Otherwise, one personnel present (opponent's choice) is captured; others stopped. Discard dilemma.
lore: With insufficient transporter power for Scotty to beam him off the aircraft carrier Enterprise, Chekov was captured and interrogated by the U.S. Navy. Being Russian didn't help him.

name: Prefix Code Transmission
text: Plays on your ship when firing on a target that has a matching affiliation or faction icon or that your infiltrator is aboard. Opposing DEFENSE total reduced by half (round down).
lore: Each starship is assigned a unique security code to prevent remote access to its vital systems. With knowledge of the code, a ship can be ordered to lower its own shields.

name: Release This Pain
text: Plays once each turn (for free) on a personnel present with your {Sybok}. Personnel loses all Treachery, is under your control, gains [SKR], and is compatible with your [SKR] cards.
lore: Share your pain with me and gain strength from the sharing.

name: Revenge Is a Dish Best Served Cold
text: Seeds on table during facility phase; you may download {U.S.S. Reliant}. Once each turn, your Khan (or personnel with "Khan" in lore) may report for free aboard U.S.S. Reliant; at end of every turn, you must discard all other personnel you have in play. At start of each of your turns, if your {Khan} and {The Genesis Device} are aboard your U.S.S. Reliant, score 30 points (only 15 if opponent has {any Kirk} in play).

name: Riker Maneuver
text: Attack: 4. Defense: -1. Requires a ship at a nebula firing; ATTACK bonus +3 if {William T. Riker} aboard. Hit = [Down][Flip]. Direct hit = [Down][Flip][Flip][Flip], and another opposing ship present (your choice) is also hit = [Flip][Flip]. Hull: -30% Plasma containment rupture: opponent may immediately download {Plasma Fire} to this ship.

name: Saavik
text: OFFICER SCIENCE Exobiology Stellar Cartography Mindmeld DL/ {Any [Ref] card} OR {Kobayashi Maru Scenario}
lore: Vulcan cadet mentored by Captain Spock. She prefers to do things "by the book." Was determined to learn how Admiral Kirk beat the Kobayashi Maru.

name: Smooth As an Android's Bottom?
text: Once each turn, plays to draw three cards from the bottom of your draw deck (may not be converted to downloads). Place each personnel card drawn out-of-play. OR Prevents the death of one Youth personnel.
lore: Geordi once told Data that technological perfection can shave too close. That, of course, depends on the desired results.

name: St. John Talbot
text: CIVILIAN Diplomacy Computer Skill Law Compatible with {[SKR] cards}.
lore: Ambassador to the worthless lump of rock known as Nimbus III. Released the pain of his cynicism when Sybok enlisted his help in the search for Eden.

name: Starship Enterprise (The Motion Pictures)
text: Tractor Beam DL/ {Crew Reassignment}
lore: Venerable Starfleet ship refit in 2270. Completed many successful missions before being transferred to Captain Spock's command and retired for use as a training vessel.

name: Starship Excelsior
keywords: Federation ship; Prototype; Ship with a Skill; Tractor Beam;
text: Tractor Beam, Stellar Cartography
lore: Unsuccessful transwarp test ship later refitted as the prototype for one of Starfleet's most durable and ubiquitous classes of ship. Commanded by Captain Sulu.

name: Subspace Shock Wave
text: Ship is damaged and two crew members are killed (random selection) unless a Navigation personnel who has CUNNING>7 aboard. Discard dilemma.
lore: Dangerous aftermath of a stellar, planetary, or lunar explosion. The shock wave created by the "incident" on Praxis was felt even beyond the boundaries of Klingon space.

name: Sybok
text: CIVILIAN Leadership Treachery Mindmeld Empathy Anthropology DL/ {Release This Pain} (to hand).
lore: Vulcan son of Ambassador Sarek and half-brother to Captain Spock. Banished for his belief in Sha Ka Ree.

name: The Discovery of Sha Ka Ree
affiliation: Any Away Team may attempt mission.
text: {Sybok} X=number of non-{Sybok} [SKR] personnel present (limit 6).
lore: ...to undertake the greatest adventure of all time...

name: The Genesis Device
text: Use [Equipment] as (until placed). On your turn, if not playing [Fed], may place on [P] mission here. If unsolved at start of your next turn, choose: worth double OR zero points. (Unique.)
lore: Torpedo created by Project Genesis. Reorganizes matter at the subatomic level to achieve rapid terraforming on a planetary scale. Its matrix utilized dangerously unstable protomatter.

name: The Needs of the Many ...
text: Nullifies a dilemma or damage marker if it would destroy your ship. Discard one of that ship's crew members (opponent's choice).
lore: ...outweigh... "The needs of the few." "Or the one." Captain Spock made the ultimate sacrifice not because it was noble, but because it was logical.

name: The Nexus
text: Seeds like a [S/P] dilemma. When encountered, place on far end of spaceline. End of every turn, moves one location toward other end. (Not duplicatable.) All personnel here are placed under Nexus (in play for uniqueness only). Destroys all ships here. At end of spaceline, place on table. At any time, players may relocate their personnel here to a [P] mission or time location. (Immune to {Revolving Door}.)

name: T'Lar
text: V.I.P. MEDICAL Mindmeld x 2 Anthropology Leadership DL/ {Fal-tor-pan}
lore: Revered elder. High priestess of the ancient temple at Mount Seleya. The only Vulcan known to have actually performed a successful fal-tor-pan ceremony.

name: To Be or Not to Be
text: Plays on table. May discard event just after a battle your opponent initiated to damage all opposing ships (including cloaked ships) in that battle. (Immune to {Kevin Uxbridge}.)
lore: taH pagh taHbe'. DaH mu'tlheghvam vlqelnlS. quv'a', yabDaq San vaQ cha, pu' je SIQDI'? pagh, Seng blQ'a'Hey SuvmeH nuHmey SuqDI', 'ej, Suvmo', rlnmoHDI'?

name: Torg
text: OFFICER Leadership SCIENCE Navigation Computer Skill
lore: Kruge's first officer. Led the boarding party sent to secure the Starship Enterprise. His promotions came slowly. Doesn't know when he's being spoken to.

name: Transport Inhibitor
text: If your personnel present, you may prevent any beaming to or from this equipment. Opponent may destroy equipment if their personnel are present and unopposed.
lore: Device that emits an energy field preventing the operation of transporters within a radius of several meters. Used by the U.S.S. Enterprise-E crew in their defense against the Son'a.

name: Transporter Drones
text: Participates in battle like a personnel, using STRENGTH=8 (may not be modified) vs. adversary's CUNNING. May capture, and beam to your ship here, an adversary it stuns.
lore: Typical reconnaissance devices modified by the Son'a to fire isolinear tags. Transporters can lock onto a tagged object, overcoming any interference with normal targeting scanners.

name: U.S.S. Enterprise-A
text: DL/ {Any [Fed] [Films] personnel} OR {James T. Kirk} Tractor Beam
lore: Specially commissioned in 2286 to replace the famous ship lost one year earlier. Proudly continued the mission of its predecessor under the command of James T. Kirk.

name: U.S.S. Enterprise-B
text: Tractor Beam (unless any attribute is reduced). El-Aurians may report aboard.
lore: Third Federation ship so christened, launched on stardate 9715. Became fully operational the following Tuesday.

name: U.S.S. Reliant
keywords: Federation ship; Khan-related card; Tractor Beam;
text: Tractor Beam
lore: NCC-1864. Placed at the disposal of Project Genesis to locate a suitable Stage Three testing site. Captured at Ceti Alpha V and subsequently commanded by Khan.

name: U.S.S. Reliant*
keywords: Federation ship; Khan-related card; Tractor Beam;
text: Tractor Beam
lore: NCC-1864. Placed at the disposal of Project Genesis to locate a suitable Stage Three testing site. Captured at Ceti Alpha V and subsequently commanded by Khan.

name: Valeris
text: SCIENCE Navigation Mindmeld Treachery Diplomacy -3 (while infiltrating).
lore: Vulcan prot g of Captain Spock whom he intended as his replacement. She made a choice to sabotage negotiations with the untrustworthy Klingon Empire.

name: Valkris
text: SCIENCE Klingon Intelligence Smuggling Physics Computer Skill
lore: Klingon operative romantically involved with Kruge. Obtained top secret documents on Project Genesis. It was the pinnacle of her career in espionage.

name: V'Ger
text: Ship is destroyed unless 2 Empathy OR Diplomacy, Anthropology, and Computer Skill present. Discard dilemma.
lore: Massive living machine created by an unknown race around the lost NASA space probe Voyager VI. Left a trail of destruction during its return to Earth in search of its creator.

name: Vixis
text: OFFICER ENGINEER Computer Skill Astrophysics DL/ {Incoming Message - Federation}
lore: Klaa's first officer. Tracked the U.S.S. Enterprise-A by intercepting their distress signal and impersonating Starfleet Command. She has wonderful muscles.

name: What Does God Need With a Starship?
text: Nullifies {"God}." OR Plays once per game. Opponent chooses: you may download a ship to any location or you may stop or unstop (your choice) any ship in play.
lore: Excuse me. I'd... just like to ask a question.

name: Willard Decker
text: OFFICER SCIENCE Computer Skill Diplomacy Leadership Anthropology
lore: Son of Commodore Decker. Succeeded Admiral Kirk as captain of the Starship Enterprise, at Kirk's recommendation. Personally oversaw its refit.

name: Tierna *VP
text: SECURITY Navigation Honor Stellar Cartography DL/ {Kazon Bomb} (as an interrupt, where Tierna present).
lore: Kazon-Nistrim serving as Seska's aide. Assigned a suicide mission by Culluh as part of an elaborate plan to take U.S.S. Voyager. Determined to succeed.

name: Friendly Fire *VP
text: Unless 2 Leadership and 2 SECURITY present, kills one personnel (random selection); place dilemma on this mission (or this {Empok Nor}); it cannot be attempted or scouted.
lore: Attempting to subdue a hostage situation in Ten Forward led to a phaser fight between Worf and his security forces and possessed crewmembers Deanna Troi, Data, and Miles O'Brien.

name: Kai Opaka *VP
text: V.I.P. Leadership x 3 Diplomacy Honor Anthropology Orb artifacts may not be nullified.
lore: Revered Kai of Bajor. Lost her son in the Kendra Valley Massacre. First recognized Benjamin Sisko as the Emissary of the Prophets.

name: Ops *VP
text: Compatible OFFICER-classification personnel may report here. Any player may, in place of their normal card play, download to an unopposed site on this station one card which may play there (if reporting a ship or personnel, must be of matching affiliation); player draws no cards that turn. Any Computer Skill personnel unopposed here may commandeer station. Any Nor: Ops Module

name: Sulan *VP
text: MEDICAL MEDICAL Transporter Skill Exobiology x 2 Treachery Computer Skill x 2 Physics
lore: Chief Surgeon of the Vidiian Sodality. Divided B'Elanna Torres into two beings - fully human and fully Klingon - to study the phage's effects on Klingon genetic material.

name: Turanj *VP
text: SECURITY Treachery x 2 Leadership Geology Stellar Cartography
lore: Rash hunter. Grudgingly took part in a holodeck scenario of Nazi Germany's 20th-century occupation of France. Never grasped Karr's aims in studying the Voyager prey.

name: Strategic Base *VP
text: Seeds or plays on your outpost (except [Neu] or [Non]). Adds point value of this mission to outpost's DEFENSE total. Your leaders and SECURITY personnel at this location are attributes all +1. OR Once per game, seeds or plays on any mission. If you subsequently play an outpost here, discard incident and draw three cards.

name: Federation Flagship: Recovered *VP
text: Seeds or plays on table. If opponent's card just destroyed your only ship in play, place that ship here (with all cards aboard). Download one of the following to your matching facility or that spaceline's end: a different ship of the same class or identification OR any other Enterprise (if destroyed ship was {any Enterprise}). Relocate crew and equipment from here to downloaded ship (they are "stopped"). Discard incident.

name: Authorized Access Only *VP
text: To get past requires three personnel with Acquisition OR three personnel with OFFICER classification.
lore: With the U.S.S. Enterprise evacuated, Jean-Luc Picard took on a group of armed mercenaries single-handedly to prevent them from stealing dangerous trilithium resin.

name: Curzon Odo* *VP
keywords: Changeling; Ambassador; Deep Space 9-related personnel; Male; Shape-shifter; zhian'tara;
text: V.I.P. Diplomacy x 2 Anthropology Law SECURITY When he leaves play, may download {Odo} and/or {Jadzia Dax}.
lore: As part of Jadzia Dax's zhian'tara ritual aboard DS9, former Ambassador and host Curzon Dax was merged with the changeling Odo in 2371.

name: Hanok *VP
text: V.I.P. Acquisition Diplomacy Smuggling ENGINEER DL/ {Any [Rule] card}
lore: Karemma Commerce Minister. Helped to defuse a torpedo lodged in the hull of the U.S.S. Defiant. Learned of Ferengi business philosophy from Quark.

name: Gelnon *VP
text: V.I.P. Diplomacy MEDICAL Stellar Cartography Treachery DL/ {VR Headset} OR {Ketracel-White}
lore: Vorta who ordered an attack on the U.S.S. Defiant in 2374. Skeptical of using Kudak'Etan and other Jem'Hadar alphas. His suspicions were justified.

name: O'Brien Founder *VP
text: ENGINEER ENGINEER Transporter Skill Physics Computer Skill Treachery DL/ {Homefront}
lore: Changeling posing as Miles O'Brien. Infiltrated Earth in 2372 with three other Founders. Gloated about their disruptive activities to Benjamin Sisko.

name: Goran'Agar *VP
text: OFFICER Honor x 2 Leadership Navigation Biology Nullifies {Hippocratic Oath} where present.
lore: First. Jem'Hadar soldier who overcame addiction to ketracel-white. Brought group of Jem'Hadar to Bopak III seeking freedom from the white and the Vorta.

name: Ultimatum *VP
text: Seeds or plays on table; you may download {Bajoran Wormhole}. Once per game, you may download {Remote Supply Depot} and up to two Equipment cards to a {[DOM] Alpha Quadrant mission} where your [Dom] ENGINEER present. Also, you may discard incident to place in your point area one ship just destroyed by your {[Dom] ship}; score points equal to highest attribute printed on that ship card.

name: Kirk's Reading Glasses
text: Immediately plays on table. Once each turn, you may exchange a card in hand for a card in your discard pile.
lore: Eighteenth century spectacles. A birthday present from Dr. McCoy in 2285. Admiral Kirk sold them for 100 dollars in 1986. Would have been worth more if the lenses were intact.

name: Row, Row, Row your Boat
text: To get past requires 2 Music OR total attributes > 63 from up to 3 personnel.
lore: Even amongst old friends, conflicts can arise. Captain Spock initially struggled to comprehend the meaning behind the lyrics of his compatriots' chosen campfire song.

name: This is Ceti Alpha Five!
text: If Away Team unopposed, opponent may relocate up to three augments here. Your Transporter Skill here with transporters may beam up one personnel. Place on mission; no downloading personnel here.
