name: Hannah Bates (Premiere Remastered)
keywords: Human; Female; Mission Specialist; U.S.S. Enterprise-related personnel;
text: SCIENCE Physics
lore: Genetically engineered human scientist from Moab IV. She was granted asylum aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise in 2368.

name: Type VI Shuttlecraft (Premiere Remastered)
keywords: Federation ship; No staffing requirement; Shuttlecraft;
lore: Modern Federation shuttle with warp capability. May be armed for special missions.

name: U.S.S. Excelsior (Premiere Remastered)
text: Tractor Beam
lore: First launched in 2284 as a test for what proved to be the unsuccessful transwarp project. Refitted to use standard warp drive.

name: U.S.S. Galaxy (Premiere Remastered)
keywords: Federation ship; Holodeck; Prototype; Tractor Beam;
text: Holodeck, Tractor Beam
lore: Prototype in this elite class of ships was the U.S.S. Galaxy, after which the class was named.

name: U.S.S. Miranda (Premiere Remastered)
text: Tractor Beam
lore: Small ship class from the late 23rd century. Named for a character in Shakespeare's play, The Tempest.

name: U.S.S. Nebula (Premiere Remastered)
text: Holodeck, Tractor Beam
lore: Modern class of ship featuring large upper equipment modules customizable for specific mission uses.

name: U.S.S. Oberth (Premiere Remastered)
text: Tractor Beam
lore: Class of small ships often used for scientific missions. Named for 20th century rocket scientist Hermann Oberth.

name: Varel (Premiere Remastered)
text: SCIENCE Physics Computer Skill Youth
lore: Representative of female Romulans trained in the field of science. Assigned to assist with an interphase generator project.

name: Vekma (Premiere Remastered)
keywords: Klingon; Female; I.K.S. Pagh-related personnel; Mission Specialist;
text: MEDICAL Honor
lore: Klingon female trained in Klingon anatomy and medicine. Propositioned William T. Riker on the I.K.S. Pagh in 2365.

name: Albert Einstein (Premiere Remastered)
text: SCIENCE Physics x 2 Astrophysics
lore: Holographic re-creation. He is based on the famed 20th century physicist and author of the theory of relativity.

name: Batrell (Premiere Remastered)
text: OFFICER Honor
lore: Klingon representative of officers trained for the Klingon Defense Force. He was formerly in command of the Narendra III outpost.

name: B'iJik (Premiere Remastered)
text: OFFICER Navigation
lore: Typical Klingon male trained as an officer for the Klingon Defense Force. Served as junior adjutant to the diplomatic delegation for Gowron.

name: Calloway (Premiere Remastered)
keywords: Human; Female; Mission Specialist; U.S.S. Enterprise-related personnel;
text: MEDICAL Youth
lore: Human ensign who is representative of Starfleet medical technicians. She served aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise in 2370.

name: Christopher Hobson (Premiere Remastered)
text: OFFICER Computer Skill
lore: Lieutenant commander representative of human officers in Starfleet. He served aboard the U.S.S. Sutherland in 2368.

name: Combat Vessel (Premiere Remastered)
lore: A little-known class of attack craft. One such vessel attacked the U.S.S. Enterprise in 2368 at a surplus depot orbiting Qualor II.

name: Darian Wallace (Premiere Remastered)
keywords: Human; Male; Mission Specialist; U.S.S. Enterprise-related personnel;
text: SECURITY Anthropology
lore: Human ensign. Representative of Starfleet security officers. He has held numerous positions aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise.

name: D'deridex (Premiere Remastered)
keywords: Cloaking Device; Romulan ship; Tractor Beam;
text: Cloaking Device, Tractor Beam
lore: Imperial Romulan Warbird. A massive ship significantly larger than a Galaxy-class starship.

name: Divok (Premiere Remastered)
text: MEDICAL Biology Youth
lore: One of many trained in Klingon anatomy and medicine. He studied the effects of tribbles on the Klingon nervous system.

name: Dr. Farek (Premiere Remastered)
text: MEDICAL Greed
lore: Dr. Farek is representative of male Ferengi trained in medicine. Threatened to seize control of the D'Kora-class Ferengi Marauder Krayton in 2366.

name: Dr. Leah Brahms (Premiere Remastered)
text: ENGINEER ENGINEER
lore: Holographic re-creation. She told Geordi La Forge "Every time you look at this engine, you're looking at me. Every time you touch it, it's me."

name: Dukath (Premiere Remastered)
keywords: Klingon; I.K.S. Pagh-related personnel; Male; Mission Specialist;
text: SCIENCE Archaeology
lore: Klingon characteristic of those trained in the field of science. Studied the effects of Berthold rays on plant life. He served aboard the I.K.S. Pagh.

name: Exocomp (Premiere Remastered)
text: ENGINEER On your ship, repairs damage (as if docked).
lore: Sentient inorganic life-form considered by many to be its own species, not merely a tool. Created by Dr. Farallon. It uses a microreplicator to make repairs.

name: Fek'lhr (Premiere Remastered)
text: V.I.P. Honor Treachery
lore: Holographic re-creation of mythical Klingon beast. He is the guardian of Gre'thor, where the dishonored go to die.

name: Galathon (Premiere Remastered)
text: OFFICER Archaeology Greed Treachery
lore: Romulan officer representative of those serving the Romulan Star Empire. He pursued the DNA program in 2369.

name: Giusti (Premiere Remastered)
keywords: Human; Female; Mission Specialist; U.S.S. Enterprise-related personnel;
text: OFFICER Youth
lore: Ensign representative of human staff officers in Starfleet. She served at the Ops console aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise in 2370.

name: Gorath (Premiere Remastered)
keywords: Klingon; High Council; Male; Mission Specialist;
text: SECURITY Honor
lore: Typical Klingon trained in security. Guarded the High Council chamber in the year of Maktag. He served as security chief for the Hegh'bat division.

name: Gorta (Premiere Remastered)
text: ENGINEER Physics Greed
lore: Male of Dopterian race. Representative of non-aligned agents. An opportunist. Had an encounter with the Sisters of Duras in 2370.

name: Husnock Ship (Premiere Remastered)
text: Holodeck, Tractor Beam
lore: With a single thought, Kevin Uxbridge killed the entire Husnock race (50 billion lives) everywhere in the universe. Their powerful ships remain.

name: I.K.S. K'Vort (Premiere Remastered)
keywords: Bird-of-Prey; Cloaking Device; Klingon ship; Tractor Beam;
text: Cloaking Device, Tractor Beam
lore: Class of ships identical in configuration to the classic B'rel-class Klingon Bird-of-Prey, although much larger.

name: I.K.S. Vor'Cha (Premiere Remastered)
keywords: Cloaking Device; Klingon ship; Tractor Beam;
text: Cloaking Device, Tractor Beam
lore: Large attack cruiser. The modern mainstay of the Klingon Defense Force.

name: Jaron (Premiere Remastered)
text: SECURITY Geology Youth
lore: One of many Romulans trained in the field of security. He is rumored to be a former member of the Tal Shiar intelligence service.

name: J'Dan (Premiere Remastered)
text: SCIENCE Exobiology Treachery
lore: One of many Klingons trained in the field of science. He smuggled Federation secrets to the Romulans in the form of amino acid codes.

name: Jera (Premiere Remastered)
text: MEDICAL Biology Youth
lore: Holographic re-creation of a female Romulan. An alien entity assumed this form in 2369.

name: Klag (Premiere Remastered)
keywords: Klingon; I.K.S. Pagh-related personnel; Male; Mission Specialist;
text: OFFICER Navigation
lore: Second officer of the I.K.S. Pagh. He is representative of Klingon warriors throughout the Klingon Empire.

name: Kle'eg (Premiere Remastered)
text: SECURITY Honor
lore: Typical Klingon trained in the specific field of security. He was a bodyguard for the House of K'mpec when K'mpec was poisoned in 2367.

name: Kromm (Premiere Remastered)
text: ENGINEER Physics
lore: Klingon characteristic of those trained in the field of engineering. He is reputed to have consumed fifteen rokeg blood pies in one sitting.

name: K'Tesh (Premiere Remastered)
text: ENGINEER Stellar Cartography
lore: Typical holographic re-creation for simulated Age of Ascension rituals. He is based on the engineer who perfected current painstik design for ritual use.

name: Linda Larson (Premiere Remastered)
text: ENGINEER Youth
lore: Human lieutenant. She is representative of staff engineers serving in Starfleet.

name: McKnight (Premiere Remastered)
text: OFFICER Navigation Youth Music
lore: Human ensign who is one of many helm officers serving aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise. She is a distant relative of a famous 20th century game designer.

name: Mendon (Premiere Remastered)
keywords: Benzite; Male; Mission Specialist; U.S.S. Enterprise-related personnel;
text: SCIENCE Physics
lore: Benzite ensign representative of science specialists within Starfleet. He served aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise in 2365. Looks like Mordock.

name: Mercenary Ship (Premiere Remastered)
text: Long-Range Scan Shielding
lore: Little-known ship. Difficult to track due to a unique hull design that renders it invisible to long-range scans. Baran captained one in 2370.

name: Narik (Premiere Remastered)
keywords: Male; Mission Specialist; Stone of Gol-related personnel;
text: ENGINEER Computer Skill
lore: Representative of male mercenaries operating throughout the galaxy. Boslic who worked with Baran to find the Stone of Gol.

name: Palteth (Premiere Remastered)
text: ENGINEER Computer Skill
lore: Typical Romulan trained in the field of engineering. A specialist in artificial quantum singularities. He served aboard the Khazara in 2369.

name: Runabout (Premiere Remastered)
lore: Auxiliary support vehicle. Contains living accommodations. Modular design can be re-configured for different mission profiles.

name: Science Vessel (Premiere Remastered)
lore: Specialized science ship used for an Interphase Generator experiment in 2368.

name: Scout Vessel (Premiere Remastered)
keywords: No staffing requirement; Romulan ship; Scout;
lore: Class of small, versatile ships used by the Romulan Star Empire for reconnaissance and science missions.

name: Selok (Premiere Remastered)
text: V.I.P. Treachery
lore: Subcommander and female Romulan agent. Successfully posed as T'Pel, a Vulcan ambassador.

name: Simon Tarses (Premiere Remastered)
text: MEDICAL Youth
lore: Crewman first class. Representative of Starfleet medical technicians. He is 1/4 Romulan, 3/4 human.

name: Sir Isaac Newton (Premiere Remastered)
text: SCIENCE Physics x 2
lore: Holographic re-creation. He is based on the famous 17th and 18th century mathematician, who originated the classic laws of physics.

name: Sito Jaxa (Premiere Remastered)
keywords: Bajoran; Female; Support Personnel; U.S.S. Enterprise-related personnel;
text: SECURITY Navigation Youth
lore: Bajoran ensign. She is one of a number of navigation officers aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise.

name: Taitt (Premiere Remastered)
keywords: Human; Female; Support Personnel; U.S.S. Enterprise-related personnel;
text: SCIENCE Stellar Cartography Geology
lore: Human ensign representative of science specialists from Starfleet Academy. She helped the U.S.S. Enterprise destroy a Borg vessel in 2370.

name: Takket (Premiere Remastered)
text: MEDICAL Exobiology
lore: Typical Romulan male trained in Romulan anatomy and medicine. Extensively trained in exobiology.

name: Tallus (Premiere Remastered)
text: OFFICER Leadership
lore: Romulan officer representative of those serving the Romulan Star Empire. He is a former commander of private forces under Sela.

name: Tarus (Premiere Remastered)
text: SCIENCE Stellar Cartography
lore: Representative of male Romulans trained in the field of science. Specialist in the study of extra-dimensional life-forms.

name: Taul (Premiere Remastered)
text: SECURITY Treachery Archaeology
lore: Typical Romulan male trained in the field of security. Assistant to Commander Konsab of the Romulan Intelligence Academy.

name: Taurik (Premiere Remastered)
text: ENGINEER Mindmeld
lore: Vulcan lieutenant. He is representative of engineering junior officers serving in Starfleet.

name: Thei (Premiere Remastered)
text: OFFICER Geology Physics
lore: Subcommander representative of officers serving in the Romulan Star Empire. He was an ally of the Sisters of Duras during the Klingon Civil War.

name: Tomek (Premiere Remastered)
text: ENGINEER Astrophysics
lore: Holographic re-creation of a male Romulan. An alien entity assumed this form in 2369.

name: Torin (Premiere Remastered)
text: SCIENCE Astrophysics
lore: One of many Klingons trained in the field of science. He studied the effects of warp propulsion on subspace.

name: Vekor (Premiere Remastered)
text: SCIENCE MEDICAL Navigation Geology
lore: Representative of female humanoid mercenaries operating throughout the galaxy. Worked with Baran to find the Stone of Gol.

name: Benjamin Maxwell (Premiere Remastered)
text: OFFICER Leadership
lore: Human captain of the U.S.S. Phoenix. He has a bitter hatred of the Cardassians, after his family was killed during a Cardassian attack.

name: B'Etor (Premiere Remastered)
text: V.I.P. Treachery Leadership Physics Youth Greed
lore: Plotted with Lursa to seize power from Gowron with the support of the Romulans. Younger of the two Duras sisters. The pretty one.

name: Beverly Crusher (Premiere Remastered)
text: MEDICAL MEDICAL Biology Exobiology
lore: Human doctor and chief medical officer of the U.S.S. Enterprise. Dancer and thespian. Widow of Jack Crusher. Mother of Wesley Crusher.

name: Birth of "Junior" (Premiere Remastered)
text: Place on ship. End of each turn, reduces RANGE by 1; if this reduces RANGE below 1 (or RANGE already below 1), destroys ship. Nullify with 3 ENGINEER.
lore: Large infant spaceborne life-form. Attached itself to the U.S.S. Enterprise in 2368, sucking energy from the ship.

name: Disruptor Overload (Premiere Remastered)
text: Plays on either player's crew or Away Team (except on their facility). Destroys one of that player's non-[Shield][Equipment] present (random selection).
lore: A directed-energy weapon can be set on overload and left to explode like a bomb.

name: Distortion Field (Premiere Remastered)
text: Plays on a [P]. End of each turn (even while face down), flip card over. While face up, prevents all beaming to or from this planet. (Unique.)
lore: Atmospheric phenomena that inhibits use of transporters, as on Nervala IV.

name: Distortion of Space/Time Continuum (Premiere Remastered)
text: Plays on your non-[AU] ship just after opponent plays an [AU] card. You may discard to unstop ship and crew OR restore full RANGE OR unstop an Away Team here. (Unique.)
lore: Time effects can be caused by the unusual warping or rifting of space.

name: Yridian Shuttle (Premiere Remastered)
lore: Common shuttlecraft used by Yridian agents and others for covert activities.

name: Zibalian Transport (Premiere Remastered)
keywords: Merchant vessel; No staffing requirement; Transport;
lore: Common class of merchant vessel used by traders such as Kivas Fajo.

name: Alexander Rozhenko (Premiere Remastered)
text: CIVILIAN Honor Youth
lore: 3/4 Klingon, 1/4 human son of Worf and K'Ehleyr. He was born on the 43rd day of Maktag.

name: Alidar Jarok (Premiere Remastered)
text: OFFICER Navigation Leadership
lore: Conscientious admiral who questioned Romulan policy. He eventually stole a scout ship and defected to the Federation in 2366.

name: Alien Abduction (Premiere Remastered)
text: Places most CUNNING Away Team member atop mission (in stasis) with dilemma. Cure with 3 Leadership. Released when mission completed (discard dilemma).
lore: Solanogen-based aliens, existing in a subspace domain, can access our universe and abduct humanoids for study.

name: Alien Groupie (Premiere Remastered)
text: Plays on an Away Team that just solved a planet mission. One male present (random selection) is stopped until countdown expires.
lore: Lanel, a Malcorian nurse, agreed to help William T. Riker, but only if he would

name: Alien Parasites (Premiere Remastered)
text: Unless INTEGRITY>32, opponent controls Away Team and/or your ship and crew here (opponent's choice) until start of your next turn (not compatible with opponent's other cards).
lore: Intelligent parasites that take control of humanoids. Can be detected by a gill-like protrusion on the back of a host's neck.

name: Alien Probe (Premiere Remastered)
text: Plays on table. Players play with their hands revealed.
lore: Space probes of unknown origin are frequently encountered by starships. Often such probes seek information or contact.

name: Alynna Nechayev (Premiere Remastered)
text: OFFICER Diplomacy Leadership
lore: Human admiral and antagonistic superior of Jean-Luc Picard. She was often responsible for liaising on matters relating to the Cardassians or the Maquis.

name: Alyssa Ogawa (Premiere Remastered)
text: MEDICAL Biology
lore: Human nurse and medical assistant. She is a trusted friend and colleague of Beverly Crusher. Promoted to lieutenant junior grade in 2370.

name: Amanda Rogers (Premiere Remastered)
text: Nullifies an [Interrupt] being played (except [Shield]). Place this [Interrupt] out-of-play.
lore: Female Q raised as a human on Earth. Was taken to the Q continuum by Q after she could not resist the benevolent use of her powers.

name: Amarie (Premiere Remastered)
text: CIVILIAN Music
lore: Four-armed pianist. Humanoid information broker and ex-wife of an arms smuggler. Lounge performer on Qualor II, she knows Aktuh and Melota. Salt sucker.

name: Anaphasic Organism (Premiere Remastered)
text: Unless MEDICAL and SECURITY present, discards female with highest total attributes. Discard dilemma.
lore: A male non-corporeal life-form that lives inside a female host which he enchants, as in the case of Beverly Crusher's late grandmother.

name: Ancient Computer (Premiere Remastered)
text: Cannot get past unless 2 Computer Skill OR 3 SCIENCE OR 3 ENGINEER present.
lore: Vital information can be retrieved from old or damaged computer systems like this one aboard a derelict Promellian battlecruiser.

name: Anti-Time Anomaly (Premiere Remastered)
text: Plays on table. At the start of each turn, opponent may [Flip] one ship at {any Devron System}. When countdown expires, each player shuffles all personnel in play (even "for uniqueness only") that they own into their draw decks.
lore: Oh! Nothing happened. See what you've done? " I caused the anomaly, and the anomaly somehow disrupted the beginnings of life on Earth?"

name: Archer (Premiere Remastered)
text: Unless MEDICAL and SECURITY present, kills Away Team member with highest total attributes. Discard dilemma.
lore: Indigenous inhabitants, such as this Mintakan bowman, often attack an Away Team out of fear.

name: Armus: Skin Of Evil (Premiere Remastered)
text: Kills one Away Team member (random selection).
lore: A malevolent being was formed when the inhabitants of Vagra II rid themselves of all the evil they had inside.

name: Asteroid Sanctuary (Premiere Remastered)
text: Plays on your exposed ship (even at the start of battle). While your 2 Navigation aboard, cancels any battle initiated against it. Discard at end of turn.
lore: Hoping to avoid detection by a Romulan Warbird, the U.S.S. Enterprise entered a giant asteroid cavern in 2370.

name: Atmospheric Ionization (Premiere Remastered)
text: Plays on a [P]. Personnel may only beam to/from this planet one at a time, and only if their controller has beamed no more than three personnel this way this turn. (Unique.)
lore: Charged particles in the atmosphere of planets which can disrupt transporter beams.

name: Auto-Destruct Sequence (Premiere Remastered)
text: Plays on your ship. When countdown expires, destroys ship. Then, damages all other ships present with SHIELDS<8.
lore: Computer controlled self-destruct countdown which can be set by the senior officers aboard a ship. The explosion can damage nearby ships.

name: Morag (Premiere Remastered)
text: OFFICER Computer Skill Greed
lore: Klingon officer. He stole Federation data from Relay Station 47.

name: Morgan Bateson (Premiere Remastered)
text: OFFICER Leadership Stellar Cartography
lore: Human captain of the U.S.S. Bozeman. He and his crew were caught in a temporal causality loop from 2278 to 2368. Born in Seattle.

name: Mot the Barber (Premiere Remastered)
keywords: Bolian; Male; Mission Specialist; U.S.S. Enterprise-related personnel;
text: CIVILIAN Barbering
lore: Bolian male. Convivial barber aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise. Snappy conversationalist.

name: Movar (Premiere Remastered)
keywords: Romulan; Duras-related; General; Male; Support Personnel;
text: OFFICER Treachery Anthropology
lore: Romulan general. He secretly provided military supplies to Duras family forces during the Klingon Civil War in 2368.

name: Taibak (Premiere Remastered)
text: SCIENCE Treachery Biology Computer Skill
lore: Scientist who developed a mind control device using E-band emissions. He controlled Geordi La Forge through his VISOR.

name: Tam Elbrun (Premiere Remastered)
text: V.I.P. Empathy x 2 Honor
lore: Betazoid male with exceptional empathic abilities. Participated in the notorious Ghorusda disaster. Specialist in first contact with new life-forms.

name: Tarellian Plague Ship (Premiere Remastered)
text: Beams a personnel (your choice) to this card (in space), if possible. Score points if MEDICAL aboard this card. If not, your crew dies. Discard dilemma.
lore: Ship containing the survivors of a plague. Infected from biological weapons, they are now refused entry everywhere.

name: Tasha Yar (Premiere Remastered)
keywords: Human; Female; Support Personnel; U.S.S. Enterprise-related personnel;
text: SECURITY Honor Leadership
lore: Lieutenant who served as chief of security on the U.S.S. Enterprise. Courageous human orphan from Turkana IV. She proved Data fully functional.

name: Avert Disaster (Premiere Remastered)
text: Geology + Honor + INTEGRITY>35
lore: Aid project to delay solidification of the planet's core.

name: Ba'el (Premiere Remastered)
text: CIVILIAN Anthropology Youth
lore: 1/2 Klingon, 1/2 Romulan. Briefly romantically involved with Worf. She was born in a Romulan prison camp on Carraya IV.

name: Baran (Premiere Remastered)
keywords: Captain; Male; Stone of Gol-related personnel;
text: OFFICER Greed Archaeology Exobiology Computer Skill
lore: Male humanoid captain of a mercenary ship raiding archaeological sites to find the Stone of Gol.

name: Barclay's Protomorphosis Disease (Premiere Remastered)
text: Unless MEDICAL, SCIENCE, and SECURITY present, kills all personnel present (except inorganics). Otherwise, score points. Discard dilemma.
lore: Contagious affliction which causes animals to de-evolve into ancestral forms. Disease named for Reginald Barclay.

name: Bochra (Premiere Remastered)
text: OFFICER Navigation Youth
lore: Centurion serving the Romulan Star Empire. He was once marooned on Galorndon Core with Geordi La Forge.

name: Bok (Premiere Remastered)
text: OFFICER Greed ENGINEER Treachery Computer Skill
lore: Former Ferengi DaiMon. His son was killed by Jean-Luc Picard in battle. Seeks revenge at all costs.

name: Borg Ship (Premiere Remastered)
text: Place at furthest spaceline end. End of every turn: Attacks all ships, then moves. Worth points if destroyed in battle.
lore: Gigantic cubic ship of the Borg collective. Possesses powerful weapons and remarkable regenerative abilities

name: Bynars Weapon Enhancement (Premiere Remastered)
text: Plays on ship. Ship is WEAPONS +2. (Cumulative.)
lore: Binary race closely integrated with computers. Always work in pairs. Bynars have the ability to enhance specific computerized systems.

name: Chalnoth (Premiere Remastered)
text: Unless 3 SECURITY OR STRENGTH>40 present, kills one Away Team member (opponent's choice). Otherwise, score points. Discard dilemma.
lore: Anarchistic lupine race of humanoids with the reputation of violent responses to a variety of situations.

name: Cloaked Mission (Premiere Remastered)
text: Navigation + Diplomacy + Honor
lore: Secretly escort covert operatives to the Romulan homeworld.

name: Cosmic String Fragment (Premiere Remastered)
text: Unless ENGINEER OR Astrophysics OR Navigation present, destroys ship. Otherwise, score points. Discard dilemma.
lore: A long space object as thin as a proton but with the gravitational attraction of a hundred stars.

name: Covert Installation (Premiere Remastered)
keywords: Listening Post mission; Neutral Zone Region;
text: ENGINEER + Leadership + Treachery
lore: Build hidden listening post in the Neutral Zone.

name: Covert Rescue (Premiere Remastered)
text: Diplomacy + Leadership + CUNNING>35
lore: Retrieve crashed scout ship in Federation territory.

name: Crosis (Premiere Remastered)
text: Plays on a ship. Doubles STRENGTH of all {Rogue Borg} present. At start of next turn, discard interrupt. (May be targeted as a Rogue Borg by {Six of Nineteen}.)
lore: Fanatical Borg lieutenant of Lore. Captured Data with the lure of emotions.

name: Crystalline Entity (Premiere Remastered)
text: [P]: Unless MEDICAL and SCIENCE, kills Away Team. [S]: Unless Music OR SHIELDS>6, kills all personnel on ship. Then: Discard dilemma. Score points if overcome.
lore: Spaceborne life-form that converts biological matter to energy. Sensitive to graviton pulse resonance, shattering like crystal.

name: Cultural Observation (Premiere Remastered)
text: Anthropology + Leadership + STRENGTH>30
lore: Aid observation of primitive society.

name: Cytherians (Premiere Remastered)
text: Attempt ends. Target location at this spaceline's far end. Place on ship; it must do nothing but move towards there. Discard when reached (score points).
lore: Race which explores the galaxy by giving other species the temporary ability and strong compulsion to come to them.

name: Data (Premiere Remastered)
text: OFFICER ENGINEER Computer Skill x 2 Music Astrophysics Exobiology
lore: Sentient Soong-type android created by Dr. Soong. Desires to be human. Lieutenant commander with a positronic brain. Once left his head in San Francisco.

name: Deanna Troi (Premiere Remastered)
keywords: Betazoid/Human; Counselor; Female; Support Personnel; U.S.S. Enterprise-related personnel;
text: OFFICER Empathy Diplomacy
lore: 1/2 Betazoid, 1/2 human empath. Imzadi to William T. Riker. Counselor and lieutenant commander serving on the U.S.S. Enterprise. She loves chocolate.

name: Devinoni Ral (Premiere Remastered)
text: V.I.P. Empathy Diplomacy Treachery
lore: 1/4 Betazoid, 3/4 human. Skilled negotiator. Abused his empathic powers to gain advantage. Became romantically involved with Deanna Troi.

name: Devoras (Premiere Remastered)
keywords: Cloaking Device; Romulan ship; Tractor Beam;
text: Cloaking Device, Tractor Beam
lore: Warbird used to accomplish the escape of Romulan spy Selok from the Federation in 2367. Commanded by Admiral Mendak.

name: Diplomacy Mission (Premiere Remastered)
text: Diplomacy + INTEGRITY>30 + CUNNING>30
lore: Mediate dispute between civilizations on Peliar Zel's two moons.

name: Dr. La Forge (Premiere Remastered)
text: SCIENCE Exobiology
lore: Dr. La Forge is a Starfleet specialist in xenology and exobiology. Human father of Geordi La Forge. He is the husband of Silva La Forge.

name: Dr. Reyga (Premiere Remastered)
text: SCIENCE ENGINEER Stellar Cartography Astrophysics
lore: Ferengi male scientist. Inventor of the revolutionary, but controversial, metaphasic shield technology. Endured skepticism from the scientific community.

name: Gaps in Normal Space (Premiere Remastered)
text: Insert in spaceline between two missions as a span 4 [S] location. When a ship moves to here, randomly kills a personnel aboard. If nullified, cards here relocate to adjacent location if possible (your choice).
lore: Pockets of space containing dark matter, such as those found in the Mar Oscura nebula, can dangerously phase out when coming into contact with a ship.

name: Ocett (Premiere Remastered)
text: OFFICER Archaeology Navigation Honor
lore: Cardassian female officer. Commander of the Bralek. Gul who pursued the DNA program.

name: Roga Danar (Premiere Remastered)
text: SECURITY ENGINEER Computer Skill Biology Leadership
lore: Angosian male. Biochemically altered into a formidable perfect warrior ranked Subhadar.

name: Rogue Borg (Premiere Remastered)
text: Plays on an occupied ship. X = Number of Rogue Borg present; they form an Away Team. End of every player's turn: That Away Team battles that player's personnel present.
lore: Upon Hugh's return to the Borg collective, those Borg became self-aware. Soon, many followed their first leader, Lore.

name: Romulan Disruptor (Premiere Remastered)
text: If your [Rom] or [Non] personnel present, each of your personnel present is STRENGTH +2. (Cumulative.)
lore: Directed-energy weapon used by Romulans and other races. Disruptor fire can be identified by a high residue of antiprotons that linger for several hours.

name: Romulan Outpost (Premiere Remastered)
text: Seed one OR build where you have a Romulan ENGINEER.
lore: Romulus is one of the two homeworlds for the Romulans. The Romulan Star Empire establishes outposts throughout its territory.

name: Romulan PADD (Premiere Remastered)
text: If your [Rom] personnel present, each of your personnel present is CUNNING +2. (Cumulative.)
lore: Standard Romulan Personal Access Display Device for computerized information.

name: Thomas Riker (Premiere Remastered)
text: OFFICER Leadership Navigation Geology Music
lore: Starfleet lieutenant. Human double of William T. Riker. He was created during a transporter accident in 2361.

name: Thought Maker (Premiere Remastered)
text: Place in hand. Plays as [Interrupt]: Name a card type, then take all cards with that card type from opponent's draw deck, shuffle them, and place them on bottom of deck.
lore: Outlawed Ferengi mind control device. Transmits signals that implant sensory experiences and triggers emotions and memories.

name: Dr. Selar (Premiere Remastered)
keywords: Vulcan; Female; Support Personnel; U.S.S. Enterprise-related personnel;
text: MEDICAL Computer Skill Mindmeld
lore: Dr. Selar is a female Vulcan medical doctor. Served aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise for many years.

name: Duras (Premiere Remastered)
text: V.I.P. Leadership Computer Skill Treachery Greed
lore: Son of Ja'rod. Contender for leadership of the Klingon High Council. Member of a powerful political family.

name: El-Adrel Creature (Premiere Remastered)
text: Targets the two strongest members in Away Team (your choice if tie). Unless they have STRENGTH>16, kills one of them (random selection). Discard dilemma.
lore: Nearly invisible predatory electromagnetic creature. First encountered by the Tamarian Dathon and the human Jean-Luc Picard on El-Adrel IV.

name: Emergency Transporter Armbands (Premiere Remastered)
text: Plays on your crew or Away Team, even during battle or while facing an [ETA] dilemma. Any of your personnel present may immediately beam away. (May not be played while two adversaries are in combat.)
lore: Devices which allow quick remote activation of a transporter when in danger.

name: Energy Vortex (Premiere Remastered)
text: Plays while opponent's normal card play is being played. Cancels that card play; card returns to hand. Opponent may play a different card as their normal card play instead. (Other costs remain paid.)
lore: Whirlpool-like space/time phenomena that can destroy a ship, as it nearly did the U.S.S. Enterprise in 2365.

name: Engineering Kit (Premiere Remastered)
text: Your OFFICER-classification personnel present gain ENGINEER.
lore: Representative of specialized engineering instruments. Such equipment has been developed by many races.

name: Engineering PADD (Premiere Remastered)
text: Your SCIENCE-classification personnel present gain ENGINEER.
lore: Representative of Personal Access Display Devices designed specifically for engineering functions. Such equipment has been developed by many races.

name: Erik Pressman (Premiere Remastered)
keywords: Human; Admiral; Captain; Male; Support Personnel;
text: OFFICER ENGINEER Treachery
lore: Human admiral and former captain of the U.S.S. Pegasus, which was lost in space following a failed experiment he oversaw

name: Escape Pod (Premiere Remastered)
text: Plays at a location just after your ship there is destroyed; relocate its crew(s) atop this card. You may later relocate them to your ship here, then discard interrupt.
lore: Angosian escape pod used by Roga Danar in 2366. Escape pods can be used in an emergency to save a crew.

name: Espionage: Federation on Klingon (Premiere Remastered)
text: Plays on a [KLI] mission. Your cards may attempt it as if it were [FED]. Discard when solved (just after points are scored).
lore: Federation intelligence-gathering has often relied upon sympathetic informants and electronic surveillance.

name: Espionage: Klingon on Federation (Premiere Remastered)
text: Plays on a [FED] mission. Your cards may attempt it as if it were [KLI]. Discard when solved (just after points are scored).
lore: Klingon espionage against the Federation has included data stolen from Relay Station 47 by Morag.

name: Espionage: Romulan on Federation (Premiere Remastered)
text: Plays on a [FED] mission. Your cards may attempt it as if it were [ROM]. Discard when solved (just after points are scored).
lore: Romulan spies are everywhere.

name: Espionage: Romulan on Klingon (Premiere Remastered)
text: Plays on a [KLI] mission. Your cards may attempt it as if it were [ROM]. Discard when solved (just after points are scored).
lore: Romulan espionage against Klingons has included efforts to de-stabilize the Klingon government by programming assassins and supporting rebel forces.

name: Etana Jol (Premiere Remastered)
text: SCIENCE Treachery Biology
lore: Ktarian female. Attempted to use a psychotropically addictive game to gain control of the Federation in 2368.

name: Evacuation (Premiere Remastered)
text: Diplomacy x3 + STRENGTH>35
lore: Evacuate American Indian colony.

name: Evaluate Terraforming (Premiere Remastered)
text: MEDICAL + Biology + Exobiology OR {Geordi La Forge} + MEDICAL x2
lore: Evaluate progress of terraforming station.

name: Evek (Premiere Remastered)
text: OFFICER Diplomacy Leadership Anthropology
lore: Gul Evek, Cardassian male officer. Administers area ceded to Cardassians in a treaty with the Federation.

name: Excavation (Premiere Remastered)
text: Archaeology OR CUNNING>32
lore: Assist new archaeological dig.

name: Explore Black Cluster (Premiere Remastered)
text: Stellar Cartography + Leadership OR CUNNING>50
lore: Study and evaluate enormous cluster of collapsed proto-stars.

name: Explore Dyson Sphere (Premiere Remastered)
text: ENGINEER x3 + Navigation + Computer Skill + Physics
lore: Study gigantic structure completely enclosing a star.

name: Explore Typhon Expanse (Premiere Remastered)
text: Astrophysics + Stellar Cartography OR CUNNING>50
lore: Trace time distortion reported in this desolate region.

name: Expose Covert Supply (Premiere Remastered)
text: Treachery x3 + Navigation
lore: Uncover covert supply lines supporting rebels on the Klingon homeworld.

name: Extraction (Premiere Remastered)
text: Treachery + Biology + MEDICAL
lore: Secretly acquire age-reversal drug reportedly under development.

name: Federation Outpost (Premiere Remastered)
text: Seed one OR build where you have a Federation ENGINEER.
lore: Earth is a member of the United Federation of Planets. The Federation establishes outposts throughout its territory.

name: Federation PADD (Premiere Remastered)
text: If your [Fed] personnel present, each of your personnel present is CUNNING +2. (Cumulative.)
lore: Standard Federation Personal Access Display Device for computerized information.

name: Female's Love Interest (Premiere Remastered)
text: Relocates a female present (random selection) to furthest different planet on this spaceline.
lore: Contact with new civilizations may lead to romantic entanglements.

name: Fever Emergency (Premiere Remastered)
text: MEDICAL x3 OR Biology + OFFICER
lore: Coordinate aid for Correllium Fever outbreak.

name: Firestorm (Premiere Remastered)
text: Kills all Away Team members with INTEGRITY<5. Discard dilemma.
lore: With advanced technology, personnel can work together to survive natural phenomenon such as the firestorms on Bersallis III.

name: First Contact (Premiere Remastered)
text: Diplomacy + Empathy
lore: Make initial contact with advancing civilization.

name: Fleet Admiral Shanthi (Premiere Remastered)
text: OFFICER Leadership Diplomacy
lore: Human admiral. She authorized the blockade of Romulan forces covertly supporting the Klingon Civil War in 2368.

name: Full Planet Scan (Premiere Remastered)
text: Plays at the start of your turn on your ship with at least two staffing icons at a [P] mission. Stop your Computer Skill and Geology aboard to examine the bottom seed card here.
lore: Sensor instruments can make detailed scans of a planet surface and atmosphere.

name: Genetronic Replicator (Premiere Remastered)
text: Plays on table. When a personnel is targeted to die, you may stop 2 MEDICAL present (who are not also targeted to die) to return that personnel to hand instead.
lore: Medical device invented by Toby Russell. Capable of growing replacements for damaged organs.

name: Geordi La Forge (Premiere Remastered)
text: ENGINEER ENGINEER Navigation Physics Computer Skill
lore: Human lieutenant commander and chief engineer of the U.S.S. Enterprise. He has a great sense of humor and is an experienced holodeck programmer.

name: Goddess of Empathy (Premiere Remastered)
text: Plays on table. [Interrupt] cards (except [Ref], [Q], Kevin Uxbridge, and Q2) cannot be played.
lore: Reginald Barclay created a fantasy holodeck simulation of Deanna Troi. Her empathic abilities help other personnel anticipate danger.

name: Gowron (Premiere Remastered)
keywords: Klingon; Duras-related; High Council; High Council Leader; Male;
text: V.I.P. Leadership x 2 Diplomacy Honor
lore: Son of M'Rel. Leader of the Klingon High Council after defeating the Duras forces in the Klingon Civil War of 2367-68.

name: Gravitic Mine (Premiere Remastered)
text: Unless SCIENCE and Navigation present, damages ship. Discard dilemma.
lore: Free-floating weapon used against space vehicles. The U.S.S. Denver struck such a mine, which caused it to crash in the Mericor System.

name: Hologram Ruse (Premiere Remastered)
text: To get past requires INTEGRITY>30 and CUNNING>30.
lore: Holograms can be used to create realistic fantasy worlds.

name: Holo-Projectors (Premiere Remastered)
text: Plays on a [P]. [Holo] cards may exist on this planet (activated or deactivated). If nullified, [Holo] cards that depended on these Holo-Projectors for existence are erased.
lore: The hologram projector on Minos is an example of planet-based interactive holographic technology.

name: Honor Challenge (Premiere Remastered)
text: Plays at the start of a personnel battle. Each of your Klingons with Honor may kill an opposing personnel present with Treachery. (Cumulative.)
lore: The call to glory inspires the Klingon warrior to maximum fierceness and honor, as symbolized by the bat'leth championship trophy.

name: Horga'hn (Premiere Remastered)
text: Immediately plays on table. Each turn, gain an additional normal card play OR at end of turn, draw an extra card.
lore: Mysterious symbol of sexuality from the pleasure planet of Risa. To own one is to call forth its powers. To display one is to announce that the owner is seeking jamaharon.

name: Hugh (Premiere Remastered)
text: Plays to cancel a battle just initiated by a [Bor] card or {Borg Ship} dilemma. OR Plays to kill all {Rogue Borg} at one location.
lore: The Federation named a rescued Borg, Hugh. When he returned to the Collective, his newly acquired self-aware personality fragmented the Borg hive mind there.

name: Hunt for DNA Program (Premiere Remastered)
text: Archaeology x3 + Computer Skill + Biology + Leadership + STRENGTH>40
lore: Seek and secure last strand of DNA program on this desert planet.

name: Hyper-Aging (Premiere Remastered)
text: Place on Away Team; quarantined. If countdown expires, kills Away Team (except inorganics). Cure with 2 MEDICAL and SCIENCE (score points).
lore: Disease created accidentally at the Darwin Genetic Research Station on Gagarin IV. Causes rapid aging and death.

name: I.K.S. Bortas (Premiere Remastered)
keywords: Cloaking Device; Klingon ship; Tractor Beam;
text: Cloaking Device, Tractor Beam
lore: Flagship commanded by Gowron during the Klingon Civil War of 2367-68. Worf briefly served aboard as a weapons officer.

name: I.K.S. Buruk (Premiere Remastered)
keywords: Bird-of-Prey; Cloaking Device; Klingon ship; Tractor Beam;
text: Cloaking Device, Tractor Beam
lore: Klingon Bird-of-Prey used to transport Gowron to rendezvous with the U.S.S. Enterprise in 2367.

name: I.K.S. Hegh'ta (Premiere Remastered)
keywords: Bird-of-Prey; Cloaking Device; Klingon ship; Tractor Beam;
text: Cloaking Device, Tractor Beam
lore: Bird-of-Prey commanded by Kurn in support of Gowron during the Klingon Civil War of 2367-68.

name: I.K.S. Pagh (Premiere Remastered)
keywords: Cloaking Device; Klingon ship; Tractor Beam;
text: Cloaking Device, Tractor Beam
lore: Battle cruiser under the command of Kargan. William T. Riker served aboard as an exchange officer in 2365.

name: I.K.S. Qu'Vat (Premiere Remastered)
keywords: Cloaking Device; Klingon ship; Tractor Beam;
text: Cloaking Device, Tractor Beam
lore: Attack cruiser that carried Torak on an investigation into the death of a Starfleet officer at Relay Station 47.

name: I.K.S. Vorn (Premiere Remastered)
keywords: Bird-of-Prey; Cloaking Device; Duras-related; Klingon ship; Tractor Beam;
text: Cloaking Device, Tractor Beam
lore: Klingon Bird-of-Prey used to transport Duras to meet with the Klingon Arbiter of Succession in 2367.

name: Iconia Investigation (Premiere Remastered)
text: Archaeology + Computer Skill x2
lore: Investigate Federation incursion in the Neutral Zone.

name: Iconian Computer Weapon (Premiere Remastered)
text: Unless SCIENCE present, reveal hand, discarding all non-personnel cards revealed. Then, draw a card for each card discarded this way. Discard dilemma.
lore: Highly destructive virus from the ancient extinct Iconians. Transmitted to target vessels via a probe.

name: Impassable Door (Premiere Remastered)
text: To get past requires Computer Skill.
lore: Forcefields across door or hallway openings are commonly used to bar entry.

name: Incoming Message: Federation (Premiere Remastered)
text: Plays on a [Fed] ship; its controller targets one of their [Fed] facilities on this spaceline (nullified if none). Ship must do nothing but move toward it. Nullified on arrival at its location.
lore: Messages and directives are sent, faster than light, on subspace radio signals amplified by networks of relay stations.

name: Incoming Message: Klingon (Premiere Remastered)
text: Plays on a [Kli] ship; its controller targets one of their [Kli] facilities on this spaceline (nullified if none). Ship must do nothing but move toward it. Nullified on arrival at its location.
lore: Messages and directives are sent, faster than light, on subspace radio signals amplified by networks of relay stations.

name: Incoming Message: Romulan (Premiere Remastered)
text: Plays on a [Rom] ship; its controller targets one of their [Rom] facilities on this spaceline (nullified if none). Ship must do nothing but move toward it. Nullified on arrival at its location.
lore: Messages and directives are sent, faster than light, on subspace radio signals amplified by networks of relay stations.

name: Interphase Generator (Premiere Remastered)
text: Use as [Equipment]. Where present, nullifies [IPG] dilemmas.
lore: Experimental Romulan device that both cloaks and phases matter, allowing it to pass through normal matter.

name: Investigate "Shattered Space" (Premiere Remastered)
text: Leadership + Computer Skill + Astrophysics x2 + Stellar Cartography
lore: Study fragments of distorted space/time reported in this sector.

name: Investigate Alien Probe (Premiere Remastered)
text: Anthropology + Biology + Computer Skill
lore: Study and evaluate mysterious probe sighted in this sector.

name: Investigate Anomaly (Premiere Remastered)
text: Exobiology + STRENGTH>35
lore: Trace radiation anomalies reported at this location.

name: Investigate Disappearance (Premiere Remastered)
text: Physics + Navigation + CUNNING>40 OR Astrophysics x3
lore: Trace disappearance of a medical transport ship.

name: Investigate Disturbance (Premiere Remastered)
text: Honor + Leadership + INTEGRITY>30 OR {Gowron} + Biology
lore: Investigate disturbance at Boreth monastery.

name: Investigate Massacre (Premiere Remastered)
text: Diplomacy + INTEGRITY>35 + CUNNING>35
lore: Initiate investigation into destruction of distant outpost.

name: Investigate Raid (Premiere Remastered)
text: Exobiology + Diplomacy
lore: Investigate report of Borg attack.

name: Investigate Rogue Comet (Premiere Remastered)
text: Archaeology + Exobiology + Computer Skill
lore: Study unusual rogue comet sighted in this sector.

name: Investigate Sighting (Premiere Remastered)
text: Empathy x3 OR Treachery + Exobiology + CUNNING>40
lore: Investigate sighting of Gomtuu, an interstellar creature code-named Tin Man.

name: Investigate Time Continuum (Premiere Remastered)
text: {Guinan} OR {Data} OR discard your earned {Time Travel Pod} from play.
lore: Trace mysterious time-traveling aliens living in a parallel time continuum.

name: Ishara Yar (Premiere Remastered)
keywords: Human; Female; Support Personnel; U.S.S. Enterprise-related personnel;
text: CIVILIAN Treachery Youth
lore: Human sister of Tasha Yar. Once betrayed the U.S.S. Enterprise crew in an attempt to aid the rebels on Turkana IV.

name: Jaglom Shrek: Information Broker (Premiere Remastered)
text: Examine opponent's draw deck, then replace unshuffled.
lore: Yridian dealer of information who uncovered the Romulan prison camp in the Carraya system.

name: Jean-Luc Picard (Premiere Remastered)
keywords: Human; Captain; Male; U.S.S. Enterprise-related personnel;
text: OFFICER Diplomacy x 2 Leadership Honor Archaeology Navigation Music
lore: Captain of the U.S.S. Enterprise. Human born in LaBarre, France. He has an artificial heart. Reads Shakespeare. Something of a Renaissance man.

name: Jenna D'Sora (Premiere Remastered)
text: SECURITY Stellar Cartography Music
lore: Human lieutenant who was briefly romantically involved with Data after the android wooed her using crystilia flowers from Telemarius IV.

name: Jo'Bril (Premiere Remastered)
text: SCIENCE Treachery Astrophysics Physics Greed
lore: Takaran male. Attempted to steal Dr. Reyga's metaphasic shield technology to claim as his own.

name: Kahless (Premiere Remastered)
text: V.I.P. Honor x 2
lore: Cloned reincarnation of Klingon spiritual icon Kahless the Unforgettable. He was installed as ceremonial emperor in 2369.

name: Kareel Odan (Premiere Remastered)
keywords: Trill; Ambassador; Female; Support Personnel; Trill with symbiont;
text: V.I.P. Diplomacy Computer Skill
lore: Famous ambassador. Romantically involved with Beverly Crusher. Trill with symbiont who moved to this female host after the last host died in 2367.

name: Kargan (Premiere Remastered)
keywords: Klingon; Captain; I.K.S. Pagh-related personnel; Male; Support Personnel;
text: OFFICER Honor Computer Skill
lore: Captain of the I.K.S. Pagh. William T. Riker served under him as an exchange officer.

name: K'Ehleyr (Premiere Remastered)
text: V.I.P. Diplomacy Honor
lore: 1/2 Klingon, 1/2 human female. Federation ambassador to the K'mpec government. Mate of Worf. Mother of Alexander Rozhenko.

name: Kell (Premiere Remastered)
keywords: Klingon; High Council; Male; Mission Specialist;
text: V.I.P. Treachery
lore: High Council emissary. Covert agent for the Romulan Star Empire. He attempted to use Geordi La Forge to assassinate Vagh, a Klingon governor

name: Kevin Uxbridge (Premiere Remastered)
text: Nullifies an [Event] (except a [Shield] or Treaty). Place this [Interrupt] out-of-play.
lore: Immortal omnipotent being called a Douwd. Lived secretly as a human. Took a human wife who was killed by the Husnocks at Delta Rana IV.

name: Khazara (Premiere Remastered)
keywords: Cloaking Device; Romulan ship; Tractor Beam;
text: Cloaking Device, Tractor Beam
lore: Warbird commanded by Toreth. Covertly used by N'Vek and Deanna Troi to accomplish the defection of Vice-Proconsul M'ret in 2369.

name: Khitomer Research (Premiere Remastered)
text: Honor x3 + Computer Skill + Treachery
lore: Reopen investigation into Khitomer massacre.

name: Kivas Fajo: Collector (Premiere Remastered)
text: Choose a player to draw three cards. Discard event.
lore: Treacherous collector of rare one-of-a-kind antiquities. Once tried to add Data to his collection.

name: Klingon Death Yell (Premiere Remastered)
text: Plays just after a Klingon with Honor dies (limit one each). Score points, and you may yell to warn the dead.
lore: Warning for the dead to beware; a Klingon warrior is about to arrive. In Klingon myth, killed warriors with honor go to Sto-Vo-Kor. Dishonored dead go to Gre-thor.

name: Klingon Disruptor (Premiere Remastered)
text: If your [Kli] or [Non] personnel present, each of your personnel present is STRENGTH +2. (Cumulative.)
lore: Phase-disruptor used by Klingons and other races. Similar to a phaser.

name: Klingon Outpost (Premiere Remastered)
text: Seed one OR build where you have a Klingon ENGINEER.
lore: The Klingon Homeworld is Qo'noS. The Klingon Empire establishes outposts throughout its territory.

name: Klingon PADD (Premiere Remastered)
text: If your [Kli] personnel present, each of your personnel present is CUNNING +2. (Cumulative.)
lore: Standard Klingon Personal Access Display Device for computerized information.

name: Klingon Right of Vengeance (Premiere Remastered)
text: Just after a personnel battle where a Klingon died, your Klingons present may immediately attack same opponents, even without a leader (STRENGTH doubled for this battle).
lore: Under Klingon law, Worf claimed right of vengeance against Duras in 2367.

name: K'mpec (Premiere Remastered)
keywords: Klingon; High Council; High Council Leader; Male; Support Personnel;
text: V.I.P. Leadership Diplomacy
lore: Klingon High Council leader prior to Gowron. He appointed Jean-Luc Picard as Arbiter of Succession in 2367.

name: Konmel (Premiere Remastered)
text: OFFICER Navigation
lore: Klingon warrior. He destroyed the cruiser I.K.S. T'Acog and hijacked the Talarian ship Batris with Korris.

name: Koral (Premiere Remastered)
text: CIVILIAN Navigation Archaeology
lore: Tall Klingon male. Captain of a shuttle who traded with mercenaries in 2370.

name: Koroth (Premiere Remastered)
text: SCIENCE Biology Archaeology Anthropology
lore: Klingon high cleric at Boreth Monastery. He was responsible for creating Kahless, a clone of Kahless the Unforgettable, in 2369.

name: Korris (Premiere Remastered)
text: OFFICER Honor
lore: Klingon warrior. He destroyed the cruiser I.K.S. T'Acog and hijacked the Talarian ship Batris with Konmel.

name: Krios Suppression (Premiere Remastered)
text: Honor + Diplomacy + STRENGTH>35
lore: Aid suppression of warring factions.

name: K'Tal (Premiere Remastered)
keywords: Klingon; High Council; Male; Mission Specialist;
text: V.I.P. Diplomacy
lore: Senior member of the Klingon High Council. He presided over the installation of Gowron as head of the council in 2367.

name: Ktarian Game (Premiere Remastered)
text: Place on ship. Now and start of each turn, one personnel aboard (random selection) is disabled. Cure with CUNNING>30 OR any android.
lore: Psychotropically, mesmerizingly addictive game device. One by one, its players are made susceptible to complete mental control.

name: Kurak (Premiere Remastered)
text: SCIENCE Astrophysics Computer Skill Physics Honor
lore: Famed female Klingon scientist and warp-field specialist who evaluated the metaphasic shield.

name: Kurlan Naiskos (Premiere Remastered)
text: Place in hand. Plays as [Event] on a ship: while OFFICER, ENGINEER, MEDICAL, SCIENCE, SECURITY, V.I.P., and CIVILIAN aboard, triples ship's attributes.
lore: Statues which open to reveal a multitude of similar but smaller figurines inside, representing the belief that each person is a community of individual voices and desires.

name: Kurn (Premiere Remastered)
text: OFFICER Honor Computer Skill Navigation Diplomacy
lore: Son of Mogh. Brother of Worf. Commands the I.K.S. Hegh'ta. Kept his true bloodline hidden prior to becoming a member of the Klingon High Council.

name: K'Vada (Premiere Remastered)
text: OFFICER Leadership Navigation
lore: Klingon captain. He transported Jean-Luc Picard and Data on an undercover mission to Romulus.

name: Leah Brahms (Premiere Remastered)
text: ENGINEER ENGINEER
lore: Human warp field theorist and doctor of engineering. She was responsible for much of the warp engine design for Galaxy-class starships.

name: Life-form Scan (Premiere Remastered)
text: Examine the cards in your opponent's hand.
lore: A special form of sensor scan capable of detecting life-forms on planets or in space.

name: L'Kor (Premiere Remastered)
text: CIVILIAN Leadership Music
lore: Klingon warrior. Believed killed at Khitomer massacre. He was actually held prisoner by the Romulans on Carraya IV.

name: Long-Range Scan (Premiere Remastered)
text: Examine the cards aboard a ship (except a ship with Long-Range Scan Shielding).
lore: Detects ships and phenomena at interstellar distances using ship sensors.

name: Lore Returns (Premiere Remastered)
text: Plays on opponent's empty ship with {Rogue Borg} aboard. You gain control of those Rogue Borg, who commandeer ship (as [Non]). While Rogue Borg aboard, ship is staffed; it may initiate battle and beam your Rogue Borg. (Unique.)
lore: Data's charismatic android brother became the leader of a group of rogue Borg and was referred to as The One.

name: Lore's Fingernail (Premiere Remastered)
text: Plays on table. All inorganics (except [Holo]) become [Non].
lore: Circuitry in Lore's finger was used to control and manipulate his brother Data with emotions.

name: Loss of Orbital Stability (Premiere Remastered)
text: Plays on a ship orbiting a [P]. Ship has NO RANGE until end of turn. If SHIELDS>4, discard interrupt. Otherwise, ship destroyed at end of its owner's next turn. (Cumulative.)
lore: If a ship's orbit decays, it can be drawn toward a planet and burn up in its atmosphere.

name: Lursa (Premiere Remastered)
text: V.I.P. Treachery Leadership Geology Greed
lore: Elder of the two Duras sisters. Plotted with Sela, a Romulan, to start the Klingon Civil War of 2367-68.

name: Lwaxana Troi (Premiere Remastered)
text: V.I.P. Empathy x 2
lore: Betazoid mother of Deanna Troi. Daughter of the Fifth House, Holder of the Sacred Chalice of Rixx, Heir to the Holy Rings of Betazed.

name: Male's Love Interest (Premiere Remastered)
text: Relocates a male present (random selection) to furthest different planet on this spaceline.
lore: One of the many beautiful women who reside on the paradise planet of Risa.

name: Masaka Transformations (Premiere Remastered)
text: Choose a player. That player shuffles their hand, places it beneath their draw deck, then draws an equal number of cards. Discard event.
lore: Masaka attempted to transform the U.S.S. Enterprise into an ancient temple and grounds by rearranging its matter.

name: Matriarchal Society (Premiere Remastered)
text: Cannot get past unless at least two female Away Team members are present.
lore: The planet Angel One was dominated by its women who were intolerant of dealing with men.

name: Medical Kit (Premiere Remastered)
text: Your OFFICER-classification personnel present gain MEDICAL.
lore: Representative of specialized medical equipment. Such equipment has been developed by many races.

name: Medical Relief (Premiere Remastered)
text: Biology + Exobiology + MEDICAL
lore: Respond to reported medical emergency.

name: Medical Tricorder (Premiere Remastered)
text: Your SCIENCE-classification personnel present gain MEDICAL.
lore: Representative of a specialized tricorder optimized for medical use. Such equipment has been developed by many races.

name: Mendak (Premiere Remastered)
text: OFFICER Treachery Exobiology
lore: Admiral and commander of the warbird Devoras. He aided the escape of Romulan operative Selok from the Federation.

name: Menthar Booby Trap (Premiere Remastered)
text: Place on ship; it cannot move. Unless MEDICAL present, one crew member killed (random selection). Cure with 2 ENGINEER.
lore: Relic from ancient Menthar-Promellian war. Aceton assimilators trap passing ships, drain power, then emit deadly radiation.

name: Metaphasic Shields (Premiere Remastered)
text: Plays on your ship. SHIELDS +2 for each of your SCIENCE-classification personnel present.
lore: Revolutionary shields using overlapping subspace fields. Invented by Ferengi Dr. Reyga

name: Microbiotic Colony (Premiere Remastered)
text: Unless OFFICER, ENGINEER, and SCIENCE present, damages ship. Discard dilemma.
lore: Rare subatomic spaceborne life-form that can cause severe damage to a starship's hull.

name: Microvirus (Premiere Remastered)
text: Unless MEDICAL and SECURITY present, kills one personnel present (opponent's choice), except an inorganic. Otherwise, score points. Discard dilemma.
lore: Genetic weapon designed to attack humanoids who have specific DNA sequences.

name: Mirok (Premiere Remastered)
text: SCIENCE ENGINEER Astrophysics Physics
lore: Romulan scientist. He was in charge of developing and testing the interphase generator in 2368.

name: Nagilum (Premiere Remastered)
text: Unless 3 Diplomacy OR STRENGTH>40 present, kills half of crew (random selection, round down). Otherwise, score points. Discard dilemma.
lore: Extra-dimensional entity willing to kill in order to understand the concept of mortality.

name: Nanites (Premiere Remastered)
text: Unless 2 SCIENCE OR Diplomacy present, damages ship. Otherwise, score points. Discard dilemma.
lore: Originally, microscopic robots used for medical therapy. Now, self-replicating sentient life-forms who can disable computer systems.

name: Nausicaans (Premiere Remastered)
text: Unless STRENGTH>44, kills one personnel (random selection). Discard dilemma.
lore: all humanoid species with a quick temper. A Nausicaan once stabbed Jean-Luc Picard through the heart with a knife.

name: Near-Warp Transport (Premiere Remastered)
text: Plays to beam up to six cards (personnel and/or [Equipment]) from your exposed ship with transporters to an adjacent spaceline location (if possible).
lore: Physically disconcerting transport at high-speed.

name: Nella Daren (Premiere Remastered)
text: SCIENCE Astrophysics Stellar Cartography Music
lore: Human specializing in stellar cartography. She is an accomplished pianist. Lieutenant commander who became romantically involved with Jean-Luc Picard.

name: Neral (Premiere Remastered)
keywords: Romulan; Male; Proconsul; Senator; Support Personnel;
text: V.I.P. Treachery Youth
lore: Senator who became proconsul of the Romulan Senate. He plotted with Sela and Pardek to invade Vulcan.

name: Neural Servo Device (Premiere Remastered)
text: Plays on a [Non] ship without 2 SECURITY aboard. Until end of turn, ship and crew are under your control, but are not compatible with your other cards.
lore: Device which can be used to control a crew by activating pain-causing implants.

name: New Contact (Premiere Remastered)
text: Diplomacy + Leadership + Empathy + Anthropology
lore: Seek contact with advanced civilization at this distant planet.

name: Nikolai Rozhenko (Premiere Remastered)
text: CIVILIAN Anthropology Computer Skill Treachery
lore: Worf's human foster brother. Son of Sergey and Helena. He operated a cultural observation post in 2370.

name: Nitrium Metal Parasites (Premiere Remastered)
text: Place on ship. Ship is destroyed when countdown expires. Cure with 2 SCIENCE OR 2 ENGINEER.
lore: Microscopic life-forms that normally live in asteroids but can infest and damage ships by ingesting nitrium.

name: Norah Satie (Premiere Remastered)
keywords: Human; Admiral; Female; Mission Specialist; U.S.S. Enterprise-related personnel;
text: V.I.P. Leadership
lore: Retired human admiral. Assigned Jean-Luc Picard to the U.S.S. Enterprise. A zealous investigator, she helped expose the alien conspiracy of 2364.

name: Nu'Daq (Premiere Remastered)
text: OFFICER Archaeology Navigation Exobiology
lore: Captain of the I.K.S. Maht-H'a. He pursued the DNA program in 2369.

name: Null Space (Premiere Remastered)
text: Unless 2 Navigation present, damages ship. Otherwise, score points. Discard dilemma.
lore: A rare, invisible pocket of space caused by turbulence during star formation. Absorbs all energy.

name: Nutational Shields (Premiere Remastered)
text: Plays on your ship. SHIELDS +2 for each of your ENGINEER-classification personnel present.
lore: Nutation adjusts the shield frequency phase rotation, thereby increasing shield efficiency. Used against the Borg in 2367.

name: N'Vek (Premiere Remastered)
text: SCIENCE Honor Biology Computer Skill
lore: Member of the Romulan underground. He spearheaded the defection of Vice-Proconsul M'ret to the Federation.

name: Palor Toff: Alien Trader (Premiere Remastered)
text: Exchange this card for any non-Personnel card in your discard pile.
lore: Rich merchant and trader from an unknown race. Friend of Kivas Fajo. Snappy dresser.

name: Pardek (Premiere Remastered)
text: V.I.P. Diplomacy x 2 Treachery
lore: Male senator from the Krocton Segment of Romulus. Delegate at the 2293 Khitomer conference. Betrayer of Ambassador Spock.

name: Parem (Premiere Remastered)
text: OFFICER Treachery
lore: Male Romulan officer accidently phased by an interphase generator experiment.

name: Particle Fountain (Premiere Remastered)
text: Plays if your Away Team just solved a planet mission. If 2 ENGINEER in Away Team, score points.
lore: Experimental orbital station built by Dr. Farallon for mining a planet from space. Rumored to be effective for atmospheric depletion.

name: Pattern Enhancers (Premiere Remastered)
text: Plays on table. You may ignore any effect on a dilemma, event, or mission that prevents beaming or targets your just-beamed personnel or equipment.
lore: Devices which amplify transporter signals to enhance transporter beam power in hazardous areas.

name: Pegasus Search (Premiere Remastered)
text: Navigation + Diplomacy + Leadership + Treachery + INTEGRITY>40 OR {Interphase Generator}
lore: Search for U.S.S. Pegasus, reported lost in this sector.

name: Phased Matter (Premiere Remastered)
text: Divide Away Team into two groups. Place on larger group (your choice if tie); they are in stasis. Cure with ENGINEER and SCIENCE.
lore: Phased personnel vibrate out of sync with normal matter, rendering them undetectable. Phased people cannot interact with non-phased people.

name: Pi (Premiere Remastered)
keywords: No staffing requirement; Romulan ship; Scout;
lore: Ship suspected of attempting a covert mission to Galorndon Core in Federation territory.

name: Plasma Fire (Premiere Remastered)
text: Plays on a non-[Bor] ship. At the end of each of its controller's turns, ship damaged. May be nullified by SECURITY.
lore: Intensely hot combustion of ionized plasma gas. Dangerous fire which can destroy a ship.

name: Plunder Site (Premiere Remastered)
text: Treachery + Archaeology + STRENGTH>30
lore: Search ancient civilization site for treasures or artifacts.

name: Portal Guard (Premiere Remastered)
text: Unless one Away Team member has CUNNING>7 or Honor, immediately beam entire Away Team off planet surface OR kills entire Away Team.
lore: Portal 63 is the last remaining protector of the Tkon Empire, which became extinct 600,000 years ago. Challenges those who awaken him.

name: Q (Premiere Remastered)
text: Unless 2 Leadership and INTEGRITY>60, opponent may download up to 2 [Q] cards and place them atop their Q-Continuum side deck; crew or Away Team has a Q-Flash of 4 cards, then is stopped. Discard dilemma.
lore: Incorrigible omnipotent being. Member of the Q Continuum. Q exhibits a child-like petulance and sense of playfulness.

name: Q2 (Premiere Remastered)
text: Nullifies {Amanda Rogers} OR {Kevin Uxbridge} OR a [Q] icon dilemma OR a dilemma with the word "Q" in title. Place this [Interrupt] out-of-play.
lore: Member of the Q who observed Q's act of self-sacrifice and re-instated him in the Q continuum.

name: Q-Net (Premiere Remastered)
text: Plays between two adjacent spaceline locations. No ship may pass the Q-Net unless 2 Diplomacy aboard.
lore: Q used an enormous forcefield grid in space to stop the U.S.S. Enterprise in 2364.

name: Radioactive Garbage Scow (Premiere Remastered)
text: Place on mission; mission attempt ends. Mission can't be attempted here. Ship with Tractor Beam and 2 ENGINEER can tow Scow.
lore: Barges containing dangerous waste can be adrift for centuries. One such barge threatened Gamelan V in 2367.

name: Raise the Stakes (Premiere Remastered)
text: Opponent chooses: You win the game OR Plays on table. The winner of this game may randomly select and keep one card from opponent's game deck. (Cumulative.)
lore: Weekly poker game aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise honed the tactical and bluffing skills of many officers.

name: Rebel Encounter (Premiere Remastered)
text: Unless STRENGTH>44 OR you destroy an [Equipment] present, kills one personnel (random selection). Discard dilemma.
lore: Belligerent rebels from war-torn worlds often hide out on other planets and can endanger an Away Team. However, sometimes they can be bribed not to attack.

name: Red Alert! (Premiere Remastered)
text: Plays on table. In place of your normal card play, you may play up to five personnel and/or [Equipment]. When nullified, any player may immediately download {Yellow Alert}.
lore: The state of maximum crew and systems readiness aboard starships.

name: Reginald Barclay (Premiere Remastered)
text: ENGINEER Computer Skill
lore: Human lieutenant who is a talented but socially shy systems diagnostic engineer. He is a former victim of holodiction. Has a phobia of traveling by transporter.

name: Relief Mission (Premiere Remastered)
text: Geology OR Physics
lore: Alleviate planet of ice age conditions following type-C asteroid impact.

name: REM Fatigue (Premiere Remastered)
text: Place on crew or Away Team; quarantined. Kills them when countdown expires. Cure (score points) with 3 MEDICAL OR (if on ship) by docking.
lore: A crew can go insane from lack of REM (rapid eye movement) sleep.

name: Repair Mission (Premiere Remastered)
text: ENGINEER x3 + Computer Skill
lore: Examine malfunctioning subspace radio telescope at the edge of Federation space.

name: Res-Q (Premiere Remastered)
text: Plays to take a card from your discard pile to your hand. Discard event.
lore: Q once saved Jean-Luc Picard's life following an injury from a compressed teryon beam.

name: Restore Errant Moon (Premiere Remastered)
text: ENGINEER + Astrophysics + Leadership
lore: Restore moon knocked off its orbit by passage of nearby black hole.

name: Richard Galen (Premiere Remastered)
text: SCIENCE Archaeology x 2 Biology Exobiology
lore: Professor and mentor to Jean-Luc Picard. Human considered the greatest archaeologist of the 24th century. He discovered the DNA program.

name: Riva (Premiere Remastered)
text: V.I.P. Diplomacy x 2
lore: Deaf mute Ramatin. Famed mediator from Ramatis III. He spoke with a chorus of three telepaths.

name: Ro Laren (Premiere Remastered)
text: OFFICER Computer Skill Navigation Treachery
lore: Bajoran ensign. Prot g of Jean-Luc Picard. She is sympathetic to the Maquis. A bit of a renegade.

name: Sarek (Premiere Remastered)
text: V.I.P. Diplomacy x 3 Mindmeld
lore: Illustrious Vulcan ambassador. Father of Spock. Over 200 years old. He has been romantically involved with a Vulcan princess, Amanda Grayson, and Perrin.

name: Sarjenka (Premiere Remastered)
text: You may stop all Away Teams at this location to score points and discard dilemma. Otherwise, mission continues.
lore: Alien child from Drema IV. Her radio pleas for help were answered by Data in violation of the Prime Directive.

name: Sarthong Plunder (Premiere Remastered)
text: Archaeology x2 + STRENGTH>40
lore: Plunder rich ruins at this famous archaeological site.

name: Satelk (Premiere Remastered)
text: OFFICER Leadership Mindmeld Diplomacy
lore: Vulcan captain and Starfleet officer. He presided over the inquiry into Joshua Albert's death at the Academy Flight Range in 2368.

name: Scan (Premiere Remastered)
text: Plays at the start of your turn on your ship with at least two staffing icons at a [S] mission. Stop your Computer Skill and Stellar Cartography aboard to examine the bottom seed card here.
lore: Sensor instruments can detect life signs and molecular signatures at a distance with accuracy.

name: Secret Salvage (Premiere Remastered)
text: Treachery x4 OR Navigation x2 + Computer Skill
lore: Attempt retrieval of floating Federation wreckage at Borg massacre site.

name: Seek Life-form (Premiere Remastered)
text: Exobiology + Astrophysics + ENGINEER
lore: Study new spaceborne life-form reported in this system.

name: Sela (Premiere Remastered)
text: V.I.P. Diplomacy Leadership Treachery Youth
lore: 1/2 Romulan, 1/2 human female. Daughter of Tasha Yar from an alternate timeline. Powerful operative and key figure in the Romulan hegemony.

name: Shaka, When the Walls Fell (Premiere Remastered)
text: To get past requires 2 Diplomacy and CUNNING>30.
lore: Shaka, when the walls fell, means inability to understand. The incomprehensible Tamarians spoke entirely in metaphors.

name: Shelby (Premiere Remastered)
keywords: Human; Female; Support Personnel; U.S.S. Enterprise-related personnel;
text: OFFICER Leadership Exobiology
lore: Ambitious human Starfleet officer. She was assigned to the U.S.S. Enterprise as a specialist on the Borg.

name: Ship Seizure (Premiere Remastered)
text: Plays on your ship with Tractor Beam. Discard another empty exposed ship here.
lore: Tractor beams are focused linear graviton beams which can be used to seize or tow objects in space.

name: Sirna Kolrami (Premiere Remastered)
text: V.I.P. Leadership
lore: Famed Zakdorn strategist. He is a grandmaster of the game Strategema.

name: Soren (Premiere Remastered)
keywords: J'Naii; Androgynous; Female; Mission Specialist; Neuter;
text: SCIENCE Astrophysics
lore: Androgynous-gender J'Naii. Became romantically involved with William T. Riker. Illegally chose to be female. Underwent therapy for this "perversity."

name: Spacedock (Premiere Remastered)
text: Plays on your outpost. Just after your ship docks here, repair all its damage.
lore: Orbital repair and building facility for starships. Such facilities have been developed by many races.

name: Starfleet Type II Phaser (Premiere Remastered)
text: If your [Fed] or [Non] personnel present, each of your personnel present is STRENGTH +2. (Cumulative.)
lore: Handheld weapon can be set for stun, heat and disruption. PHASER is an acronym for PHASed Energy Rectification.

name: Static Warp Bubble (Premiere Remastered)
text: Plays on table. At the end of each of their turns, opponent must discard a card (their choice).
lore: Beverly Crusher experienced a shrinking universe, shaped by her own thoughts, inside a static warp bubble created by Wesley Crusher.

name: Strategic Diversion (Premiere Remastered)
text: Treachery x3 + STRENGTH>30
lore: Aid preparations for an offensive invasion.

name: Study "Hole in Space" (Premiere Remastered)
text: Leadership + Diplomacy + INTEGRITY>40
lore: Investigate mysterious void.

name: Study Lonka Pulsar (Premiere Remastered)
text: Navigation + Astrophysics + Stellar Cartography
lore: Research vibrating neutron star.

name: Study Nebula (Premiere Remastered)
text: Astrophysics + Stellar Cartography + CUNNING>40
lore: Study and chart nebula.

name: Study Plasma Streamer (Premiere Remastered)
text: Astrophysics + Youth
lore: Study stream of plasma flowing between binary stars.

name: Study Stellar Collision (Premiere Remastered)
text: Stellar Cartography
lore: Study rare collision between two gas giants.

name: Subspace Interference (Premiere Remastered)
text: Nullifies {Incoming Message} OR {Hail} OR {Subspace Schism}.
lore: Disruptions of subspace communications can be caused by nebulae and other phenomena.

name: Subspace Schism (Premiere Remastered)
text: Plays when a player would draw a card (limit once every turn). Discards that card. (Player draws next card.)
lore: Solanogen-based aliens from another subspace domain accessed our space to abduct people for experiments.

name: Subspace Warp Rift (Premiere Remastered)
text: Plays on a spaceline location. Ships that fly by here are damaged. Ships that move to here are damaged if they move again on same turn (unless relocated).
lore: Dr. Serova proved in 2370 that disastrous rifts occur in the fabric of space due to the excessive use of warp drive. Discovery led to a Federation-wide speed limit of warp 5.

name: Supernova (Premiere Remastered)
text: Requires {Tox Uthat}. Plays on a mission. Destroys all ships and facilities here. For rest of game, mission is unattemptable and unscoutable, converts to [S] (if [P]), and loses gametext, point box, and affiliation icons.
lore: The explosion of a star, usually caused by natural processes toward the end of its life cycle.

name: Survey Mission (Premiere Remastered)
text: Stellar Cartography + Physics
lore: Study and chart dark matter nebula.

name: Tachyon Detection Grid (Premiere Remastered)
text: If you control four exposed ships, plays on a cloaked ship. It de-cloaks (even if it is stopped or has cloaked this turn). It may not cloak.
lore: Network of active tachyon beams between many ships. Devised by Geordi La Forge in 2368 to detect cloaked vessels.

name: Tebok (Premiere Remastered)
text: OFFICER Diplomacy Leadership Navigation
lore: Commanding officer of a Romulan warbird. His ship crossed the Romulan Neutral Zone in 2364.

name: Telepathic Alien Kidnappers (Premiere Remastered)
text: Plays on table. At end of each turn, name a card type. Then, randomly select a card from opponent's hand. If it has that card type, discard it.
lore: Unknown aliens abducted Jean-Luc Picard for telepathic studies about authority in 2366.

name: Temporal Causality Loop (Premiere Remastered)
text: Unless SCIENCE and CUNNING>35 present, returns here (re-plays) all cards in discard piles discarded from here this attempt (re-seed seed cards); turn ends. Otherwise, score points. Discard dilemma.
lore: Localized distortion causes time to repeat ad infinitum. The U.S.S. Bozeman was trapped for 90 years in a temporal loop.

name: Temporal Rift (Premiere Remastered)
text: Plays on table as a [Univ][S] time location; relocate one of your exposed ships OR a dilemma here. Counts down only at the start of your turn. When nullified, return that ship or dilemma to its former location.
lore: Time displacement caused by high energy explosions such as that which affected the U.S.S. Enterprise-C at Narendra III.

name: Test Mission (Premiere Remastered)
text: Physics + INTEGRITY>28
lore: Provide aid for a helium ignition project attempting to revitalize dying sun.

name: Tetryon Field (Premiere Remastered)
text: Plays on a spaceline location. Ships may not fly by here. Ships that move to here require Navigation aboard to use RANGE again this turn.
lore: Intense masses of subspace particles, unstable in normal space, which require ships to route through safe corridors.

name: The Devil (Premiere Remastered)
text: Nullifies {Horga'hn} OR {Wind Dancer} OR one {Treaty}.
lore: Ardra recreated the human mythical figure the Devil on Ventax II.

name: The Juggler (Premiere Remastered)
text: Choose any player to re-shuffle the cards in their draw deck.
lore: The Juggler hosted Lwaxana Troi and Alexander Rozhenko's visit to the Parallax colony, all the time juggling his three worlds.

name: The Traveler: Transcendence (Premiere Remastered)
text: Plays on table. Nullifies each {Static Warp Bubble}. Choose a player. End of each turn, that player must draw a card.
lore: Benevolent humanoid from Tau Alpha C who could transcend space and time with thought.

name: Time Travel Pod (Premiere Remastered)
text: Immediately play on table as a [Univ][S] time location. Relocate opponent's ship here now OR once, at any time, relocate your ship here. Counts down only while a ship here. When discarded, return ship to former location.
lore: Craft from the future, stolen in the past by Berlinghoff Rasmussen for his own gain.

name: Toby Russell (Premiere Remastered)
text: MEDICAL Physics
lore: Doctor and controversial human neurogeneticist. She created the genetronic replicator therapy for spinal injury that saved Worf.

name: Tokath (Premiere Remastered)
text: OFFICER Anthropology Honor
lore: Romulan commandant. He established a secret prison camp in the Carraya system for dishonored Klingon survivors of the Khitomer massacre.

name: Tomalak (Premiere Remastered)
keywords: Romulan; Male; Support Personnel; U.S.S. Enterprise-related personnel;
text: OFFICER Diplomacy Leadership
lore: Commander of the D'deridex-class warbird Deranas. He is a frequent nemesis of the U.S.S. Enterprise.

name: Toq (Premiere Remastered)
text: CIVILIAN Leadership Computer Skill Youth
lore: Klingon male, born in a Romulan prison camp on Carraya IV. Prot g of Worf.

name: Torak (Premiere Remastered)
text: V.I.P. Diplomacy Geology
lore: Klingon governor. He served near the Federation border commanding Sector 2520 in 2369.

name: Toral (Premiere Remastered)
text: V.I.P. Leadership Youth
lore: Illegitimate son of Duras. Claimed a leadership position on the High Council at the bidding of the Sisters of Duras, Lursa and B'Etor.

name: Toreth (Premiere Remastered)
text: OFFICER Leadership Honor Navigation
lore: Female captain of the Imperial Romulan warbird Khazara. Her father was killed by the Tal Shiar. Uncovered the Vice-Proconsul M'ret defection plot.

name: Tox Uthat (Premiere Remastered)
text: Place in hand. Plays as [Event]: Plays on table; you may not play {Supernova} this turn. Discard if used to play Supernova. OR Plays as [Interrupt]: Nullifies Supernova. Discard artifact.
lore: Dangerous quantum phase inhibitor invented in the future by Kal Dano who hid it in the 22nd century for safekeeping.

name: T'Pan (Premiere Remastered)
text: SCIENCE SCIENCE Mindmeld
lore: Vulcan director of the prestigious Vulcan Science Academy. She is a doctor of astrophysical sciences and a preeminent expert in subspace morphology.

name: Transwarp Conduit (Premiere Remastered)
text: Plays on a ship. Its full RANGE is doubled. At end of turn, discard interrupt.
lore: Borg technology which creates an artificial subspace tunnel that increases effective warp speed.

name: Treaty: Federation/Klingon (Premiere Remastered)
text: Plays on table. Your [Fed] and [Kli] cards are compatible
lore: Past treaties between these powers included the Treaty of Alliance creating mutual aid and defense without intervention.

name: Treaty: Federation/Romulan (Premiere Remastered)
text: Plays on table. Your [Fed] and [Rom] cards are compatible.
lore: Past treaties between these powers include the Treaty of Algeron, which created a neutral zone and outlawed Federation cloaking devices.

name: Treaty: Romulan/Klingon (Premiere Remastered)
text: Plays on table. Your [Rom] and [Kli] cards are compatible.
lore: Historically bitter enemies, these two powers had a brief, failed alliance to share technology around 2268.

name: Tricorder (Premiere Remastered)
text: Your ENGINEER-classification personnel present gain SCIENCE.
