lore: Representative of a multipurpose handheld device combining sensors, computers, and recorders. Such equipment has been developed by many races.

name: Tsiolkovsky Infection (Premiere Remastered)
text: Place on ship; personnel aboard lose first-listed skill. Cure with 3 MEDICAL.
lore: Variety of water-based Psi 2000 virus. Passed by perspiration. Creates dangerous intoxication-like instability among a crew.

name: Two-Dimensional Creatures (Premiere Remastered)
text: Place on ship; Empathy personnel aboard are disabled. Ship cannot move. Cure with ENGINEER and SCIENCE.
lore: Perfectly flat spaceborne creatures from a two-dimensional spatial continuum. Ensnared the U.S.S. Enterprise in 2367 and impeded Deanna Troi's empathic abilities.

name: U.S.S. Brattain (Premiere Remastered)
text: Tractor Beam
lore: Starship found trapped in a Tyken's Rift in 2367. All but one of crew were killed by REM sleep deprivation.

name: U.S.S. Enterprise (Premiere Remastered)
text: Holodeck, Tractor Beam
lore: The fifth Federation ship named Enterprise, launched in 2363. Built at the Utopia Planitia shipyards orbiting Mars.

name: U.S.S. Hood (Premiere Remastered)
text: Tractor Beam
lore: Registry number NCC-42296. Named for the 20th century admiral, Sir Horace Hood. Commanded by Robert DeSoto.

name: U.S.S. Phoenix (Premiere Remastered)
text: Holodeck, Tractor Beam
lore: Commanded by Benjamin Maxwell. Assigned to the Cardassian/Federation border in 2367.

name: U.S.S. Sutherland (Premiere Remastered)
text: Holodeck, Tractor Beam
lore: Named for Horatio Hornblower's fictional flagship. Played a pivotal role in the Klingon Civil War blockade.

name: U.S.S. Yamato (Premiere Remastered)
text: Holodeck, Tractor Beam
lore: Named for a Japanese WWII battleship. Sister ship of the U.S.S. Enterprise. Commanded by Donald Varley.

name: Vagh (Premiere Remastered)
text: V.I.P. Diplomacy Anthropology
lore: Klingon governor of Krios. He was the target of an assassination attempt by Geordi La Forge, acting under Romulan mind control.

name: Varon-T Disruptor (Premiere Remastered)
text: Use as [Equipment]. Doubles the STRENGTH of each of your personnel present.
lore: Only five of these pistols were made before being banned by the Federation. These vicious weapons disrupt the body from the inside out, causing a slow and painful death.

name: Vash (Premiere Remastered)
text: CIVILIAN Archaeology x 2 Treachery Anthropology
lore: Extraordinary archaeology treasure hunter. Traveled with Q. Human romantically involved with Jean-Luc Picard. Lovable character, but she's not to be trusted.

name: Vulcan Mindmeld (Premiere Remastered)
text: Plays on your Mindmeld personnel. Personnel gains the skills of one of your other personnel present until end of turn. At end of turn, discard interrupt.
lore: Ancient Vulcan ritual which telepathically links minds to intimately share each other's thoughts and knowledge.

name: Vulcan Stone of Gol (Premiere Remastered)
text: Place in hand. Plays as [Event] on any Away Team: kills all personnel present without Youth OR CUNNING>7. Discard artifact.
lore: Ancient Vulcan telepathic weapon. Kills by magnifying aggressive and violent thoughts, but can be blocked by peaceful thoughts.

name: Warp Core Breach (Premiere Remastered)
text: Plays on a non-[Bor] ship. At the end of its controller's next turn, destroys ship. May be nullified by ENGINEER.
lore: In warp propulsion systems, if the magnetic confinement field collapses, matter and antimatter collide causing the ship to explode.

name: Wesley Crusher (Premiere Remastered)
text: OFFICER Youth Computer Skill Navigation ENGINEER Astrophysics
lore: Ensign and child prodigy. Human prot g of The Traveler. Son of Beverly Crusher. He saved the U.S.S. Enterprise 3 1/2 times as a teenager.

name: Where No One Has Gone Before (Premiere Remastered)
text: Plays on table. You may move ships between locations at opposite ends of a spaceline as if those locations were adjacent.
lore: The Traveler transcends space with thought. Took the U.S.S. Enterprise to Galaxy M-33, then to an even greater extragalactic distance.

name: William T. Riker (Premiere Remastered)
keywords: Human; Cook; Male; U.S.S. Enterprise-related personnel;
text: OFFICER Diplomacy Leadership Navigation Honor Music
lore: Commander, gourmet cook, and jazz musician. Human executive officer of the U.S.S. Enterprise. He is imzadi to Deanna Troi, his beloved.

name: Wind Dancer (Premiere Remastered)
text: To get past requires Music OR Youth OR a personnel with STRENGTH>9 OR {Lwaxana Troi}.
lore: Sentry of the Parallax colony. Only allows those whose hearts are joyous to pass.

name: Worf (Premiere Remastered)
text: SECURITY Honor x 2 Navigation Diplomacy
lore: Chief of security on the U.S.S. Enterprise. Klingon warrior and Starfleet lieutenant. Son of Mogh. Raised on Gault, and later on Earth, by his foster parents.

name: Wormhole (Premiere Remastered)
text: Requires two wormholes. Play one on your exposed ship. Play the other at any location (even a time location). Ship relocates to that location (and then is stopped).
lore: An unstable tunnel through subspace that links to locations in normal space/time.

name: Wormhole Negotiations (Premiere Remastered)
text: Diplomacy x5 OR Honor x4 OR Treachery x4
lore: Study and negotiate for exclusive use of Barzan wormhole.

name: Betazoid Gift Box (Premiere Remastered)
text: Immediately download to hand up to three cards from your draw deck (ignoring opponent's cards that prevent downloading). Discard artifact.
lore: Traditional device for presenting important gifts. Its sculpted face comes to life boisterously presenting its contents to the recipient.

name: Dathon *VP
text: OFFICER Diplomacy x 2 Leadership Honor Nullifies dilemmas with "Tamarian" in lore where present.
lore: Tamarian captain of the Tama. He said: "Darmok and Jalad at Tanagra. The beast of Tanagra. Picard and Dathon at El-Adrel. Sokath, his eyes uncovered!"

name: Stand-Off *VP
text: To get past requires three personnel with Anthropology OR three personnel with SECURITY classification.
lore: Joining forces with the Dominion required both mental and physical restraint to prevent the Klingon Worf and the Jem'Hadar Toman'torax from killing each other.

name: Victory Is Life *VP
text: Once every turn, download an [Equipment] to your Jem'Hadar who just helped solve a mission or won a personnel battle against another player; score points.
lore: I am First Omet'iklan. And I am dead. As of this moment we are all dead. We go into battle to win back our lives. This we do gladly, because we are Jem Hadar. Remember victory is life.

name: Donald Varley *VP
text: OFFICER Archaeology Stellar Cartography Computer Skill {Iconia} and {Denius III} add [FED], [fed].
lore: Human captain of the U.S.S. Yamato. He retrieved a "Galactic Rosetta Stone" from Denius III to search for and unfortunately find the mythical planet Iconia.

name: Time Travel Pod (Premiere Remastered) *VP
text: Immediately play on table as a [Univ][S] time location. Relocate opponent's ship here now OR once, at any time, relocate your ship here. Counts down only while a ship here. When discarded, return ship to former location.
lore: Craft from the future, stolen in the past by Berlinghoff Rasmussen for his own gain.

name: Crystalline Entity (Premiere Remastered) *VP
text: [P]: Unless MEDICAL and SCIENCE, kills Away Team. [S]: Unless Music OR SHIELDS>6, kills all personnel on ship. Then: Discard dilemma. Score points if overcome.
lore: Spaceborne life-form that converts biological matter to energy. Sensitive to graviton pulse resonance, shattering like crystal.

name: Anti-Time Anomaly (Premiere Remastered) *VP
text: Plays on table. At the start of each turn, opponent may [Flip] one ship at {any Devron System}. When countdown expires, each player shuffles all personnel in play (even "for uniqueness only") that they own into their draw decks.

name: Distortion of Space/Time Continuum (Premiere Remastered) *VP
text: Plays on your non-[AU] ship just after opponent plays an [AU] card. You may discard to unstop ship and crew OR restore full RANGE OR unstop an Away Team here. (Unique.)
lore: Time effects can be caused by the unusual warping or rifting of space.

name: Repair Mission (Premiere Remastered) *VP
text: ENGINEER x3 + Computer Skill
lore: Examine malfunctioning subspace radio telescope at the edge of Federation space.

name: Erik Pressman (Premiere Remastered) *VP
keywords: Human; Admiral; Captain; Male; Support Personnel;
text: OFFICER ENGINEER Treachery
lore: Human admiral and former captain of the U.S.S. Pegasus, which was lost in space following a failed experiment he oversaw

name: Kurn (Premiere Remastered) *VP
text: OFFICER Honor Computer Skill Navigation Diplomacy
lore: Son of Mogh. Brother of Worf. Commands the I.K.S. Hegh'ta. Kept his true bloodline hidden prior to becoming a member of the Klingon High Council.

name: Ocett (Premiere Remastered) *VP
text: OFFICER Archaeology Navigation Honor
lore: Cardassian female officer. Commander of the Bralek. Gul who pursued the DNA program.

name: Khazara (Premiere Remastered) *VP
keywords: Cloaking Device; Romulan ship; Tractor Beam;
text: Cloaking Device, Tractor Beam
lore: Warbird commanded by Toreth. Covertly used by N'Vek and Deanna Troi to accomplish the defection of Vice-Proconsul M'ret in 2369.

name: Ancient Computer (Premiere Traditional) *VP
text: Cannot get past unless 2 Computer Skill OR 3 SCIENCE OR 3 ENGINEER present.
lore: Vital information can be retrieved from old or damaged computer systems like this one aboard a derelict Promellian battlecruiser.

name: Matriarchal Society (Premiere Traditional) *VP
text: Cannot get past unless at least two female Away Team members are present.
lore: The planet Angel One was dominated by its women who were intolerant of dealing with men.

name: Q-Net (Premiere Traditional) *VP
text: Plays between two adjacent spaceline locations. No ship may pass the Q-Net unless 2 Diplomacy aboard.
lore: Q used an enormous forcefield grid in space to stop the U.S.S. Enterprise in 2364.

name: Hunt for DNA Program (Premiere Traditional) *VP
text: Archaeology x3 + Computer Skill + Biology + Leadership + STRENGTH>40
lore: Seek and secure last strand of DNA program on this desert planet.

name: Dr. Selar (Premiere Traditional) *VP
keywords: Vulcan; Female; Support Personnel; U.S.S. Enterprise-related personnel;
text: MEDICAL Computer Skill Mindmeld
lore: Dr. Selar is a female Vulcan medical doctor. Served aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise for many years.

name: Mot the Barber (Premiere Traditional) *VP
keywords: Bolian; Male; Mission Specialist; U.S.S. Enterprise-related personnel;
text: CIVILIAN Barbering
lore: Bolian male. Convivial barber aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise. Snappy conversationalist.

name: Duras (Premiere Traditional) *VP
text: V.I.P. Leadership Computer Skill Treachery Greed
lore: Son of Ja'rod. Contender for leadership of the Klingon High Council. Member of a powerful political family.

name: Dr. Reyga (Premiere Traditional) *VP
text: SCIENCE ENGINEER Stellar Cartography Astrophysics
lore: Ferengi male scientist. Inventor of the revolutionary, but controversial, metaphasic shield technology. Endured skepticism from the scientific community.

name: Devoras (Premiere Traditional) *VP
keywords: Cloaking Device; Romulan ship; Tractor Beam;
text: Cloaking Device, Tractor Beam
lore: Warbird used to accomplish the escape of Romulan spy Selok from the Federation in 2367. Commanded by Admiral Mendak.

name: Iconian Gateway *VP
text: Place in hand. Play as [Event] on a [P] mission: personnel present may walk to other [P] missions.
lore: Ancient, sophisticated portal which instantaneously transports people to distant planets. The attempted restoration of one by renegade Jem'Hadar on Vandros IV posed a galactic threat.

name: Male's Love Interest *VP
text: Relocates a male present (random selection) to furthest different planet on this spaceline.
lore: Deltans exhibit extremely strong levels of sexual attraction. To avoid such distractions, many Deltans take an oath of celibacy. Less scrupulous individuals, like Melle, utilise this ability.

name: Q *VP
text: Unless 2 Leadership and INTEGRITY>60, opponent may download up to 2 [Q] cards and place them atop their Q-Continuum side deck; crew or Away Team has a Q-Flash of 4 cards, then is stopped. Discard dilemma.
lore: Powerful member of the Q Continuum. Nuisance to Jean-Luc. Still incorrigible. "Mon capitaine. How I've missed you."

name: The Guardian of Forever *VP
text: Plays on planet {Gateway} (limit one). Once per turn, one or more personnel present may time travel to a time location in this quadrant, or may return here from there (with any of owner's other personnel present). OR Plays once each turn to nullify any card that is closing Guardian, or to draw up to four cards if your Archaeology or Anthropology personnel just time traveled back to Guardian; place doorway out-of-play.

name: Lower Decks* *VP
text: Plays on table. Each of your non-holographic, universal personnel is attributes all +2. (Captain's Order.)
lore: Each junior officer s development is a unique voyage, guided by their individual experiences. This shared journey generates a sense of camaraderie. "Lower decks! Lower decks!"

name: Spacedock *VP
text: Plays on your outpost. Just after your ship docks here, repair all its damage.
lore: Specialist spacedock facilities, such as those on Starbase One, can be used to repair, upgrade, and overhaul starship systems.

name: Federation Flagship: Recovered* *VP
text: Seeds or plays on table. If opponent's card just destroyed your only ship in play, place that ship here (with all cards aboard). Download one of the following to your matching facility or that spaceline's end: a different ship of the same class or identification OR any other Enterprise (if destroyed ship was {any Enterprise}). Relocate crew and equipment from here to downloaded ship (they are "stopped"). Discard incident.

name: Kobayashi Maru Scenario (All Good Things Remastered)* *VP
text: Seeds or plays on a mission; adds Computer Skill to mission requirements. At the start of each mission attempt here, one attempting personnel (random selection) is placed beneath this incident ("in play" for uniqueness only). When a player solves this mission, all of their compatible personnel beneath this incident join the solving crew or Away Team (any other personnel are discarded). (Unique.)

name: Live Long and Prosper *VP
text: Saves any Vulcan who was just randomly selected to die. OR Once per turn, returns an opponent's personnel who just died to opponent's hand; draw one card for each of its [*] icons.
lore: The Vulcan salute is accompanied by a traditional greeting. "Live long and prosper." "Peace and long life."

name: 1 Tribble - Bonus *VP
text: May report anywhere. Each non-Klingon present is CUNNING -1. Once every turn, may "stop" one personnel present (random selection).

name: The Village is Strong!
text: Plays on table. Once per game, prevent the death of any one CIVILIAN OR discard your just-revealed dilemma to download and seed {Dal'Rok} there. Then, discard event.
lore: The Dal'Rok is a fearsome enemy. The mountains tremble with its fury. But our prosperity is its misery. Our unity is its vulnerability. And our strength is its doom.

name: Maternal Instinct
text: Plays on table. Your cards are all compatible with each other. Your Youth personnel are attributes all +1. Nullified if you own and control a personnel without printed Youth and without "Youth" or "non-Youth" in gametext.
lore: Xindi-Insectoid eggs can spray a neurochemical, causing potential attackers to instead form a protective bond.

name: Surprise Reinforcements
text: Plays on table if all your missions are [DQ]. Your {Karr}, {[Kli] personnel}, and {[Univ][Hir] cards} are compatible.
lore: With encouragement from Neelix, a group of Klingon warriors crossed from one holoprogram to another so they could join a battle in the French town of Sainte Claire.

name: Miles O'Brien (Dramatis Personae)
text: ENGINEER ENGINEER Transporter Skill Diplomacy DL/ {The Village is Strong!}
lore: Human who was briefly appointed Sirah of a Bajoran village. He failed to drive off the Dal'Rok in 2369. Hovath could, cementing himself as the new Sirah.

name: Phlox of Borg
text: MEDICAL x 2 Biology Honor Exobiology When killed, shuffle this card into owner's draw deck. While on your ship, WEAPONS and SHIELDS +4 against [Sta].
lore: In a parallel universe, the Denobulan - Phlox - was too slow to irradiate his nanoprobe infection. Assimilated as a counterpart who spoke to Starfleet.

name: Iliana Ghemor
text: SECURITY Obsidian Order Computer Skill Diplomacy Personnel with Resistance here are attributes all -3.
lore: Cardassian daughter of Tekeny Ghemor. In an alternate timeline, she successfully infiltrated a Bajoran terrorist cell by posing as Kira Nerys.

name: Kira Nerys (Dramatis Personae)
text: OFFICER Diplomacy Computer Skill Navigation SECURITY DL/ {Treaty: Bajoran/Dominion}
lore: After the Dominion commandeered DS9, the Bajoran stayed aboard to represent her homeworld, as Bajor had signed a non-aggression pact with the Dominion.

name: Captain Pike
text: OFFICER Leadership Treachery SECURITY Opponent's personnel here are attributes all -1.
lore: Christopher Pike commanded the I.S.S. Enterprise prior to James Tiberius Kirk. Talented cook, but no one trusts his food.

name: Jadzia Dax (Dramatis Personae)
text: SCIENCE OFFICER Astrophysics Anthropology DL/ {Tongo} Other [Fer] personnel are attributes all +1 (here or in hand).
lore: Trill with symbiont and expert Tongo player. Brings out the best in the Ferengi. Despite their primitive, misogynistic attitudes, she finds them a lot of fun.

name: Neelix (Dramatis Personae)
text: SECURITY Honor Diplomacy Geology DL/ {Surprise Reinforcements}
lore: Talaxian who was altered to appear Klingon in one of Karr's holoprograms. Experienced warrior. The son of Eximar likes to drink heavily on the eve of battle.

name: The Doctor (Dramatis Personae)
text: MEDICAL Exobiology Biology Computer Skill Treachery MEDICAL Music
lore: A doctor, not a counterinsurgent, who unwittingly joined the Kazon-Nistrim. He told Seska he didn't care who was running Voyager.

name: Prisoner Kirk
text: CIVILIAN OFFICER Honor Diplomacy Exobiology May relocate to {Rura Penthe} if your [Kli][Films] leader dies.
lore: Following the murder of Chancellor Gorkon, the human Captain Kirk was sentenced to a life of mining on Rura Penthe. Had a price on his head.

name: Captain Worf (Dramatis Personae)
keywords: Klingon; Captain; Male; U.S.S. Enterprise-related personnel;
text: OFFICER Leadership SECURITY Honor When discarded, may download {any Jean-Luc Picard} here.
lore: A Satarran memory wipe resulted in the Klingon Worf briefly commanding the U.S.S. Enterprise.

name: Duras (Dramatis Personae)
text: V.I.P. Treachery x 2 Leadership Diplomacy If {K'mpec} or {Sela} in play, may avoid random selections.
lore: High Council member. Klingon who conspired with Romulans. His family started the Klingon Civil War.

name: Zefram Cochrane (Dramatis Personae)
text: V.I.P. Leadership ENGINEER Astrophysics DL/ {Where No Man Has Gone Before}
lore: Human pioneer. Attended the dedication ceremony at the Warp Five Complex in 2119. Plans for statues and theme parks drove him to explore space again.

name: Kes (Dramatis Personae)
text: CIVILIAN Empathy x 2 Treachery ENGINEER Physics Greed May download {Bigger on the Inside} once.
lore: Ocampa, former nurse, and temporal agent. Confused by her psychic abilities, she traveled to the past intending to trade her shipmates to the Vidiians.

name: T'Mir
text: SCIENCE OFFICER Geology Anthropology May download {Cashing In} once (if on {Earth}).
lore: Vulcan ancestor of T'Pol. She crash-landed on Earth in the 20th century. Aided Mestral's effort to remain in Carbon Creek. Introduced humanity to Velcro.

name: Jonathan Archer (Dramatis Personae)
text: SECURITY Leadership May download {Maternal Instinct} once. Anthropology Your Youth personnel may report here.
lore: Human captain who obsessively protected a nest of Xindi-Insectoid eggs which had imprinted on him. He was assisted by Jeremiah Hayes.

name: Kira Nerys (Dramatis Personae)*
text: OFFICER Diplomacy Computer Skill Navigation SECURITY DL/ {Treaty: Bajoran/Dominion}
lore: After the Dominion commandeered DS9, the Bajoran stayed aboard to represent her homeworld, as Bajor had signed a non-aggression pact with the Dominion.

name: Neelix (Dramatis Personae)*
text: SECURITY Honor Diplomacy Geology DL/ {Surprise Reinforcements}
lore: Talaxian who was altered to appear Klingon in one of Karr's holoprograms. Experienced warrior. The son of Eximar likes to drink heavily on the eve of battle.

name: The Doctor (Dramatis Personae)*
text: MEDICAL Exobiology Biology Computer Skill Treachery MEDICAL Music
lore: A doctor, not a counterinsurgent, who unwittingly joined the Kazon-Nistrim. He told Seska he didn't care who was running Voyager.

name: Duras (Dramatis Personae)*
text: V.I.P. Treachery x 2 Leadership Diplomacy If {K'mpec} or {Sela} in play, may avoid random selections.
lore: High Council member. Klingon who conspired with Romulans. His family started the Klingon Civil War.

name: Jonathan Archer (Dramatis Personae)*
text: SECURITY Leadership May download {Maternal Instinct} once. Anthropology Your Youth personnel may report here.
lore: Human captain who obsessively protected a nest of Xindi-Insectoid eggs which had imprinted on him. He was assisted by Jeremiah Hayes.

name: Maternal Instinct *VP
text: Plays on table. Your cards are all compatible with each other. Your Youth personnel are attributes all +1. Nullified if you own and control a personnel without printed Youth and without "Youth" or "non-Youth" in gametext.
lore: In 2267, a Horta began killing human miners on Janus VI in order to protect its young.

name: Uri'lash (All Good Things Remastered)
text: SECURITY Honor Biology
lore: Typical Hupyrian. Hired by Brunt as a bodyguard during his brief stint as Grand Nagus in 2374.

name: Lokirrim Vessel (All Good Things Remastered)
text: Tractor Beam All [Holo] cards here are deactivated.
lore: The Lokirrim, at war with photonic insurgents, forbid the use of holograms in their space. Their ships can emit a disruption field that decompiles holographic matrices.

name: Lt. Palmer (All Good Things Remastered)
text: ENGINEER Anthropology Computer Skill
lore: Representative of female relief officers serving on Federation starships. Such officers routinely fill in for crewmembers on shore leave or restricted duty.

name: Shandor (All Good Things Remastered)
keywords: Bajoran; Deep Space 9-related personnel; Male; Prylar;
text: CIVILIAN Archaeology Diplomacy Honor
lore: Prylar representative of members of the Bajoran clergy. Maintains the shrine aboard Deep Space 9.

name: Sunad (All Good Things Remastered)
text: OFFICER SECURITY Leadership Physics Law
lore: Zalkonian captain. He sought to capture criminals undergoing a dangerous mutation before they could further disrupt society.

name: Admiral Janeway (All Good Things Remastered)
text: V.I.P. SCIENCE ENGINEER Leadership Computer Skill Physics DL/ {Ablative Armor}
lore: In an alternate future, the U.S.S. Voyager was lost for 23 years. So Kathryn Janeway travelled back in time to give her younger self a faster route home.

name: Admiral Riker (All Good Things Remastered)
text: V.I.P. Leadership x 2 Diplomacy Navigation Music Your leaders here may initiate battle against [Kli]. DL/ {Any Enterprise} (if aboard your matching facility).
lore: Commander of Starbase 247 in an alternate future. At odds with Governor Worf. Battled Klingons near Devron.

name: Aid Clone Colony (All Good Things Remastered)
text: Biology + Diplomacy + MEDICAL x2 + CUNNING>36 When you solve, may download a copy of a personnel in play. Opponent's side: No gametext.
lore: Help small population of clones who are suffering from replicative fading of their DNA.

name: Anij (All Good Things Remastered)
text: CIVILIAN Twice per game, may nullify a non-[Ref] interrupt and place it atop owner's draw deck. Anthropology
lore: Ba'ku female who became romantically involved with Jean-Luc Picard. In her 300 years, learned to sustain a perfect moment in time - but never learned to swim.

name: Artim (All Good Things Remastered)
text: CIVILIAN Youth Your non-Treachery personnel present are each attributes all +1 (or +2 if they also have Youth).
lore: Twelve-year-old Ba'ku child. Son of Sojef. Taught Data the importance of play and having a little fun every day.

name: Bluegill Infestation (All Good Things Remastered)
text: Seeds on table; place up to seven unique personnel face up beneath here from outside the game. Your copies of those personnel in play are STRENGTH +5, considered Bluegills, and may not be stunned. Also, when one of your Bluegills is killed, you must randomly select a personnel from here; if it matches one who was killed, that personnel was considered to be the Bluegill Queen. (Unique.)

name: Calondon (All Good Things Remastered)
text: Smuggling personnel in crew may use hand weapons to complete "{cargo runs.}"
lore: Independent freighter commanded by Zef'No. In 2370, ran weapons supplied by the Cardassians to the Bajoran isolationists of the Circle.

name: Changeling Sweep (All Good Things Remastered)
text: Plays to "sweep" an opponent's discard pile: examine it and place any interrupt cards (except [BO] or [Ref] cards) out-of-play.
lore: Changelings will be forced into a gelatinous state by a mid-level phaser stun. In 2372, special units were placed in many Starfleet facilities to ensure that empty rooms were in fact truly so.

name: Christopher Pike (All Good Things Remastered)
text: OFFICER SECURITY Honor Diplomacy Leadership Your other [OS] personnel here are attributes all +1.
lore: Noted human captain. He commanded the Starship Enterprise, succeeding Robert April and preceeding Captain Kirk. Explored many strange new worlds.

name: Colonel Kira (All Good Things Remastered)
keywords: Bajoran; Colonel; Deep Space 9-related personnel; Female;
text: OFFICER SECURITY Honor Diplomacy Leadership Computer Skill X=2 if a [Rom] personnel in play.
lore: During Captain Sisko's absence after the death of Jadzia Dax, Kira Nerys was promoted to command DS9. She soon learned the responsibilities of the captain's chair.

name: Dimensional Shifting (All Good Things Remastered)
text: During your turn, discard a random card from hand to place any number of your personnel and equipment at one mission aboard any ship at the same mission.
lore: Powerful form of folded space transport, capable of penetrating all known shields and forcefields. Repeated use of the technology causes a fatal degradation of the subject's cellular chemistry.

name: Empathic Touch (All Good Things Remastered)
text: When your personnel is about to be killed, if your Empathy personnel is present, stop both personnel to prevent that.
lore: It's accelerating. You have no more time for games.

name: Environmental Suit (All Good Things Remastered)
text: You may discard this equipment to prevent a personnel present from being killed by a dilemma or a Tactic card (that personnel is stopped instead).
lore: Self-contained garment for protecting personnel in a hostile environment. A variable magnetic field can be activated in the boots when working in zero-gravity.

name: Espionage: Bajoran on Dominion (All Good Things Remastered)
text: Plays on a [DOM] mission (for free if your {Odo} there). Your cards may attempt it as if it were [BAJ]. Discard when solved (just after points are scored).
lore: No strangers to oppression, many Bajorans fought the 2374 Dominion occupation from within. With Odo's help, Kira's small "resistance cell" paved the way for the Dominion withdrawal.

name: Gideon Seyetik (All Good Things Remastered)
text: SCIENCE Each time he helps solve a mission requiring SCIENCE, you may draw a card. Astrophysics Physics x 2
lore: Gifted terraformer who in 2370 planned to crown his career by reigniting the burned-out star Epsilon 119. Failure - and modesty - do not agree well with him.

name: In for a Trim (All Good Things Remastered)
text: Seeds or plays on table. {Barber Pole} and {Mot's Advice} play for free. Once each turn, if you have Barber Pole in play, you may "take a little off the top": examine the top X cards of opponent's draw deck, where X is the number of your non-[Bor] Barbering personnel in play. You may discard any events, incidents, or interrupts (except [BO] and [Ref] cards), then replace the rest in any order.

name: Kobayashi Maru Scenario (All Good Things Remastered)
text: Seeds or plays on a mission; adds Computer Skill to mission requirements. At the start of each mission attempt here, one attempting personnel (random selection) is placed beneath this incident ("in play" for uniqueness only). When a player solves this mission, all of their compatible personnel beneath this incident join the solving crew or Away Team (any other personnel are discarded). (Unique.)

name: K'Temoc (All Good Things Remastered)
text: OFFICER Astrophysics Transporter Skill Geology DL/ {Engage Cloak}
lore: Captain of the sleeper ship I.K.S. T'Ong, on a crucial mission ordered by the High Command in the late 23rd century. Awoke 75 years later in a much-changed galaxy.

name: Miral Paris (All Good Things Remastered)
text: OFFICER Youth Honor Anthropology ENGINEER Diplomacy (x2 if {Treaty: Federation/Klingon} is in play).
lore: 1/4 Klingon, 3/4 human. Inherited Tom Paris's charm and B'Elanna Torres's temper. In an alternate future, she helped Admiral Janeway negotiate with Korath.

name: Miral Paris (All Good Things Remastered)*
text: OFFICER Youth Honor Anthropology ENGINEER Diplomacy (x2 if {Treaty: Federation/Klingon} is in play).
lore: 1/4 Klingon, 3/4 human. Inherited Tom Paris's charm and B'Elanna Torres's temper. In an alternate future, she helped Admiral Janeway negotiate with Korath.

name: Raimus (All Good Things Remastered)
text: ENGINEER Acquisition Leadership Treachery x 2 Orion Syndicate
lore: Farian crime lord and thief. Oversees a significant Orion Syndicate operation based on Farius Prime. When he tells you to do something, you just do it.

name: Raymond Boone (All Good Things Remastered)
text: ENGINEER Attributes all +2 if with {Miles O'Brien} or {Benjamin Maxwell}. Computer Skill Physics
lore: Starfleet officer who served on the U.S.S. Rutledge in the Federation/Cardassian war. Captured at Setlik III in 2347 and subsequently killed while in captivity.

name: Reklar (All Good Things Remastered)
keywords: Capturing-related card; Cardassian ship; Tractor Beam;
text: WEAPONS +2 and SHIELDS +1 while you have a captive. Tractor Beam
lore: In response to tensions along the Cardassian/Federation border, this ship was sent to attend diplomatic talks with the U.S.S. Enterprise.

name: Robert DeSoto (All Good Things Remastered)
text: OFFICER If on {U.S.S. Hood}, your compatible V.I.P.s may report aboard. Leadership Honor Exobiology
lore: Captain of the U.S.S. Hood and former commanding officer of William T. Riker. Years ago, he and Jean-Luc Picard served together as lieutenants on the same ship.

name: Shape-Shift Inhibitor (All Good Things Remastered)
text: Seeds or plays on table; may not leave play. Each DL/ used during an attempt downloads target card to hand (except [Tactic]); if it can't be immediately played, it is discarded.
lore: Prototype device developed by the Obsidian Order. Emits a quantum stasis field that prevents a changeling from altering its biomolecular structure.

name: Sojef (All Good Things Remastered)
text: CIVILIAN Leadership Diplomacy Biology Archaeology
lore: Leader of the small community of Ba'ku that settled a new world in the Briar Patch. Ardent supporter of a simple way of life, free of advanced technology.

name: Strategema (All Good Things Remastered)
text: Seeds or plays on table. {Q's Planet} may not enter play. Your opponent may not initiate battle at a homeworld against your force containing a card matching that homeworld.
lore: Against an opponent of equivalent skill, a game of Strategema can last well over one thousand moves.

name: Timepod Ring (All Good Things Remastered)
text: Plays on table. Once each turn, you may examine the top card of your deck. Also, you may discard this event and the top card of your draw deck to nullify an [AU] dilemma.
lore: Small device used to monitor the auto-timer on the time travel pod appropriated by Berlinghoff Rasmussen. As he was uncertain how to reprogram the timer, the ring was very precious to him.

name: Tournel (All Good Things Remastered)
text: CIVILIAN Leadership ENGINEER Computer Skill Physics
lore: Chief engineer of the ship that first brought the Ba'ku to their new home in 2066. Now one of the more respected "elders" in their idyllic community.

name: Treacherous Advice (All Good Things Remastered)
text: Examine opponent's hand. You may discard one of those cards for each Leadership personnel present with one of your infiltrators who is infiltrating. Discard event after use.
lore: For many months, a changeling posing as General Martok manipulated the Klingon Empire through choice lies whispered in the ear of Chancellor Gowron.

name: Tsunkatse Ship (All Good Things Remastered)
text: Your personnel with "Tsunkatse" in lore may report aboard. Tractor Beam
lore: Formidable vessel commanded by Penk, from which he broadcasts his popular fighting circuit. Heavily shielded to prevent anyone from abducting his competitors.

name: U.S.S. Drake (All Good Things Remastered)
text: Holodeck, Tractor Beam
lore: Starfleet vessel, registry NCC-20381. In 2364, was assigned a routine mission of exploration in and around the Lorenze Cluster under the command of Paul Rice.

name: U.S.S. Grissom (All Good Things Remastered)
keywords: Federation ship; Ship with a Skill; Tractor Beam;
text: Tractor Beam, SCIENCE
lore: Science vessel assigned to survey and investigate the planet Genesis in 2285. Named for one of Earth's earliest space explorers.

name: U.S.S. Pegasus (All Good Things Remastered)
text: Tractor Beam DL/ {Phased Cloaking Device}
lore: Modified prototype on which an experimental cloak was secretly tested in 2358. Some of the crew mutinied against Erik Pressman for his violation of treaty.

name: Weyoun 6 (All Good Things Remastered)
text: CIVILIAN Diplomacy x 2 Leadership Honor Law Biology May replace any changeling present selected to die.
lore: Activated after his predecessor's suspicious death, this clone of the Vorta Weyoun had subtle errors. He hoped to end the Dominion War by defecting to Odo's side.

name: Yeoman Rand (All Good Things Remastered)
text: OFFICER Youth Biology ENGINEER DL/ {File Mission Report} [OS] personnel may file mission reports aboard her ship.
lore: Janice Rand is yeoman to Captain Kirk aboard the Starship Enterprise. She was captain of the Academy Diving Team. Student of horticulture and xenobotany.

name: Archer: Precise Bowman
text: Kills one personnel (your choice) for each affiliation icon on this mission with no matching personnel present.
lore: Whilst being hunted down on Capella IV, Mr. Spock constructed a bow and arrows. The Capellans were surprised by his level of accuracy.

name: Geological Instability
text: Unless total ENGINEER+Geology present>7 - mission span, place on mission. Now and at start of each attempt here, one personnel (random selection) is killed.
lore: With Drema IV on the verge of tearing itself apart, the crew of the U.S.S. Enterprise used harmonic resonators to alleviate the tectonic stresses and save the inhabitants.

name: No Buffer Time
text: Stops 9-X personnel (random selection), where X=this mission's span. Opponent may re-seed dilemma beneath a mission with more affiliation icons facing you than this mission.
lore: The introduction of timed deadlines for the crew of the U.S.S. Cerritos resulted in chaos and inefficiency as the crew struggled to meet their strict timetable.

name: Send in the Clones
text: Plays on any mission requiring Biology and MEDICAL OR {Boreth}. When you solve, may discard to download here a copy of a personnel in play you own (ignoring uniqueness).
lore: With only five surviving colonists from the S.S. Mariposa being insufficient to build a colony, the remaining scientists used cloning to increase their population.

name: Abandoned Cube
text: Seed one at any [DQ] mission with "Borg" in lore. Once each turn, you may draw a card when you play a [Com], [Nav], or [Def] personnel aboard.
lore: The Borg Collective can isolate faulty ships, leaving drones independent and free from the hive mind.

name: Group of Individuals
text: Plays on your mission. When you solve with a crew or Away Team that includes at least 6 personnel who are [Non] Borg or <Y) , you may discard incident to download a <Y) or unique [Non] Borg personnel.
lore: Hugh's attack on Lore proved that the Rogue Borg didn't need to follow anybody and could think for themselves.

name: Acquire Food Replicator
text: ENGINEER + SECURITY + Greed + Physics
lore: Receive stolen technology on planet rich in leola roots.

name: Cleanse Telepaths
text: Leadership + SECURITY + Biology + Treachery When solved, kills all Empathy and Mindmeld in [DQ].
lore: Inspect and scan all vessels and purge any telepaths detected.

name: Collapse Spatial Vortex
text: Astrophysics x2 + Navigation + ship with WEAPONS>7
lore: Escape void and close Malon waste route.

name: Equalize Treatment Levels
text: MEDICAL x2 + Biology + INTEGRITY>40
lore: Ensure fair and equitable treatment for all patients.

name: Evade Assailants
text: Landed ship + ENGINEER x2 + CUNNING >35
lore: Shelter on irradiated world and avoid revival of local conflict.

name: Evade Detection
text: Navigation + Archaeology + SCIENCE
lore: Utilize ancient hideout constructed from neutronium alloy.

name: Evade Neural Harvest
text: Stellar Cartography + Anthropology + SECURITY
lore: Navigate safely around hostile life-forms in dark matter nebula.

name: Exile Enemies
text: SECURITY + Treachery + Leadership + Navigation Score 5 points when you overcome {Hanonian Land Eel} here.
lore: Strand foes on primitive world to see if they can survive without their technology.

name: Explore Micro-Wormhole
text: Transporter Skill + Astrophysics x2 + OFFICER * +5 if you own a {Temporal Micro-Wormhole} in play.
lore: Examine odd phase variance in decaying subspace conduit.

name: Explore Sleeping Giant
text: Computer Skill x2 + SCIENCE + (ENGINEER OR [Com] OR a Medusan)
lore: Access critical information aboard disabled Borg cube.

name: Harvest Specimens
text: Leadership x2 + SECURITY + Stellar Cartography + CUNNING>40
lore: Pursue vessel and extract healthy organs from the crew.

name: Impersonate Sages
text: Treachery x2 + Greed + Anthropology When seeded, may download {Barzan Wormhole} adjacent.
lore: Exploit primitive locals by posing as mythical demigods.

name: Intercept Lone Intruder
text: OFFICER + Honor + (STRENGTH>30 OR [Kaz] Youth)
lore: Patrol Kazon-Ogla territory and capture unprotected interlopers.

name: Investigate Holotechnology Malfunction
text: ENGINEER + Computer Skill + SECURITY
lore: Study holosimulations for cause of massacre.

name: Nucleate Genetic Material
text: Exobiology + MEDICAL + Treachery x2 Removes males killed here from the game.
lore: Lure males from other species to participate in fatal procreation rites.

name: Optimize Performance Venue
text: Diplomacy + Leadership + ENGINEER *+5 for each Music in Away Team (limit 4).
lore: Introduce music to society and prepare concert recital.

name: Protostar Study
text: SCIENCE + Diplomacy + Honor + Stellar Cartography
lore: Contact photonic life via holodeck simulation and conduct exchange.

name: Pursue Holographic Prey
text: Navigation x2 + Astrophysics + STRENGTH>42
lore: Overcome sensor interference and track rebellious photonics.

name: Raid Technology
text: Acquisition + Transporter Skill + (thief OR Treachery x2)
lore: Steal equipment using high-energy transporter.

name: Reclaim Stolen Goods
text: Honor + ENGINEER + SECURITY + ([Holo] personnel OR Leadership)
lore: Infiltrate black market to recover hijacked equipment.

name: Salvage Borg Technology
text: ENGINEER x2 + (Cybernetics OR Acquisition)
lore: Reactivate Borg neuro-electric field generator.

name: Seek Sporocystian Lifeform
text: Leadership + Diplomacy + CUNNING>40 Your {Caretaker's Array} must seed here (limit one here). Opponent's side: No gametext.
lore: Search for powerful entity and former companion to the Caretaker.

name: Test Transwarp Engines
text: (ENGINEER x3 OR Navigation x3) + {Type 9 Shuttlecraft}
lore: Assess ability to safely maintain high-warp velocities.

name: Track Mutated Crew
text: Biology + Exobiology + personnel of 2 different genders {Primal Urges} relocates here from any quadrant.
lore: Locate rapidly evolved colleagues for anti-proton treatments.

name: Traverse Void
text: Astrophysics + Honor + no Stellar Cartography *+10 if you have solved another Star Desert mission.
lore: Cross vast area and maintain crew morale.

name: Utilize Abandoned Network II
text: Navigation + SECURITY + Honor + CUNNING>36 WORMHOLE: You may move your staffed ship between here and any other location if that location is a [Wmh] mission OR by playing one {Wormhole} interrupt there. Then flip this mission over.
lore: Reactivate Borg conduit.

name: Utilize Abandoned Network II (back)
text: Navigation + SECURITY + Honor + CUNNING>36 If you have a staffed ship here, you may play {Long-Range Scan} here to "detect Wormhole" (flip mission over).
lore: Reactivate Borg conduit.

name: Intercept Lone Intruder II
text: OFFICER + Honor + (STRENGTH>30 OR [Kaz] Youth) If destroyed, flip mission over.
lore: Patrol and capture interlopers.

name: Intercept Lone Intruder II (back)
text: OFFICER + Honor + (STRENGTH>30 OR [Kaz] Youth) If your Kazon ENGINEER is here, in place of your normal card play may flip mission over, draw no cards that turn.
lore: Patrol and capture interlopers.

name: Evade Detection II
text: Navigation + Archaeology + SCIENCE If destroyed, flip mission over.
lore: Utilize ancient hideout constructed from neutronium alloy.

name: Evade Detection II (back)
text: Navigation + Archaeology + SCIENCE If your Vidiian ENGINEER is here, in place of your normal card play, you may flip mission over, draw no cards that turn.
lore: Utilize ancient hideout constructed from neutronium alloy.

name: Dala
text: OFFICER Diplomacy Computer Skill SCIENCE Treachery Greed Acquisition
lore: Humanoid con artist, thief, and liar who impersonated Kathryn Janeway. She took advantage of the Federation's trustworthy reputation for personal gain.

name: Derran Tal
text: CIVILIAN Stellar Cartography Biology ENGINEER If with {Harry Kim}, both are attributes all +2.
lore: Varro dissident who became romantically involved with Harry Kim. She designed a synthetic parasite to attack and dismantle the Varro's generational ship.

name: Investigate Holotechnology Malfunction II
text: ENGINEER + Computer Skill + SECURITY If destroyed, flip mission over.
lore: Study holosimulations.

name: Investigate Holotechnology Malfunction II (back)
text: ENGINEER + Computer Skill + SECURITY If your Hirogen ENGINEER is here, in place of your normal card play, you may flip mission over; draw no cards that turn.
lore: Study holosimulations.

name: Icheb* *VP
text: CIVILIAN ENGINEER Astrophysics Physics Youth Stellar Cartography Biology
lore: Borg rescued from the collective and his own people, the Brunali. Takes Starfleet Academy courses, taught by U.S.S. Voyager's crew. Prot g of Seven of Nine.

name: Icheb *VP
text: CIVILIAN ENGINEER Astrophysics Physics Youth Stellar Cartography Biology
lore: Borg rescued from the collective and his own people, the Brunali. Takes Starfleet Academy courses, taught by U.S.S. Voyager's crew. Prot g of Seven of Nine.

name: Humuhumunukunukuapua'a *VP
text: Plays on any location. Your Youth personnel here are CUNNING and STRENGTH +4; opponent's [Non] personnel here are CUNNING and STRENGTH 4.
lore: A reef triggerfish, Rhinecanthus rectangulus, found near Earth's tropical islands. An animated version is a symbolic "guide" on the U.S.S. Enterprise schoolroom computers.

name: Soong-type Android *VP
keywords: Android; Female; Inorganic; Male; Neuter; Soong-type android;
text: Computer Skill Youth DL/ * When reported, select classification and gender (male, female, or genderless).
lore: A recently produced Soong-type android ready to select its gender and appearance. Replicated using a method developed by Data.

name: Lal *VP
text: CIVILIAN Computer Skill Youth When reported, gains two different skills present.
lore: Soong-type android and daughter of Data. Created through replication of Data's positronic pathways. Named for the Hindi word for imzadi or beloved.

name: FGC-47 Research *VP
text: Diplomacy + Youth x2 X = 6 minus each Navigation aboard ship (minimum 0).
lore: Study interior of nebula filled with energy strands that obstruct navigation.

name: Haakona (Premiere Traditional)
keywords: Cloaking Device; Romulan ship; Tractor Beam;
text: Cloaking Device, Tractor Beam
lore: Subcommander Taris' warbird. Responded to the Federation incursion of the Neutral Zone, near Iconia.

name: Hannah Bates (Premiere Traditional)
keywords: Human; Female; Mission Specialist; U.S.S. Enterprise-related personnel;
text: SCIENCE Physics
lore: Genetically engineered scientist from Moab IV. Granted asylum aboard U.S.S. Enterprise in 2368.

name: Type VI Shuttlecraft (Premiere Traditional)
keywords: Federation ship; No staffing requirement; Shuttlecraft;
lore: Modern Federation shuttle with warp capability. May be armed for special missions.

name: U.S.S. Excelsior (Premiere Traditional)
text: Tractor Beam
lore: First launched in 2284 as a test for what proved to be the unsuccessful transwarp project. Now uses standard warp drive.

name: U.S.S. Galaxy (Premiere Traditional)
keywords: Federation ship; Holodeck; Prototype; Tractor Beam;
text: Holodeck, Tractor Beam
lore: Prototype in this elite class of ships was the U.S.S. Galaxy, after which the class was named.

name: U.S.S. Miranda (Premiere Traditional)
text: Tractor Beam
lore: Small ship class from the late 23rd century. Named for a character in Shakespeare's play, The Tempest.

name: U.S.S. Nebula (Premiere Traditional)
text: Holodeck, Tractor Beam
lore: Modern class of ship featuring large upper equipment modules customizable for specific mission uses.

name: U.S.S. Oberth (Premiere Traditional)
text: Tractor Beam
lore: Class of small ships often used for scientific missions. Named for 20th century rocket scientist Hermann Oberth.

name: Varel (Premiere Traditional)
text: SCIENCE Physics Computer Skill Youth
lore: Representative of female Romulans trained in the field of science. Assigned to assist with interphase generator project.

name: Vekma (Premiere Traditional)
keywords: Klingon; Female; I.K.S. Pagh-related personnel; Mission Specialist;
text: MEDICAL Honor
lore: Klingon female trained in Klingon anatomy and medicine. Propositioned Commander William T. Riker on the I.K.C. Pagh in 2365.

name: Albert Einstein (Premiere Traditional)
text: SCIENCE Physics x 2 Astrophysics
lore: Re-creation of the famed 20th century human. Author of the theory of relativity.

name: Batrell (Premiere Traditional)
text: OFFICER Honor
lore: Klingon trained as an officer for the Klingon Defense Force. Formerly in command of Narendra III outpost.

name: B'iJik (Premiere Traditional)
text: OFFICER Navigation
lore: Klingon male trained as an officer for the Klingon Defense Force. Served as junior adjutant to the diplomatic delegation for Gowron.

name: Calloway (Premiere Traditional)
keywords: Human; Female; Mission Specialist; U.S.S. Enterprise-related personnel;
text: MEDICAL Youth
lore: Ensign Calloway is representative of Starfleet medical technicians. Served aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise in 2370.

name: Christopher Hobson (Premiere Traditional)
text: OFFICER Computer Skill
lore: Lt. Commander Christopher Hobson is representative of staff officers in Starfleet. Served aboard the U.S.S. Sutherland in 2368.

name: Combat Vessel (Premiere Traditional)
lore: A little-known class of attack craft. One such vessel attacked the U.S.S. Enterprise in 2368 at Surplus Depot Zed-15.

name: Darian Wallace (Premiere Traditional)
keywords: Human; Male; Mission Specialist; U.S.S. Enterprise-related personnel;
text: SECURITY Anthropology
lore: Ensign Darian Wallace is representative of Starfleet security officers. Held numerous positions aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise.

name: D'deridex (Premiere Traditional)
keywords: Cloaking Device; Romulan ship; Tractor Beam;
text: Cloaking Device, Tractor Beam
lore: Imperial Romulan Warbird. A massive ship significantly larger than a Galaxy class starship.

name: Divok (Premiere Traditional)
text: MEDICAL Biology Youth
lore: Male trained in Klingon anatomy and medicine. Studied the effects of Tribbles on the Klingon nervous system.

name: Dr. Farek (Premiere Traditional)
text: MEDICAL Greed
lore: Dr. Farek is representative of male Ferengi trained in medicine. Seized control of the D'Kora class Ferengi Marauder, Krayton, in 2366.

name: Dr. Leah Brahms (Premiere Traditional)
text: ENGINEER ENGINEER
lore: Re-creation who said, "I'm with you every day, Geordi. Every time you look at this engine, you're looking at me. Every time you touch it, it's me."

name: Dukath (Premiere Traditional)
keywords: Klingon; I.K.S. Pagh-related personnel; Male; Mission Specialist;
text: SCIENCE Archaeology
lore: Klingon trained in the field of science. Studied the effects of Berthold rays on plant life. Served aboard the I.K.C. Pagh.

name: Exocomp (Premiere Traditional)
text: ENGINEER If aboard ship, can repair damage in two of your full turns, without returning to outpost.
lore: Sentient artificial life-form incorporating an advanced microreplication system. Specializes in repair tasks. Servomechanism designed by Dr. Farallon.

name: Fek'lhr (Premiere Traditional)
text: V.I.P. Honor Treachery
lore: Re-creation of mythical Klingon beast. Guardian of Gre'thor, where the dishonored go to die.

name: Galathon (Premiere Traditional)
text: OFFICER Archaeology Greed Treachery
lore: Romulan officer representative of those serving the Romulan Star Empire. Pursuer of DNA program in 2369.

name: Giusti (Premiere Traditional)
keywords: Human; Female; Mission Specialist; U.S.S. Enterprise-related personnel;
text: OFFICER Youth
lore: Ensign Giusti is representative of staff officers in Starfleet. Served at the Ops console aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise in 2370.

name: Gorath (Premiere Traditional)
keywords: Klingon; High Council; Male; Mission Specialist;
text: SECURITY Honor
lore: Klingon trained in the field of security. Guarded the Klingon High Council chamber in the year of Maktag. Served as security chief for the Hegh'bat division.

name: Gorta (Premiere Traditional)
text: ENGINEER Physics Greed
lore: Male of Dopterian race. Representative of non-aligned agents. An opportunist. Had an encounter with the sisters of Duras in 2370.

name: Husnock Ship (Premiere Traditional)
text: Holodeck, Tractor Beam
lore: With a single thought, Kevin Uxbridge killed the entire Husnock race (50 billion lives) everywhere in the universe. Their powerful ships remain.

name: I.K.C. K'Vort (Premiere Traditional)
keywords: Bird-of-Prey; Cloaking Device; Klingon ship; Tractor Beam;
text: Cloaking Device, Tractor Beam
lore: Class of ships identical in configuration to the classic B'rel class Klingon Bird-of-Prey, although much larger.

name: I.K.C. Vor'Cha (Premiere Traditional)
keywords: Cloaking Device; Klingon ship; Tractor Beam;
text: Cloaking Device, Tractor Beam
lore: Large attack cruiser. The modern mainstay of the Klingon Defense Force.

name: Jaron (Premiere Traditional)
text: SECURITY Geology Youth
lore: Romulan trained in the field of security. A former member of the Tal Shiar intelligence service.

name: J'Ddan (Premiere Traditional)
text: SCIENCE Exobiology Treachery
lore: Klingon trained in the field of science. Smuggled Federation secrets to the Romulans in the form of amino acid codes.

name: Jera (Premiere Traditional)
text: MEDICAL Biology Youth
lore: Re-creation of a female Romulan. Alien entity assumed this body in 2369.

name: Klag (Premiere Traditional)
keywords: Klingon; I.K.S. Pagh-related personnel; Male; Mission Specialist;
text: OFFICER Navigation
lore: Second Officer Klag, of the I.K.C. Pagh, is representative of Klingon warriors throughout the Klingon Empire.

name: Kle'eg (Premiere Traditional)
text: SECURITY Honor
lore: Klingon trained in the specific field of security. Guarded the House of K'mpec when K'mpec was poisoned in 2367.

name: Kromm (Premiere Traditional)
text: ENGINEER Physics
lore: Klingon trained in the field of engineering. Reputed to have consumed fifteen rokeg blood pies at one sitting.

name: K'Tesh (Premiere Traditional)
text: ENGINEER Stellar Cartography
lore: Re-creation who assisted in the Age of Ascension ritual. Perfected current pain-stick design for ritual use.

name: Linda Larson (Premiere Traditional)
text: ENGINEER Youth
lore: Lieutenant Linda Larson is representative of staff engineers serving in Starfleet.

name: McKnight (Premiere Traditional)
text: OFFICER Navigation Youth Music
lore: Ensign McKnight is one of many helm officers serving aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise. Distant relative of a famous 20th century game designer.

name: Mendon (Premiere Traditional)
keywords: Benzite; Male; Mission Specialist; U.S.S. Enterprise-related personnel;
text: SCIENCE Physics
lore: Ensign Mendon is a Benzite male representative of science specialists within Starfleet. Served aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise in 2365. Looks like Mordock.

name: Mercenary Ship (Premiere Traditional)
text: Long-Range Scan Shielding
lore: Little-known ship. Difficult to track due to a unique hull design that renders it invisible to long-range scans. Baran captained one in 2370.

name: Narik (Premiere Traditional)
keywords: Male; Mission Specialist; Stone of Gol-related personnel;
text: ENGINEER Computer Skill
lore: Representative of male mercenaries operating throughout the galaxy. Worked with Baran to find the Stone of Gol.

name: Palteth (Premiere Traditional)
text: ENGINEER Computer Skill
lore: Romulan trained in the field of engineering. A specialist in artificial quantum singularity. Served aboard the Khazara in 2369.

name: Runabout (Premiere Traditional)
lore: Resembles a large shuttle. Contains living accommodations. Modular design can be re-configured for different mission profiles.

name: Science Vessel (Premiere Traditional)
lore: Specialized science ship used for an Interphase Generator experiment in 2368.

name: Scout Vessel (Premiere Traditional)
keywords: No staffing requirement; Romulan ship; Scout;
lore: Class of small, versatile ships used by the Romulan Star Empire for reconnaissance and science missions.

name: Selok (Premiere Traditional)
text: V.I.P. Treachery
lore: Subcommander Selok is a female Romulan agent. Successfully posed as Vulcan Ambassador T'Pel.

name: Simon Tarses (Premiere Traditional)
text: MEDICAL Youth
lore: Crewman First Class Simon Tarses is representative of Starfleet medical technicians. He is 1/4 Romulan, 3/4 Human.

name: Sir Isaac Newton (Premiere Traditional)
text: SCIENCE Physics x 2
lore: Re-creation of the famous 18th century human. Originator of calculus and the classic laws of physics.

name: Sito Jaxa (Premiere Traditional)
keywords: Bajoran; Female; Support Personnel; U.S.S. Enterprise-related personnel;
text: SECURITY Navigation Youth
lore: Ensign Sito Jaxa, a Bajoran, is one of a number of navigation officers aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise.

name: Taitt (Premiere Traditional)
keywords: Human; Female; Support Personnel; U.S.S. Enterprise-related personnel;
text: SCIENCE Stellar Cartography Geology
lore: Ensign Taitt is representative of science specialists from Starfleet Academy. Helped the U.S.S. Enterprise destroy a Borg ship in 2370.

name: Takket (Premiere Traditional)
text: MEDICAL Exobiology
lore: Romulan male trained in Romulan anatomy and medicine. Extensively trained in exobiology.

name: Tallus (Premiere Traditional)
text: OFFICER Leadership
lore: Romulan officer representative of those serving the Romulan Star Empire. Former commander of private forces under Commander Sela.

name: Tarus (Premiere Traditional)
text: SCIENCE Stellar Cartography
lore: Representative of male Romulans trained in the field of science. Specialist in the study of extra-dimensional life-forms.

name: Taul (Premiere Traditional)
text: SECURITY Treachery Archaeology
lore: Romulan male trained in the field of security. Assistant to Commander Konsab of the Romulan Intelligence Academy.

name: Taurik (Premiere Traditional)
text: ENGINEER Mindmeld
lore: Lieutenant Taurik is a Vulcan male representative of engineering junior officers serving in Starfleet.

name: Thei (Premiere Traditional)
text: OFFICER Geology Physics
lore: Subcommander Thei is representative of officers serving in the Romulan Star Empire. Ally of the sisters of Duras during the Klingon Civil War.

name: Tomek (Premiere Traditional)
text: ENGINEER Astrophysics
lore: Re-creation of a male Romulan. Alien entity assumed this body in 2369.

name: Torin (Premiere Traditional)
text: SCIENCE Astrophysics
lore: Klingon trained in the field of science. Studied the effects of warp propulsion on subspace.

name: Vekor (Premiere Traditional)
text: SCIENCE MEDICAL Navigation Geology
lore: Representative of female mercenaries operating throughout the galaxy. Worked with Baran to find the Stone of Gol.

name: Benjamin Maxwell (Premiere Traditional)
text: OFFICER Leadership
lore: Captain Benjamin Maxwell of the U.S.S. Phoenix is a bitter enemy of the Cardassians.

name: B'Etor (Premiere Traditional)
text: V.I.P. Treachery Leadership Physics Youth Greed
lore: Plotted with Lursa to seize power from Gowron with the support of the Romulans. Younger of the two Duras sisters. The pretty one.

name: Beverly Crusher (Premiere Traditional)
text: MEDICAL MEDICAL Biology Exobiology
lore: Dr. Beverly Crusher is the chief medical officer of the U.S.S. Enterprise. Dancer and thespian. Widow of Jack Crusher. Mother of Ensign Wesley Crusher.

name: Birth of "Junior" (Premiere Traditional)
text: Place on ship. End of each turn, RANGE reduced by 1; if reduced to 0, ship destroyed. Nullify with 3 ENGINEER.
lore: Large infant spaceborne life-form. Attached itself to the U.S.S. Enterprise in 2368, sucking energy from the ship.

name: Disruptor Overload (Premiere Traditional)
text: Plays on any ship or Away Team. Where present, destroys one Equipment card or one card used as an Equipment card (random selection).
lore: A directed-energy weapon can be set on overload and left to explode like a bomb.

name: Distortion Field (Premiere Traditional)
text: Plays crosswise face up on any planet location. Once each turn, flip card over. While face up, prevents all beaming down/up here.
lore: Atmospheric phenomena that inhibits use of transporters, as on Nervala IV.

name: Distortion of Space/Time Continuum (Premiere Traditional)
text: Plays on any ship. "Unstops" ship, crew, and ship's Away Teams and restores any of this turn's RANGE already used by that ship.
lore: Time effects can be caused by the unusual warping or rifting of space.

name: Yridian Shuttle (Premiere Traditional)
lore: Common shuttlecraft used by Yridian agents and others for covert activities.

name: Zibalian Transport (Premiere Traditional)
keywords: Merchant vessel; No staffing requirement; Transport;
lore: Common class of merchant vessel used by traders such as Kivas Fajo.

name: Alexander Rozhenko (Premiere Traditional)
text: CIVILIAN Honor Youth
lore: 3/4 Klingon, 1/4 Human male. Born on the 43rd day of Maktag. Son of Lieutenant Worf and K'Ehleyr.

name: Alidar Jarok (Premiere Traditional)
text: OFFICER Navigation Leadership
lore: Conscientious admiral who questioned Romulan policy. Eventually stole a scout ship and defected to the Federation in 2366.

name: Alien Abduction (Premiere Traditional)
text: Most CUNNING Away Team member (owner's choice if tie) is held by aliens until mission completed OR 3 Leadership present.
lore: Solanagen-based aliens, existing in a subspace domain, can access our universe and abduct humanoids for study.

name: Alien Groupie (Premiere Traditional)
text: Plays on any Away Team that just completed a planet mission. Female groupie delays beam up of one male (random selection) for one full turn.
lore: Lanel, a Malcorian nurse, agreed to help Commander William T. Riker, but only if he would...

name: Alien Parasites (Premiere Traditional)
text: Unless INTEGRITY>32, Away Team infected. They beam back and opponent immediately controls ship and crew until "stopped." Then turn resumes.
lore: Intelligent parasites enter and take control of a humanoid. Their presence can be detected by a gill like protrusion on the back of a host's neck.

name: Alien Probe (Premiere Traditional)
text: Plays on table. Both players continue the game with their hands (cards) exposed, face up on the table.
lore: Space probes of unknown origin are frequently encountered by starships. Often such probes seek information and contact.

name: Alynna Nechayev (Premiere Traditional)
keywords: Human; Admiral; Female; Support Personnel; Vice-Admiral;
text: OFFICER Diplomacy Leadership
lore: Vice-Admiral Alynna Nechayev is an antagonistic superior of Captain Jean-Luc Picard. Responsible for liaison with the Cardassians and the Maquis.

name: Alyssa Ogawa (Premiere Traditional)
text: MEDICAL Biology
lore: Nurse Alyssa Ogawa is a medical assistant and friend to Dr. Beverly Crusher.

name: Amanda Rogers (Premiere Traditional)
text: Nullifies any one Interrupt card just played (except {Kevin Uxbridge} or another Amanda Rogers card) OR any other card just played as an Interrupt card.
lore: Female Q raised as a human on Earth. Was taken to the Q continuum by Q after she could not resist the benevolent use of her powers.

name: Amarie (Premiere Traditional)
text: CIVILIAN Music
lore: Four-armed pianist. Information broker. Ex-wife of arms smuggler. Four times widowed. Qualor II lounge performer. Knows Aktuh and Melota. Salt sucker.

name: Anaphasic Organism (Premiere Traditional)
text: If Female(s) in Away Team, the one with highest total attribute numbers resigns (is discarded), unless SECURITY and MEDICAL present. Discard dilemma.
lore: A male non-corporeal life-form that lives inside a female host which he enchants, as in the case of Dr. Beverly Crusher's late grandmother.

name: Ancient Computer (Premiere Traditional)
text: Cannot get past unless 2 Computer Skill OR 3 SCIENCE OR 3 ENGINEER present.
lore: Vital information can be retrieved from old or damaged computer systems like this one aboard a derelict Promellian battlecruiser.

name: Anti-Time Anomaly (Premiere Traditional)
text: Plays on table. Kills literally ALL personnel in play (both players' cards) at the end of your third full turn, unless anti-time anomaly destroyed first.
lore: Q-created phenomena. Rift caused by anti-time particles in the future. Anomaly grows backward in time endangering all life in the past.

name: Archer (Premiere Traditional)
text: Away Team member with highest total attribute numbers is shot and dies unless SECURITY and MEDICAL present. Discard dilemma.
lore: Indigenous inhabitants, such as this Mintakan bowman, often attack an Away Team out of fear.

name: Armus - Skin of Evil (Premiere Traditional)
text: Kills one Away Team member (random selection). Discard dilemma.
lore: A malevolent being was formed when the inhabitants of Vagra II rid themselves of all the evil they had inside.

name: Asteroid Sanctuary (Premiere Traditional)
text: Plays on any ship. If 2 Navigation aboard, hides ship to prevent any battle initiated against that ship for this turn.
lore: Hoping to avoid detection by a Romulan Warbird, the U.S.S. Enterprise entered a giant asteroid cavern in 2370.

name: Atmospheric Ionization (Premiere Traditional)
text: Plays crosswise on any planet location. Maximum of three personnel per turn can be beamed up or down at this location. (Unique.)
lore: Charged particles in the atmosphere of planets which can disrupt transporter beams.

name: Auto-Destruct Sequence (Premiere Traditional)
text: Plays on your ship. Ship self-destructs at end of your turn. Explosion damages all other ships at same location that have SHIELDS<8.
lore: Computer controlled self-destruct countdown which can be set by the senior officers aboard a ship.

name: Morag (Premiere Traditional)
text: OFFICER Computer Skill Greed
lore: Klingon officer who stole Federation data from Relay Station 47.

name: Morgan Bateson (Premiere Traditional)
text: OFFICER Leadership Stellar Cartography
lore: Captain Morgan Bateson was in command of the U.S.S. Bozeman when it was caught in a temporal causality loop from 2278 to 2368.

name: Mot the Barber (Premiere Traditional)
keywords: Bolian; Male; Mission Specialist; U.S.S. Enterprise-related personnel;
text: CIVILIAN Barbering
lore: Bolian male. Convivial barber aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise. Snappy conversationalist.

name: Movar (Premiere Traditional)
keywords: Romulan; Duras-related; General; Male; Support Personnel;
text: OFFICER Treachery Anthropology
lore: Romulan general who secretly provided military supplies to Duras family forces during the Klingon Civil War in 2368

name: Taibak (Premiere Traditional)
text: SCIENCE Treachery Biology Computer Skill
lore: Scientist who developed a mind control device using E-band emissions. Controlled Lt. Commander Geordi La Forge through his VISOR.

name: Tam Elbrun (Premiere Traditional)
text: V.I.P. Empathy x 2 Honor
lore: Betazoid male with exceptional empathic abilities. Participated in the notorious Ghorusda disaster. Specialist in first contact with new life-forms.

name: Tarellian Plague Ship (Premiere Traditional)
text: Entire crew immediately dies from plague unless MEDICAL "beams over" (discarded) to Tarellians. Discard dilemma.
lore: Ship containing the survivors of a Tarellia war plague. Infected from biological weapons, they are now refused entry everywhere.

name: Tasha Yar (Premiere Traditional)
keywords: Human; Female; Support Personnel; U.S.S. Enterprise-related personnel;
text: SECURITY Honor Leadership
lore: Lieutenant Natasha Yar served as chief of security on the U.S.S. Enterprise. Courageous orphan of Turkana IV. Proved Lt. Commander Data fully functional.

name: Avert Disaster (Premiere Traditional)
text: Geology + Honor + INTEGRITY>35
lore: Aid project to delay solidification of the planet's core.

name: Ba'el (Premiere Traditional)
text: CIVILIAN Anthropology Youth
lore: 1/2 Klingon, 1/2 Romulan. Romantically involved with Lieutenant Worf. Born in Romulan prison camp in Carraya system.

name: Baran (Premiere Traditional)
keywords: Captain; Male; Stone of Gol-related personnel;
text: OFFICER Greed Archaeology Exobiology Computer Skill
lore: Male captain of a mercenary ship raiding archaeological sites to find the Stone of Gol.

name: Barclay's Protomorphosis Disease (Premiere Traditional)
text: Entire crew or Away Team (except androids) de-evolves (dies) unless MEDICAL, SCIENCE and SECURITY present. Discard dilemma.
lore: Contagious affliction which causes animals to de-evolve into ancestral forms. Disease named for Lieutenant Reginald Barclay.

name: Bochra (Premiere Traditional)
text: OFFICER Navigation Youth
lore: Centurion serving the Romulan Star Empire. Once marooned on Galorndon Core with Lt. Commander Geordi La Forge.

name: Bok (Premiere Traditional)
text: OFFICER Greed ENGINEER Treachery Computer Skill
lore: Former Ferengi DaiMon. Son killed by Captain Jean-Luc Picard in battle. Seeks revenge at all costs.

name: Borg Ship (Premiere Traditional)
text: Self-controlling ship (WEAPONS=24, SHIELDS=24). Start here. Attacks everything. End of every turn, moves 1 card toward and off the spaceline's long end. Destroy for bonus.
lore: Gigantic cubic ship of the Borg collective. Possesses powerful weapons and remarkable regenerative abilities.

name: Bynars Weapon Enhancement (Premiere Traditional)
text: Plays on table. Bynars enhance each of your ship's WEAPONS +2. (Cumulative.)
lore: Binary race closely integrated with computers. Always work in pairs. Bynars have the ability to enhance specific computerized systems.

name: Chalnoth (Premiere Traditional)
text: Kills one Away Team member (opponent's choice) unless 3 SECURITY OR STRENGTH>40 present. Discard dilemma.
lore: Anarchistic lupine race of humanoids with the reputation of violent responses to a variety of situations.

name: Cloaked Mission (Premiere Traditional)
text: Navigation + Diplomacy + Honor
lore: Secretly escort covert operatives to the Romulan homeworld.

name: Cosmic String Fragment (Premiere Traditional)
text: Ship is sucked in and destroyed unless Astrophysics OR ENGINEER OR Navigation aboard. Discard dilemma.
lore: A long space object as thin as a proton but with the gravitational attraction of a hundred stars.

name: Covert Installation (Premiere Traditional)
text: ENGINEER + Leadership + Treachery
lore: Build hidden monitoring station in the Neutral Zone.

name: Covert Rescue (Premiere Traditional)
text: Diplomacy + Leadership + CUNNING>35
lore: Retrieve crashed scoutship in Federation territory.

name: Crosis (Premiere Traditional)
text: Plays on {Rogue Borg}. Doubles their STRENGTH, including himself. Two Borg = 4 STRENGTH each, three Borg = 6 STRENGTH each, etc. (Not cumulative.)
lore: Fanatical Borg lieutenant of Lore. Captured Lt. Commander Data with the lure of emotions.

name: Crystalline Entity (Premiere Traditional)
text: Space mission: kills all life on ship unless SHIELDS>6 OR Music aboard. Planet mission: kills entire Away Team unless SCIENCE and MEDICAL present. Discard dilemma.
lore: Spaceborne life-form strips biological energy from planets and ships. Sensitive to modulation much like crystal can shatter from a high pitch note.

name: Cultural Observation (Premiere Traditional)
text: Anthropology + Leadership + STRENGTH>30
lore: Aid observation of primitive society.

name: Cytherians (Premiere Traditional)
text: Place on ship. Ship must do nothing but travel to far end of spaceline at normal speed. When reached, discard dilemma. Score points.
lore: Race which explores the galaxy by giving other species the temporary ability and strong compulsion to come to them.

name: Data (Premiere Traditional)
text: OFFICER ENGINEER Computer Skill x 2 Music Astrophysics Exobiology
lore: Lt. Commander Data is a sentient android created by Dr. Noonien Soong. Has positronic brain. Desires to be human. Once left his head in San Francisco.

name: Deanna Troi (Premiere Traditional)
keywords: Betazoid/Human; Counselor; Female; Support Personnel; U.S.S. Enterprise-related personnel;
text: OFFICER Empathy Diplomacy
lore: Lt. Commander Deanna Troi is a 1/2 Betazoid, 1/2 Human empath. Counselor for U.S.S. Enterprise. Imzadi to William T. Riker. Loves chocolate.

name: Devinoni Ral (Premiere Traditional)
text: V.I.P. Empathy Diplomacy Treachery
lore: 1/4 Betazoid 3/4 Human. Skilled negotiator. Abused his empathic powers to gain advantage. Had a dangerous liaison with Counselor Deanna Troi.

name: Devoras (Premiere Traditional)
keywords: Cloaking Device; Romulan ship; Tractor Beam;
text: Cloaking Device, Tractor Beam
lore: Warbird used to accomplish the escape of Romulan spy Selok from the Federation in 2367. Commanded by Admiral Mendak.

name: Diplomacy Mission (Premiere Traditional)
text: Diplomacy + INTEGRITY>30 + CUNNING>30
lore: Mediate dispute between civilizations on Peliar Zel's two moons.

name: Dr. La Forge (Premiere Traditional)
text: SCIENCE Exobiology
lore: Dr. La Forge is a Starfleet specialist in xenology and exobiology. Father of Lt. Commander Geordi La Forge. Husband of Captain Silva La Forge.

name: Dr. Reyga (Premiere Traditional)
text: SCIENCE ENGINEER Stellar Cartography Astrophysics
lore: Ferengi male scientist. Inventor of the revolutionary, but controversial, metaphasic shield technology. Endured skepticism from the scientific community.

name: Gaps in Normal Space (Premiere Traditional)
text: Place between two Mission cards. Creates a gap with a span of 4. Ships stopping on the gap kill one personnel (random selection).
lore: Pockets of space, such as those in the Mar Oscura nebula, dangerously phase out when coming in contact with a ship.

name: Ocett (Premiere Traditional)
text: OFFICER Archaeology Navigation Honor
lore: Gul Ocett, Cardassian female officer. Commander of a Galor-class warship. Pursuer of DNA program.

name: Roga Danar (Premiere Traditional)
text: SECURITY ENGINEER Computer Skill Biology Leadership
lore: Angosian male. Biochemically altered into a formidable perfect warrior ranked Subhadar.

name: Rogue Borg Mercenaries (Premiere Traditional)
text: Plays on any occupied ship. Battles crew now and at start of every players' turn. Two Borg =2 STRENGTH each, three =3 each, etc. Surviving Borg remain.
lore: Upon Hugh's return to the Borg collective, the Borg became self-aware. Soon, many unquestioningly followed their first leader, Lore.

name: Romulan Disruptor (Premiere Traditional)
text: Romulan and Non-Aligned use only. Each of your personnel STRENGTH +2 where present. (Cumulative.)
lore: Directed-energy weapon used by Romulans and other races. Disruptor fire can be identified by a high residue of antiprotons that linger for several hours.

name: Romulan Outpost (Premiere Traditional)
text: Seed one OR build where you have a Romulan ENGINEER.
lore: Romulus is one of the two homeworlds for the Romulans. The Romulan Star Empire establishes outposts throughout its territory.

name: Romulan PADD (Premiere Traditional)
text: Romulan use only. Each of your personnel CUNNING +2 where present. (Cumulative.)
lore: Standard Romulan Personal Access Display Device for computerized information.

name: Thomas Riker (Premiere Traditional)
text: OFFICER Leadership Navigation Geology Music
lore: Lt. Commander Thomas Riker is William Riker's double. Created during a transporter accident in 2361.

name: Thought Maker (Premiere Traditional)
text: Place in hand until played once as an Interrupt card. Look at opponent's draw deck for ten seconds and rearrange as desired.
lore: Outlawed Ferengi mind control device. Transmits signals that implant sensory experiences and triggers emotions and memories.

name: Dr. Selar (Premiere Traditional)
keywords: Vulcan; Female; Support Personnel; U.S.S. Enterprise-related personnel;
text: MEDICAL Computer Skill Mindmeld
lore: Dr. Selar is a female Vulcan medical doctor. Served aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise for many years.

name: Duras (Premiere Traditional)
text: V.I.P. Leadership Computer Skill Treachery Greed
lore: Son of Ja'rod. Contender for leadership of the Klingon High Council. Member of a powerful political family.

name: El-Adrel Creature (Premiere Traditional)
text: Attacks two strongest members in Away Team (owner's choice if tie). Kills one of them (random selection) unless their combined STRENGTH>16. Discard dilemma.
lore: Nearly invisible predatory electromagnetic creature. First encountered by Dathon and Captain Jean-Luc Picard on El-Adrel IV.

name: Emergency Transporter Armbands (Premiere Traditional)
text: Beam your Personnel up or down at any time, except during a dilemma (unless specifically permitted). May be used during battle before the winner is determined.
lore: Devices which allow quick remote activation of a transporter when in danger.

name: Energy Vortex (Premiere Traditional)
text: Plays immediately after opponent plays any non-Interrupt card from hand. That card returns to their hand and a different one must be played instead.
lore: Whirlpool-like space/time phenomena that can destroy a ship, as it nearly did the U.S.S. Enterprise in 2365.

name: Engineering Kit (Premiere Traditional)
text: Gives all of your OFFICER-classification personnel the extra skill of ENGINEER where present.
lore: Representative of specialized engineering instruments. Such equipment has been developed by many races.

name: Engineering PADD (Premiere Traditional)
text: Gives all of your SCIENCE-classification personnel the extra skill of ENGINEER where present.
lore: Representative of Personal Access Display Devices designed specifically for engineering functions. Such equipment has been developed by many races.

name: Eric Pressman (Premiere Traditional)
text: OFFICER ENGINEER Treachery
lore: Captain Eric Pressman commanded the U.S.S. Pegasus before it was lost in space following a failed experiment.

name: Escape Pod (Premiere Traditional)
text: Plays on ship being destroyed. Escape pod saves entire crew. Unseen by enemy ships, crew remains in pod until personnel rescued. Discard after rescue.
lore: Angosian escape pod used by Roga Danar in 2366. Escape pods can be used in an emergency to save a crew.

name: Espionage: Federation on Klingon (Premiere Traditional)
text: Plays on any Klingon mission. Your Federation personnel may now attempt this mission. Discard after mission completed.
lore: Federation intelligence-gathering has often relied on sympathetic informants and electronic surveillance.

name: Espionage: Klingon on Federation (Premiere Traditional)
text: Plays on any Federation mission. Your Klingon personnel may now attempt this mission. Discard after mission completed.
lore: Klingon espionage against the Federation has included data stolen from Relay Station 47 by Morag.

name: Espionage: Romulan on Federation (Premiere Traditional)
text: Plays on any Federation mission. Your Romulan personnel may now attempt this mission. Discard after mission completed.
lore: Romulan spies are everywhere.

name: Espionage: Romulan on Klingon (Premiere Traditional)
text: Plays on any Klingon mission. Your Romulan personnel may now attempt this mission. Discard after mission completed.
lore: Romulan espionage against Klingons has included efforts to de-stabilize the Klingon government by programming assassins and supporting rebel forces.

name: Etana Jol (Premiere Traditional)
text: SCIENCE Treachery Biology
lore: Ktarian female. Attempted to use a psychotropically addictive game to gain control of the Federation in 2368.

name: Evacuation (Premiere Traditional)
text: Diplomacy x3 + STRENGTH>35
lore: Evacuate American Indian colony.

name: Evaluate Terraforming (Premiere Traditional)
text: MEDICAL + Biology + Exobiology OR {Geordi La Forge} + MEDICAL x2
lore: Evaluate progress of terraforming station.

name: Evek (Premiere Traditional)
text: OFFICER Diplomacy Leadership Anthropology
lore: Gul Evek, Cardassian male officer. Administers area ceded to Cardassians in a treaty with the Federation.

name: Excavation (Premiere Traditional)
text: Archaeology OR CUNNING>32
lore: Assist new archaeological dig.

name: Explore Black Cluster (Premiere Traditional)
text: Stellar Cartography + Leadership OR CUNNING>50
lore: Study and evaluate enormous cluster of collapsed proto-stars.

name: Explore Dyson Sphere (Premiere Traditional)
text: ENGINEER x3 + Navigation + Computer Skill + Physics
lore: Study gigantic structure completely enclosing a star.

name: Explore Typhon Expanse (Premiere Traditional)
text: Astrophysics + Stellar Cartography OR CUNNING>50
lore: Trace time distortion reported in this desolate region.

name: Expose Covert Supply (Premiere Traditional)
text: Treachery x3 + Navigation
lore: Uncover covert supply lines supporting rebels on the Klingon Homeworld.
